items.title: Onwards and Sideways
items.overview: Tony Evans is the deputy head of a local primary school. Emma Dretzin is a pianist, composer and single mother of two daughters. Neither knows the other until a startling encounter changes the course of their lives: on the same morning, they are both confronted with a diagnosis of Parkinson’s.

items.title: Elsinore
items.overview: The deeply emotional and inspirational true story of Ian Charleson, a gifted actor whose greatest challenge becomes his greatest triumph. Facing his own mortality with unflinching honesty, wit, and grace, Charleson delivers a courageous performance that becomes a source of healing and inspiration for those around him.

items.title: Soul Patrol
items.overview: From deep behind enemy lines, a hidden chapter of American military history is uncovered, prompting the question of whether reckoning with the past can bring peace to those who lived it. The Vietnam War’s first Black special operations team reunites to tell their story.

items.title: My Kind of Christmas
items.overview: When ambitious assistant Lindsay must track down the season’s most sought-after toy to land a long-awaited promotion, she teams up with handsome widowed dad Erik on the same quest for his daughter. But as their practical mission turns into a heartwarming holiday journey, she’s forced to choose between the career she’s always chased and the unexpected joy of love, family, and Christmas magic!

items.title: One in a Million
items.overview: Filmed over 10 years, one girl's epic journey from Syria to Germany and back again. She and her family navigate war, exile, and heartbreak in a foreign land, illuminating the complexities of the refugee experience.

items.title: The Nameless Ballad
items.overview: Under pressure from his record label, a young musician in crisis takes refuge in an isolated Italian villa to find inspiration for his next album. But the discovery of an ancient piano and a forgotten diary drags him into a spiral of twisted obsessions, supernatural visions and ghostly presences that finally push him to the brink of madness.

items.title: The Loneliest Man in Town
items.overview: Blues musician Al Cook lives in an apartment filled with memories. Outside, the world carries on without him. But when his home is slated for demolition, out of the ruins of his existence, a long-forgotten dream suddenly resurfaces.

items.title: Dear Ajayi
items.overview: In 1990s Nigeria, two estranged sisters forced to live under the same roof while caring for their paralysed mother navigate grief, ambition, love, and the fragile bonds of family.

items.title: Last Stop for the Circular Ticket
items.overview: Around Lake Como, a voyage interrupted by a series of brief, successive stops, as fleeting as musical phrases. Someone enters and leaves a telephone booth. Water and the lines that contain it.

items.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
items.overview: War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant. There is no third time. Everything ends here.

items.title: The Last Temptation of Becky
items.overview: Now working as a field agent for the CIA, Becky is sent undercover to Poland to infiltrate a family of innkeepers running a tourist venture at The Wolf's Lair, Hitler's WWII bunker. After learning that the father, Wilhelm Reuss, is on a mission to bring about the Fourth Reich, Becky takes matters into her own hands.

items.title: Daffy Season
items.overview: Daffy is ready for Duck Season, but Elmer is too immersed in his new obsession – soccer – to come hunting. Slowly the world around Daffy turns into a zombie-esque nightmare as the Tunes become obsessed with the sport.

items.title: Paper Tiger
items.overview: Two brothers become entangled in a scheme that turns out to be too good to be true. As they try to navigate their way through the dangerous world of the Russian mafia, family bonds begin to fray with life-altering consequences.

items.title: All the Lovers in the Night
items.overview: Freelance proofreader Fuyuko's carefully ordered life in solitude begins to transform after meeting Mitsutsuka, a quiet high school physics teacher.

items.title: Mahi
items.overview: Mahi, an 80-years old woman, is a former military officer who underwent gender reassignment and became a singer. 50 years later, she returns from Germany to Greece to reconnect with her daughter in order to rebuild their relationship.

items.title: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend
items.overview: An ancient epic follows a young prince and princess whose marriage and subsequent exile mark the beginning of a legendary journey. Their story of love, duty and destiny sets the stage for greater challenges ahead.

items.title: Avedon
items.overview: Richard Avedon's photographs didn't just reflect culture, they shaped it, and continue to do so. The feature documentary AVEDON traces the life and legacy of an artist who used fashion, portraiture, and commercial photography to explore identity, power, fear and beauty. With unprecedented access to Avedon's archive, including never before seen photos, behind the scenes recordings, and interviews with those who knew him best, AVEDON is a visually stunning examination of the mind of an artist who shaped our collective image of the 20th century.

items.title: A Place to Heal
items.overview: In a French public hospital, the adolescent psychiatry unit moves to the erratic rhythm of teenagers coming and going - many carrying heavy past baggage - while Etienne and his medical team navigate the relentless cycle of treating, listening, and confronting the raw edges of suffering. Young Lucia knows the ward too well. After being brought back yet again by the police, she reunites with her friend Eloïse and encounters a constellation of young patients, each wrestling with their own storms. At times, there is laughter, small breakthroughs, moments of fragile hope. But the balance is shaky, and the arrival of a new patient will shatter it entirely.

items.title: Zi
items.overview: In Hong Kong, a young woman haunted by visions of her future self meets a stranger who changes the course of her night -- and possibly her life.

items.title: In Transit
items.overview: When a complacent young bartender living in small-town Maine agrees to model for a existentially floundering painter on an artist's retreat, both women must confront their preconceptions of what makes a good life.

items.title: silver express
items.overview: Chieri, who has never had romantic feelings for anyone and has no romantic experience, always feels lonely and out of place. Not only does she struggle with interpersonal relationships with close friends like Yuki, but she also finds it difficult to empathize with the characters in romantic movies, and is unable to respond well to the affections of her close male friend, Saito. One day, Chieri meets Shoya, a man who, like her, has no romantic feelings. The two hit it off and rejoice that they are not alone. However, despite their seemingly limitless similarities, there is one crucial difference...

items.title: Victorian Psycho
items.overview: When eccentric young governess Winifred Notty arrives at a remote Gothic manor, a string of unsettling events leads the household to suspect she isn't who she claims to be—but the truth may be far more dangerous than they imagine.

items.title: Gabin
items.overview: Gabin, the youngest child of the Jourdel family, is set to take over his father's butcher shop. Torn between family loyalty and a desire to break free, he has other dreams.

items.title: Drei Kameradinnen
items.overview: Hani, Kasih and Saya have shared a deep friendship since their youth. Now, after years, the three meet again. But no matter where they are, it becomes clear time and again that everyday racism affects their lives. Nonetheless, their friendship gives them strength. Until one dramatic night shakes everything up.

items.title: Terrell & T.O.
items.overview: This feature-length documentary traces the meteoric rise of one of the most talented, accomplished, and polarizing athletes of America's most popular sport and examines his role as the preeminent "prima donna" wide receiver of his era, while catching up with Owens in present-day to see how he is evolving and discovering a new personal path forward.

items.title: The Green Eyes
items.overview: Chaya, 11, lives with her family in the Landes region, by the ocean. When they learn they’re being evicted, her older brother Nour falls into a deep and mysterious sleep. Chaya will do everything she can to wake him up, even going so far as to dive into his dreams to find him.

items.title: The Golden Age
items.overview: Born at the turn of the century in a village's butcher shop, Jeanne Lavaur dreams of becoming a countess. Inspired by the fearless Céleste and guided by her love for Guillaume de Barante, Jeanne’s journey carries her from the vibrant Paris of the Golden Twenties through the turmoil of two world wars. As her life intertwines with the great upheavals of the 20th century, she rises as a fiercely free woman, determined to never let anyone else define who she is meant to be.

items.title: Drummer Boy
items.overview: As America’s fight for independence begins, a young drummer boy, an enslaved woman, and a divided family search for freedom. Through battle and loss, music carries hope in a deeply human story of faith and forgiveness.

items.title: Club Kid
items.overview: A hard-partying New York City club promoter sees his whirlwind lifestyle upended by the arrival of the 10-year-old son he never knew he had.

items.title: Nuisance Bear
items.overview: A polar bear is forced to navigate a human world of tourists, wildlife officers, and hunters as its ancient migration collides with modern life. When a sacred predator is branded a nuisance, it becomes unclear who truly belongs in this shared landscape.

items.title: Jimmy
items.overview: A look into the life of American actor James Stewart, whose inspiring tale of valor, purpose and faith will win over everyone.

items.title: Prima Facie
items.overview: Tessa is a brilliant British defence barrister dominating London’s ruthless courtrooms. Fierce, witty, and self-made, she defends men accused of sexual assault — until she is assaulted herself by a colleague from a powerful legal dynasty.  Suddenly, the system she trusted turns against her. As she faces the same tactics she once used in court, Tessa’s faith in justice unravels. Once in control, now exposed and disbelieved, she must fight to reclaim her voice and sense of self.

items.title: THE SUNSHINE BOY
items.overview: A young boy named Ivan, who works as a sex worker, and his friend Efrem, another sex worker, stumble across the crime scene of a girl they know. Efrem sees it as just another day, while Ivan sees it as a sign to leave behind the dangerous world he's trapped in. Desperate for a way out, Ivan meets a girl named Mishka, who offers him a job involving extreme work. It pays well, and promises enough money to finally escape the life he's been living.

items.title: I Play Rocky
items.overview: The electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn't just meant to write Rocky—he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told "no" at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds.

items.title: GROTESQQQUE
items.overview: An alien girl wants to be her planet's ambassador to be able to present herself on Earth. A group of high school students take part in a violent battle royale game called The Queen of Butterflies. A pure-blooded, female vampire lives with hef servants in a world where humanity has become extinct.

items.title: Ghost Soldier
items.overview: Henry “Fitz” Fitzgerald has spent years living quietly off the grid, hiding from a past few people know anything about. But when a powerful foreign corporation moves into his hometown to seize his neighbors’ land for a massive payday, Fitz is forced to reveal who he really is: a former Special Forces soldier and advanced weapons developer. Armed with experimental technology, lethal combat skills, and an unwavering code of justice, Fitz wages a one-man war against an enemy that never saw him coming.

items.title: The Cat in the Hat
items.overview: Assigned his toughest mission yet, the Cat must cheer up siblings Gabby and Sebastian as they adjust to life in a new town. Known for pushing boundaries, this agent of chaos must prove himself or risk losing his magical hat forever.

items.title: Model Citizen
items.overview: With his memories gone and his past a blur, ex-cop Steven Bay seeks treatment for his amnesia while working on an isolated farm. Instead, he's met with rising hostility, strange surveillance, and instincts he can’t fully control. When the pressure becomes unbearable, Bay begins a desperate hunt for the truth behind his fractured reality.

items.title: A Dog's Perfect Christmas
items.overview: When a medical emergency pulls the Goss family apart, determined dog Winstead will do all he can to bring his humans back together before Christmas Eve.

items.title: Mike Tyson: Return of the Mike
items.overview: The former heavyweight champion returns to the stage for a raw one-man show, turning his wildest life stories into comedy gold at Seminole Hard Rock Hotel and Casino.

items.title: Women on Trial
items.overview: 1972. A landmark trial shakes France as young Marie-Claire is prosecuted for having an illegal abortion with the help of her mother and two other defendants. In a courtroom governed by men, the verdict seems inevitable: prison for the women, while the rapist goes unpunished. Their last hope lies with Gisèle Halimi, a fearless lawyer known for openly challenging patriarchy and confronting the system that condemns victims and lets perpetrators walk free. Alongside the accused, Gisèle will not only change their fate, but, against all odds, transform the condition of women forever

items.title: Ninho: Fame Ain’t Worth It
items.overview: At the height of his success in 2025, French rap star Ninho considers leaving music behind. This documentary looks back on the triumphs, sacrifices and personal challenges that brought him to that crossroads.

items.title: George Michael: The Faith Tour
items.overview: A stunning delve into George Michael's 1988 Faith Tour, as shot live at the famous Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy. This exclusive footage, assembled from a 14-camera shoot captured on 35mm over two nights (30–31 May 1988), features the 24-year-old pop star at the height of his powers.

items.title: Better Alone
items.overview: Overwhelmed by living with their teenage children, Lidia and Félix announce a decision as unexpected as it is irreversible. A sharp comedy about family ties, the limits of cohabitation, and the difficult transition to adulthood.

items.title: Final Interview
items.overview: Six college students meet at the final interview of a global IT company. Growing closer as they prepare for the group discussion, they dare to dream that all six might make it — until the day before the interview, when the company announces its verdict: only one will be hired. On the day of the interview, mysterious envelopes arrive, each containing one of their secrets — and suspicion begins to take hold. Who among the six is the liar?

items.title: Casa Pequena
items.overview: Five musicians travel to a secluded house in the Serra da Estrela mountains, hoping that a retreat will renew their friendship and creativity, but a mysterious host will place the band at the center of an intrigue. Is this house cursed?

items.title: One Year to Live, Buy a Man
items.overview: Given a year to live, frugal 40-year-old Yui finally lets herself spend: "buying" nightclub host Sena. What begins as a contract takes an unexpected turn.

items.title: Overacting
items.overview: When her father's memories as a retired top cop resurface, a struggling actress stages wild missions to keep him from pursuing his elusive archnemesis.

items.title: Scene
items.overview: Inbaraj, a police officer, is forced to come back from retirement when a new case resembles one he closed years ago. This time, he must solve it with a chaotic and troublesome team. As they struggle to work together and deal with the twists and turns of the case, the investigation takes them on a chaotic and unpredictable ride.

items.title: Dilwali Diwali
items.overview: Ansh Sikkha returns to his Punjabi family home for Diwali after years working abroad. As the Sikkas gather for the festival, their clashing views on what constitutes a fulfilling life create friction and connection.

items.title: Disco
items.overview: An ordinary man undergoes a transformation as he enters the dark and dangerous world of the underworld.

items.title: Frequency of Fear
items.overview: In September 2024, a covert Israeli operation took aim at decimating Islamist militant group Hezbollah, in which thousands of pagers and walkie-talkies in the possession of its operatives exploded simultaneously in Lebanon.

items.title: The Liberation
items.overview: Rita is entranced by the mesmeric Leader and renounces her family to embrace the world of the enigmatic Harmonia commune. Her daughters Ella and Jo put everything on the line to infiltrate the cult and bring their mother home. Yet, once immersed in the commune, they find themselves inexorably drawn into the Leader’s labyrinthine web of psycho-spiritual manipulation.

items.title: High End: The Watch Theft Ring
items.overview: Investigates Chile's high-profile Caso Relojes ("Watch Case") scandal, in which a suitcase full of smuggled luxury watches and jewelry unmasked an illicit underground network, connecting criminal elements to Chile's social elite.

items.title: Being Heumann
items.overview: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

items.title: Mookuthi Amman 2
items.overview: A queen sacrifices herself to protect her son, the prince, from invading enemies.Mookuthi Amman returns to protect the child and confronts a mysterious woman who embodies a new and dangerous evil.

items.title: Unprotected: Murder in Galicia
items.overview: Documentary film that tells the story of Isabel Fuentes. In April 2015, alleged burglars left her on the brink of death in her own home, in the village of Pazos, in Verín. From the very beginning, the Guardia Civil sergeant in charge of the case suspected that the account of what had happened did not add up and tried to protect Isabel from further attack.

items.title: Little Genes
items.overview: In 1987, on a weekend camping trip in Utah's beautiful Wasatch Mountains, fourteen-year-old Arlo Murphy is eager to prove he can be a world explorer scout like his Dad, while his parents grapple with Arlo's gender identity.

items.title: Fuego amigo
items.overview: Andrés is a veteran of the Malvinas War. He works at the family transportation company. News arrives that the EAAF?the Argentine Forensic Anthropology Team?has identified the remains of his friend Damián, who fell in battle. He has started smoking again. A delegation is being organized to travel to the Islands and attend the ceremony. An old pang of guilt torments him: when Damián fell, he was a few meters behind him, firing his weapon. He always knew it wasn?t him, but the specter of friendly fire casts a shadow over his memory.

items.title: Edo²
items.overview: With another summer drawing to a close in a province of Northern Italy, Edoardo fights to regain control of a youth that feels far too small for him. When an online site appears to truly get him, offering a way to fill his emptiness, Edo seizes the chance to break free from the suffocating fear of never being enough.

items.title: The 12 Dates of Christmas
items.overview: Christina Walker, a successful shop owner who has devoted her energy to her career at the expense of her dating life, goes on 12 dates in the 12 weeks leading up to Christmas hoping to find Mr. Right.

items.title: Wolves Up Close with Bertie Gregory
items.overview: Reconnecting with a pack of wolves he has followed for seven years, Bertie sets out to capture one of the Arctic's most dangerous and rarely filmed hunts: wolves taking on a bull moose, prey roughly ten times their size. Led by Kona, a striking white breeding male, the pack faces a critical winter as dwindling food supplies, an encroaching rival wolf and an aging leader threaten its survival.

items.title: Nooru Kodi Vaanavil
items.overview: Vino and Fenny's lives intertwine in a poignant tale of love, hope, and heartbreak.

items.title: Kamen Rider Kabuto 20th: ​​The One Who Inherits the Heavens
items.overview: 20 years after the events of the series, humans and Worms are walking towards the path of coexistence. However, ZECT is secretly developing a new Masked Rider System. Yui Kagami, the son of Arata Kagami/Kamen Rider Gatack is qualified to use the new system. Arata Kagami also investigates a ZECT conspiracy all by himself, but a shadow of an unexpected person appears before him...!

items.title: blood & soil
items.overview: A young man attends a rally.

items.title: Djinn Wedding
items.overview: When four estranged siblings reunite in their remote Anatolian village for their sister’s wedding, long-buried memories begin to resurface. As the celebrations unfold, two of them are drawn back into the unbreakable bond they once shared. Family secrets slowly come to light, leading them on a journey through grief and the invisible ties between generations.

items.title: Ferine
items.overview: A tragic event shatters a rich art collector's life, awakening her primal nature. She destroys her privileged existence to build a new concept of family, leading her on a path of destruction and animalistic transformation.

items.title: Holiday Unplugged
items.overview: After losing treasured videos of her late husband, a widowed mother plans a screen-free Christmas while secretly searching for the originals and finding unexpected romance along the way.

items.title: Antoñito Molina - Un sueño: del chiringuito al estadio
Best Pancakes in the County
items.overview: Over the course of one explosive night, a small-town diner becomes the epicenter of a deadly standoff involving rogue federal agents, a fast-talking con man with a dangerous past, and a waitress harboring secrets of her own.

items.title: Se domani non torno
items.overview: It follows the tragic life of Giulia Cecchettin, starting from the private pain of her father, Gino Cecchettin, and culminating in a cinematic story that stems from the book of the victim's father, entitled Dear Giulia.

items.title: Postcards for Christmas
items.overview: Hannah Norton moves to Mistletoe Valley for the holidays to work at the post office alongside her best friend from college. She discovers that the post office is full of undeliverable mail, including several love letters from the same man. Hannah sets out to solve the mystery - with the help of Ford Montgomery, a DJ at a local radio station.

items.title: The Holiday Spark
items.overview: Firefight Dean enlists illustrator Laura to help plan a holiday party for his firehouse. As they plan the epic party, both begin to question their views on romance and the possibility of love at first spark.

items.title: A Ghost at Gilmore House
items.overview: As part of a school project, Rachel begins investigating the fifty-year-old murder of infamous paranormal investigator Lucy Carter, a case the supernatural community has long attributed to an angry spirit. But as Rachel delves deeper into Lucy’s past, long-buried secrets begin to surface, raising questions about what really happened that night.

items.title: Mouse
items.overview: When her closest friendship is suddenly disrupted the summer before senior year, a teenager struggles to find her footing and develops an unexpected, complicated bond with her best friend’s mother.

items.title: The Beachnickers 3
items.overview: Rocha decides to foot the bill for his daughter's wedding in an island and invites his loyal colleagues, Alexandre, Lima, and Diguinho, along with their families, to the all-expenses-paid celebration. The setting seemed perfect for an unforgettable trip, but the peace is short-lived, soon giving way to a series of surprises and mishaps.

items.title: Merry Christmas Aubrey Flint
items.overview: An amateur production of A Christmas Carol at a retirement home is reluctantly directed by reclusive man on community service.

items.title: GJLS: Berapi-Api
items.overview: Three best friends are obsessed with becoming firefighters so they can look heroic by putting out fires. However, after failing during their training with the legendary Algojo Api squad, the three find themselves stuck doing seemingly “trivial” assignments. When they attempt to take a shortcut to join the firefighting team as soon as possible, they instead find themselves caught up in a dangerous mission to rescue children from a criminal syndicate.

items.title: How to Rob a Bank
items.overview: A crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their most ambitious heist yet.

items.title: A Season of Promises
items.overview: Though a years-ago rift following their mother's passing has pulled the sisters apart, Heidi and Sophie share is a deep love for their father, Ed. As they work together to prepare Ed for the dating world in the hope he'll find someone special in time for the holiday, they each go on their own journeys that bring them unexpected joy, love and peace for Christmas.

items.title: A Richer Christmas
items.overview: When a wealthy family loses everything before the holidays, their world falls apart — but in the chaos, they discover the true meaning of Christmas.

items.title: An Ozark Mountain Christmas
items.overview: When a dedicated young designer at a crossroads reluctantly follows her sister home to the nostalgic heart of the Ozarks for Christmas, she finds herself rediscovering not only her family’s legacy for commitment to craft, but also the quiet faith and purpose she has lost in the rush of modern life. With the help of Paul, Clara will reconnect with work rooted in care and community.
stream: Great American Pure Flix Amazon Channel

items.title: Tony Xavier
items.overview: A Chartered Accountant who acknowledges that his death is close at hand and becomes isolated in life altogether, loses his mental state and seeks refuge in the pleasure of eliminating the happiness of people around him forever, with a pinch of sadistic desires.

items.title: Rammstein – Live in Mexico City
items.overview: A three-night compilation that captures their spectacular October 2022 shows at the Foro Sol Stadium in Mexico City during the Stadium Tour era. This live has become the band's most massive and longest one of their entire career.

items.title: My Son’s Sugar Mama
items.overview: A protective mother discovers a wealthy, older woman is showering her young son with gifts and money. As she sets out to expose her, she discovers the woman's obsession with her son is far more dangerous than she ever could have imagined.

items.title: Ebenezer
items.overview: An elderly miser embarks on a supernatural journey after visits from the ghost of his former business partner and the Spirits of Christmas Past, Present, and Yet to Come force him to confront his past and fight for a second chance at happiness.

items.title: Madden
items.overview: Chronicles John Madden's incredible journey alongside best friend and true original Al Davis—from a Super Bowl-winning partnership with the Raiders, to becoming football’s most recognizable voice, to building the worldwide Madden NFL video game.

items.title: The Gospel of Christmas
items.overview: A struggling pastor moves his family to a troubled New York neighborhood, where they must save a neglected church from foreclosure before Christmas.

items.title: Villeneuve: The Rise of a Champion
items.overview: Showcases the early years of Québec racing driver Gilles Villeneuve.

items.title: Infection
items.overview: An ambitious office worker suspects her boss’s mysterious illness may be contagious. With a promotion within reach, she faces a choice between professional advancement and the person she wants to remain.

items.title: A Danish Christmas
items.overview: Marie helps her family's Copenhagen inn at Christmas when Ryan arrives, and she mistakes him for a travel writer. She curates a tour in search of hygge and the two find a connection as well.

items.title: The Invisible Horse
items.overview: Just when Jack begins to think he’s too old for Christmas, he ends up befriending an invisible creature that reminds him of what makes Christmas so magical.

items.title: Il faut brûler maman
items.overview: A comedy of manners set in a funeral home.

items.title: Confession
items.overview: In 1938, in Stalin's Moscow, a disillusioned professor, Alexei, faces brutal interrogation by his former student, Vladimir, in Lubyanka Prison. Refusing to confess, he confronts his past sins and finds redemption through faith, sacrificing himself to save others in a haunting tale of morality and resistance.

items.title: Dance with the Jackals 8
items.overview: Having overcome various dangers together for years, the Jackals gang are trying to establish a new life when they are mysteriously kidnapped and find themselves on their way to Germany, right in the middle of a human trafficking network. In this absurd journey, orchestrated by Şerafettin Top Müller, the Jackals must confront their past grievances and survive within an international criminal organization they unknowingly became involved in.

items.title: Dead Net
items.overview: A promising young tennis player finds her dreams threatened when she is targeted by a mysterious figure who is out for her blood.

items.title: Janelle James: How Romantic
items.overview: In her debut hour-long stand-up special, Janelle James sounds off on body counts, bank accounts and why women should wrestle men.

items.title: Merry Memories
items.overview: When her nephew is assigned a Christmas scrapbook project for his mother, Michaela is forced to partner with Bryan to help bring the holiday season to life. With Bryan preparing to leave town after Christmas, Michaela must decide if she’s finally ready to let love disrupt her perfectly ordered life.

items.title: Santa's Workshop
items.overview: Nine-year-old Mari is really looking forward to Christmas. Her journalist dad, Svein, on the other hand, loves his job so much, he barely notices the festive season. One night, Mari’s Christmas list vanishes – and in its place lies a mysterious mitten. The mitten sends Mari, Svein and her adventurous grandma on an exciting quest to find Santa Claus. Meanwhile, Stubby the Wishlist Elf is in a panic — he’s lost his mitten, which might just lead this curious family straight to the secret location of Santa’s workshop! He must stop them before it’s too late!

items.title: Remember
items.overview: An estranged couple who have forgotten what it means to love each other find themselves pretending to be together again for the sake of their daughter, whose memory is fading.

items.title: The Invisible Guest
items.overview: Accused of murdering her lover, a young businesswoman hires a brilliant lawyer. With only three hours left, they must uncover what really happened.

items.title: Never Dies
items.overview: Amidst imminent financial ruin, a debt-ridden man experiences profound relief upon discovering his estranged late father’s substantial life insurance policy—only to be thrown into an absurd moral crisis when the patriarch unexpectedly resuscitates inside the hearse en route to the funeral home.

items.title: Fiesta Pagäna
items.overview: The movie chronicles the untold story of the band from their origins in the 1980s, highlighting their rise to fame, creative tensions, line-up changes, internal dynamics, controversies, and fan culture.

items.title: Pray for Us
items.overview: In the mid-to-late 1970s, two young women from different social backgrounds meet inside the Patronato de Protección a la Mujer (Women’s Protection Board), a state-backed institution that confined thousands of women, many single mothers, in convents and boarding schools under the guise of moral 'reform'. Ana, a rebellious 19-year-old from Barcelona, is sent by her wealthy father to a Patronato facility overseen by the merciless Sister Socorro. Amid the harsh conditions, Ana forms a deep bond with Sole, a friendship tested by escape attempts, reprisals, and an ultimate sacrifice.

items.title: Crimson Ring
items.overview: A young boxer risks everything by turning to performance-enhancing drugs before the biggest fight of his life.

items.title: Snowbody Like You
items.overview: A holiday first date ends in a frosty misunderstanding, leaving Peyton and Ethan to go their separate ways. Years later, a Christmas blizzard brings them back together, giving them one more chance to discover if the magic between them was meant to last.
stream: UP Faith & Family Apple TV channel

items.title: Argentina Stone
items.overview: Argentina Stone explores how The Rolling Stones inspired one of the most powerful urban subcultures in Latin America. Through archival footage and testimonies from key figures of Argentine rock, the film traces the birth, rise, and legacy of the rolinga movement - a tribe that transformed admiration for a band into a way of life.

items.title: On Behalf of My Son
items.overview: Vicentina struggles to cope with the death of her son Wesley after a tragic bus accident, in which he was the driver. As the investigation unfolds, evidence suggests that Wesley’s actions may have been suicidal. Vicentina then embarks on a journey to seek out the victims’ families and apologize, while confronting her own grief and uncertainty.

items.title: Ghost Song
items.overview: Farasha and Faris are 20 when they meet at a graduation party – one glance that changes everything. But Farasha dies that very same night. Refusing to be separated from him, she discovers a way to cross the boundary between worlds: for 40 nights, and 40 nights only, she can meet Faris in his dreams. And so their love continues to grow, until the very last night.

items.title: Putri, Jangan Gentayangan Lagi
items.overview: Putri had run away from home about a year prior. When she was finally found by her mother, Mak Elli, and her younger sister, Alana, Putri was ill following childbirth; she had originally fled after becoming pregnant by her boyfriend. Mak Elli insisted that Putri and her baby, Raman, return home to reunite with the family. After moving back, however, Putri’s condition deteriorated, and she passed away. Since then, local residents have complained about sightings of Putri’s wandering spirit, which appears to be lingering as if there is unfinished business.

items.title: BAGA: Tomorrow Belongs to No One
items.overview: In a conservative East Coast village, two young lovers struggle to escape poverty and tradition when an unexpected pregnancy pushes them into difficult choices, leading one to turn to drug trafficking in a desperate bid for a better future.

items.title: Carnaval
items.overview: Four friends from Brabant who live for Carnaval see their party plans unravel when one of them suddenly has to care for his estranged daughter and Prince Carnaval reveals a sinister side. They must do everything they can to save Carnaval.

items.title: Ethical Witchery
items.overview: Witches, Dahlia and Ivy, have been performing the same ritual for over five centuries. To spice things up, Ivy invites baby witch, Oleander, to join them, but Dahlia is not sure she's ready to change her routine.

items.title: Ana, en passant
items.overview: After her grandmother’s death, Ana finds herself adrift. Following the clues left by her late grandmother, Ana arrives in Belo Horizonte and meets Alice. As they make sense of the city’s layout and their memories, Ana and Alice will discover what it means to become who they are.

items.title: Flying Cows
items.overview: In the 1990s, a dairy farm was working on a special milk formula that could heal wounds and make people look younger. To get out of poverty, a group of workers planned to steal it. But everything changed when their leader, Trau - started to fall for the person who created the formula.

items.title: Kommissar Jennerwein – Hochsaison
items.overview: Jennerwein has barely started his job in Garmisch-Partenkirchen when a Danish ski jumper falls to his death, the president of the Winter Games Committee narrowly escapes an assassination attempt, and anonymous letters announce further crimes. Amidst suspicious villagers and vain local politics, Jennerwein must unmask a perpetrator who craves attention and is playing a deadly serious game.

items.title: Mog's Bad Thing
items.overview: Follows Mog, a tabby cat, who does a bad thing during a cat show hosted by her family in their garden, hides in the attic feeling sorry for herself, and must find a way to save the day.

items.title: The Sweetest Christmas Date
items.overview: When overworked chiropractor Charlotte Hope receives an exquisite, anonymous Christmas chocolate, her orderly world is suddenly turned upside down. Determined to uncover the sender, she teams up with Cody Woods, the charming but guarded chocolatier whose shop is fighting to survive the holiday rush. As their search leads them through festive small-town magic, Charlotte discovers that the sweetest surprises – and maybe even love – can’t be scheduled, controlled, or ignored.

items.title: Tiliche
items.overview: A Tiliche dancer from Oaxaca loses his colorful fabrics in an attempt to assimilate into the unfamiliar, gray world that surrounds him.

items.title: Native Sin
items.overview: A Native American priest and his medicine woman sister must set aside old resentments to unite faith and tradition against a vengeful spirit.

items.title: The Tunnel
items.overview: Suffering from post-traumatic stress after a violent assault in a tunnel, Janet Crane returns to the subterranean passageway to confront her fears and regain her freedom. When a hooded figure starts following her, the past and present collide as Janet tries to escape.

items.title: The Wedding Bangles
items.overview: Argentina, 1967. On her fifteenth birthday, María mourns the end of her childhood while glimpsing an unfulfilling future as a middle-class woman. Tension escalates when her older cousin Bárbara pushes her to the breaking point.

items.title: The Arab
items.overview: Haroun is an old bachelor who has lived in Oran for several years. A retired civil servant, he leads a reclusive life until the day he meets Kamel in a bar—a journalist to whom he tells an incredible story dating back to 1942. He claims to be the brother of ‘the Arab’ killed in a story told in one of the most famous novels of the 20th century, ‘The Stranger’ by Albert Camus. An Arab with an erased name: Moussa. Through anger, assertions, details, and confidences, Haroun finally convinces the journalist to listen to his story. His confession is a cry of freedom and distress—but above all, a cry of revolt: against an abusive mother, against a country that failed to achieve true independence, against a book, and against a famous French writer.

items.title: Block 10
items.overview: In early 1943, at the Auschwitz main camp, hundreds of Jewish women are confined in cramped quarters in BLOCK 10, which is separated from the rest of the camp grounds. Nazi doctors subject them to the most painful methods of forced sterilization. Prisoner doctors are forced to collaborate. The Jewish gynecologist Dr. Maximilian Samuel is blackmailed with the gassing of his 20-year-old daughter if he refuses to participate in the brutal experiments. Caught in this moral dilemma, he seeks his own path.

items.title: Duct Tape
items.overview: Two boys are kidnapped and thrown into a room. How will they get out?

items.title: Apolonia
items.overview: Justyna, a young archaeologist conducting research on the graves of "cursed soldiers" - victims of crimes committed by the communist security apparatus - discovered in Pułtusk, must confront her own family's past.

items.title: Novemberliebe - Eine St. Martins Geschichte
items.overview: Officer Henrik and therapist Anja would hardly be a match on a dating platform! She, a mother of three and in the midst of separating from her former dream man, has other things on her mind right now than falling in love again. He, disciplined and hard on himself, struggles with war trauma and relationship problems. When the man in his forties has to attend therapy sessions prescribed by his doctor at Anja's “Martinshof,” their paths cross.

items.title: The Table: Day and Night
items.overview: In a bustling café where lives briefly intersect, serendipity takes centre stage. A man and a woman share the same eccentric dream – will fate bring them together? Old classmates run into each other after years: a sweet second chance or a bitter reality check? A director approaches a novelist he admires to find out if the connection on page is merely delusional. A K-idol meets her first love, where the prospect of parting ways leaves them feeling wistful.

items.title: Grin
items.overview: While visiting her family, Eva is introduced to her mother’s new partner, Lucian. When the group play Lucian’s mysterious old board game for the first time, they begin to believe it has summoned a demonic entity that punishes those who have committed terrible sins. After a series of terrifying encounters, the players begin going missing one by one. Eva soon realizes the game is more deadly than she could ever have imagined.

items.title: The Holiday Hitman
items.overview: Hitman Hank Carter is trying to save his marriage with the perfect family Christmas. Unfortunately for him, a hit has been put on his head — and a gang of festive bounty hunters will stop at nothing to collect the payday.

items.title: Embers
items.overview: Huang Yan, a terminally ill crematorium worker, accidentally mixed up two sets of ashes during her work. When she confessed the truth, neither family wanted to swap them back. Only Yao Xue, the daughter of one of the deceased, believed Huang Yan. The two embarked on a wild and absurd journey to return the ashes, where they came to understand life anew and chose to live bravely in the face of death.

items.title: Trahisons, l'art de rompre en politique
Animal Justice
items.overview: Nick Morgan, a dedicated National Park Ranger, with a passion for wildlife takes a dark turn when he witnesses a brutal act of animal abuse. Nick embarks on a clandestine mission to protect these vulnerable creatures Will he find a way?

items.title: A Man of Vision: The Bill Wittliff Story
items.overview: From a small-town Texas boy to the visionary behind Lonesome Dove, Bill Wittliff spent a lifetime capturing the soul of Texas through photography, film, and storytelling.

items.title: Game Theory
items.overview: ​Trapped in a forbidden affair with his stepmother, a man under the growing influence of an AI companion enters a deadly game in a desperate attempt to earn his father's recognition.

items.title: Einar Schleef - No Germany Did I Find
items.overview: With his monumental productions, Einar Schleef pushed theatre to the outer reaches, confounded expectations in East and West alike, grappled with GDR origins and the BRD present. A universal artist emerges from the archive: “I’m not human, I’m dynamite”.

items.title: It's Not Tomorrow Yet
items.overview: After her divorce, Lola tries to rebuild her life amidst raising her children and dealing with the pressures of those around her. An unexpected encounter leads her to explore long-held desires and understand that letting go can also be a way to start over again.

items.title: De souche
items.overview: As immigration becomes more central than ever in political discourses, De souche offers a dizzying deep dive into the far-reaching tentacles of the “Great Replacement” conspiracy theory, which is gaining popularity across the Western world. In this illuminating documentary, journalist and filmmaker Simon Coutu travels across Québec and France, meeting a range of people who subscribe to or specialize in the subject. He examines the origins of this rhetoric, its harmful consequences, and its ties to the far right and white supremacist movements. A hard-hitting documentary that offers an essential critical perspective.

items.title: History of the Marvel Universe Side-Scroll
items.overview: Enjoy a 10-hour musical, scrolling loop of Chris Giarrusso’s epic artwork from “History of the Marvel Universe.”

items.title: Summer Holidays
items.overview: A city boy's summer at his grandparents' Godavari village transforms when he befriends a spirited local paper boy. Together they explore rural life through adventures that forge an unforgettable childhood bond.

items.title: Gorgeous Grandmother
items.overview: An aged beautician longing for confidence joins a beauty pageant.

items.title: Hadota
items.overview: 40-year-old thug Hadoota kidnaps a witness, only to completely forget where he hid them. Desperate to retrace his steps and recover the missing information, he turns to a hypnosis therapist.

items.title: Panch Pandav
items.overview: Spanning from the Dwapara Yuga to the present Kali Yuga, Yudhishthira searches for his family in Nepal, where he confronts injustice, corruption, and oppression in a modern-day battle between righteousness and evil.

items.title: La Esquina tá en Candela
items.overview: When a man bursts into a grocery store armed and demanding to talk with somebody, an ordinary afternoon turns into chaos in the neighborhood.

items.title: Christmas Pop-Up
items.overview: Desperate for a fresh start, an unlucky-in-love set decorator takes a job designing a Christmas Eve pop-up event for a jaded celebrity chef, hoping to escape her current hell - living with her ex and his new girlfriend - before they get engaged on New Year’s Eve.

items.title: Terra Firme
items.overview: In a coastal village forgotten by time, young Juca approaches Zé Cangulo, a fisherman living in isolation on his boat. A silent bond forms between them, shaped by waiting and the sea. By bringing to light a submerged past in which the boy recognizes himself, this encounter opens up the possibility of a fresh start.

items.title: Thank You for Your Review
items.overview: A people-pleasing waiter sabotages his own evening trying to impress his boss; a self-conscious friend competes for attention at someone else’s birthday dinner; and two sisters turn a simple meal into a battlefield. Through quiet frustrations and misplaced priorities, the night unravels into an elegant mess of misunderstandings. No wonder this restaurant’s online reviews are so confusing.

items.title: What Lives in Room 214?
items.overview: "What Lives in Room 214?" is a psychological horror featurette that follows actor Cory King who moves into a hotel for semi-successful actors, producers, and directors. The longer he stays, the more he notices things around him have never been what they seemed. "What Lives in Room 214?" tells a cautionary tale about the cost of fame.

items.title: The Guest
items.overview: At a luxury seaside hotel, Karl and Emilie are preparing for their son’s naming party, when Karl’s estranged mother, Vibeke, suddenly turns up uninvited. Karl want’s her gone, but his sister, Rikke, insists there won’t be any issues. Over one tense weekend, old patterns and buried wounds surface in front of in-laws and guests — until the celebration fractures into a collision.

items.title: Perfume
items.overview: María Gabriela Epumer was a woman of innovative talent who created and performed rock music in the 1980s and 90s as a member of Viuda e Hijas de Roque Enroll, as Charly García's guitarist, and as a solo artist. Twenty years after her untimely death, Perfume access to 50 hours of footage she filmed herself?ranging from massive concerts to deeply intimate moments in recording studios and at home.

items.title: From the Dark
items.overview: Sardinia. A small village is shocked by the disappearance of a little girl and the suicide of Alice, a young woman found dead in the woods. There is a connection between the two cases, but no one knows yet. Sara, a successful writer and friend of the girl, decides to return to her childhood places to find out what happened. She will thus be forced to confront the demons of a forgotten past.

items.title: Living Book
items.overview: After losing his father, Roma lost his faith in goodness and became brash and rebellious. Together with a timid elementary school student, Vitya, they sneak into the house of a mysterious old man, where they find magical books with animated characters. Through carelessness, the boys unleash an evil sorcerer. To save his friend and restore everything to its rightful place, Roma must do the impossible: believe in himself again.

Follow a group of eight explorers and two leaders who reach a mountain refuge in the Pyrenees, only to be cut off by a snowstorm. When they take a headcount, they discover an extra child that no one remembers.

items.title: We Chose to Go to the Moon
items.overview: The dramatic tale of America's race to space and the decision to land a man on the Moon in one of the most ambitious scientific and exploration achievements in history.

items.title: The Harvester
items.overview: Álava, late 19th century. As the Third Carlist War rages, several women are found strangled to death on the outskirts of Vitoria.

items.title: Kabayan
items.overview: After losing his job, a young Filipino meets a fellow migrant at a bus stop and pursues a chance at belonging.

items.title: A COLD SEASON
items.overview: A lonely man's quiet winter routine hides a string of killings that spiral out of control when his dark double urges him toward madness.

items.title: Once Again: The Start of it All
items.overview: In the year 2509, Dr. Obi Iheuche, a brilliant scientist and devoted father, is racing against time to save his terminally ill daughter. As Obi secretly develops a device capable of altering time itself, his work draws the attention of the institution for which he works. This film is an Afro-futurist meditation on fatherhood, memory, and the cost of love under unforgiving systems.

items.title: Idling
items.overview: When Frank’s car breaks down in a bleak winter landscape, a mechanic named Barry comes to his aid. Hoping to repair the car, the two men take it into a labyrinthine underground parking garage governed by strange rules, where other unfortunate souls seem trapped.

items.title: Atop Babel's Tower
items.overview: One night, Pérez, a small insomniac rat, wakes up feeling uncomfortable. To find out what's disturbing his sleep, he must descend a towering mattress tower where his commune is sleeping peacefully, unaware of his nocturnal descent.

items.title: Littermates
items.overview: Amidst the chaos of a mysterious war, two victims of an attack take refuge at a cottage in the English countryside, where an enigmatic caretaker insists they cannot leave.

items.title: Reflected
items.overview: A man wakes up and slowly discovers he is trapped in a mirror world.

items.title: May Day x 4
items.overview: Drawing on archival footage from four separate film productions that documented the protests of early May, 1970, this short film creates a kaleidoscopic portrait of the response to the New Haven Black Panther trials.

items.title: A Royal Christmas Switch
items.overview: When Prince Alexander of Belvaria crosses paths with Ethan, a small-town man who looks like his twin, they decide to swap places for the Christmas season so Alexander can finally experience a normal holiday.

items.title: Illuminations
items.overview: A contemplative portrait of experimental filmmakers Nathaniel Dorsky and Jerome Hiler, and their shared devotion to the art of seeing that has shaped their work, their love, and more than fifty years of life together.

items.title: CRCL9
items.overview: An American woman studying in Europe who has been targeted by an online stalking game. As the situation becomes increasingly dangerous, she starts playing the game herself in an attempt to outwit her stalker.

items.title: Cecilia,  una luz de mañana
items.overview: Following her tragic death at just 27, Cecilia left behind a legacy of songs that today, 50 years later, continue to soar through our collective pop consciousness. Her boldness, her talent, and her legacy have inspired many of the female singers who came after her. This is her story.

items.title: Wilder
items.overview: Reeling from the trauma of an abusive husband and father of her son, a mother has fearfully locked away and hidden any sense of it in the basement from her young son. Inevitably, when the boy suddenly discovers it, his juvenile and unguided spirit is tempted to set it free.

items.title: Two Cigarettes, Three Nights
items.overview: Kanna is an illustrator living in Kyoto. Three nights with Haseo, a "guy friend" she reunites with after seven years, change the course of her life.

items.title: Lorie Party 2026 au cinéma
items.overview: Lorie invites you to a colorful and festive evening! Hear all her greatest hits during her Lorie Party 2025/2026 tour!

items.title: Small Spaces
items.overview: When an eccentric stranger promises to cure his claustrophobia, a sceptical man agrees to her treatment, only to discover that escaping his fear may cost him far more than living with it.

items.title: Angelina
items.overview: Angelina is a spirited college girl who gives a charming local lad six months to win her over. Then she is found critically injured, the police have 24 hours to find out who did it, and everyone she trusts becomes a suspect.

items.title: Non-Migrants
items.overview: In a small Bulgarian town a young man faces a crisis when his girlfriend plans to emigrate abroad. Angered, he breaks into the abandoned local factory and starts working without any specific purpose, ideology, or political agenda. But this unusual form of “protest” attracts media attention and may unexpectedly restore lost faith and friendships.

items.title: GW:s mord – Styckmordet i Karlskrona
items.overview: A man is reported missing in Karlskrona. Suspicion falls on his son and the son’s boyfriend. Leif GW Persson examines the case.

items.title: The One
items.overview: Hawk, a Native American ex-foster youth, who visits Enid, Oklahoma for the tallest Christmas tree lighting. He bonds with locals and runaway teen Alexis while dealing with PTSD, anxiety, and self-discovery concerning his faith.

items.title: Solo Vivo
items.overview: A profound narrative about the history, resistance, and social impact of the Ecological Farmers Market (FAE) of Porto Alegre, RS. A sensitive look at the dignity of rural work, resilience in the face of climate extremes, and the strength of a community united by respect for the land to nurture human relationships and promote health through healthy eating.

items.title: The Patient
items.overview: An amnesiac hospital patient is issued a life he doesn't remember. But soon he comes to suspect that he’s being manipulated in order to protect a powerful politician implicated in a murder.

items.title: Ada
items.overview: Two sisters on a forgotten island, surrounded by a sea full of rubbish. They are waiting for Darko, the island's keeper: he brings food and is their last link to the world. Silence is their survival strategy. But on an island without rules, silence too comes at a price.

items.title: Annapurna: Dreams and Nightmares
items.overview: Annapurna: Dreams and Nightmares is a 2026 documentary film by Thin Air Cinematics that challenges the traditional "man-conquers-mountain" story by exploring high-altitude mountaineering through failure, fear and human obsession  Filmed over 13 years, spanning 6 expeditions on 5 different climbing routes, this deeply personal documentary is an unflinching exploration into the life and mind of a high-altitude climber.  What begins with a dream becomes obsession, and ultimately a reckoning with why we climb in the first place.

items.title: The Diego Nobody Saw
items.overview: An intimate documentary about Diego Armando Maradona, told from a unique perspective: through the eyes of someone who quietly stood by his side, capturing moments the world had never seen. Through exclusive photos and private videos, the film reveals Diego beyond the stadium and the myth, showing his most human side. For years, Jorge Luengo witnessed defining and everyday moments of Maradona?s life.

items.title: Once Upon a Time in Jersey
items.overview: A journey through the 1960s, 70s, & 80s New Jersey - reflecting on a magical time of the Old Americana we once knew. Featuring Tom Cruise, Bill Maher and Dana Bash from CNN, with a special appearance by Oscar-Nominated actor Danny Aiello.

items.title: Tumšā robeža
items.overview: A historical thriller about Latvia in 1938 - not long before the Russian occupation.

items.title: The Excrement
items.overview: This Documentary follows Detective Jessip as he hunts down Victor Valentine and his poop monster - "THE FILTH BORN"

items.title: Horoomon
items.overview: One woman. One racist lie. One lawsuit that shook Japan. Korean Japanese entrepreneur Shin Sugok takes on major media in this electro-shock legal thriller about refusing to be silenced.

items.title: Bloody Men
items.overview: In 1980s Sweden, we follow a boy’s love for a mother who tries her best, all the bloody men who come and go, and about not becoming one yourself.

items.title: Hard as Puck
items.overview: A motley crew of para ice hockey skaters fight to keep their grassroots sporting club on the rink in this stirring, often hilarious documentary.

items.title: The making of Vincent - Dreams, Monsters & Independent Film
items.overview: Go behind the scenes of Vincent, the multi award-winning supernatural dark fantasy, and discover the creative vision, artistic collaboration and challenges of bringing an independent film about friendship, loneliness and monsters to life.

items.title: Lakadbaggha 2: The Monkey Business
items.overview: Sequel to Lakadbaggha (2023). Plot TBA.

items.title: Codes
items.overview: Following a major attack on British soil, a politician discovers the only way of saving his country is by killing the man in front of him.

items.title: The Perfect
items.overview: High-achieving teenager Pärli feels like a mountain range: cold below the knees and hot in her hands. She compares parts of her body to different seasons and playfully envies a dancing grasshopper's movements. If not a ballerina, she imagines being a violinist or lion tamer. Aspiring Black Swan Maarja took up ballet at her parents' urging, though she preferred hip-hop. Ballet lecturer and horse rider Irina teaches students to appreciate the technically perfect ballet body, yet struggles to find joy and tends to censor everything, even as she resists strict control. All three strive for perfection in life and on the dance floor. Ballet offers escape into a magical world but demands patience. Dancers repeat exercises and rehearse for hours, seeking precision despite pain, fatigue or waning motivation. Each movement takes time to master, perhaps only to satisfy a mother's high expectations.

items.title: Three Millimeters to You
items.overview: Tatsuhiko, a quiet high school student in the coastal city of Karatsu, spends his days fishing and drifting through adolescence. Just before summer vacation, Yoon-seul, an exchange student from Busan, joins his class. As they grow closer, Tatsuhiko gradually discovers the heartfelt reason she chose this small Japanese town. However, an innocent remark unexpectedly hurts Yoon-seul, and she abruptly returns to Korea. Unable to let go of his regret, Tatsuhiko makes a life-changing decision—to cross the sea in search of the girl he never truly had the chance to understand.

items.title: Aussie at Heart
items.overview: Samara, a former lawyer now event planner, reunites with Nate, her ex‑coworker and rival, to plan a couple's anniversary in Queensland and begin to confront their past and fall for each other.

items.title: Boa vs. Sports School
items.overview: AIGC Movie At an illegal snake liquor distillery in the black market, workers rip out snakes' gallbladders while they are still alive, unleashing a terrifying wave of vengeance. A gigantic, mutated two-headed serpent bursts out of its tank and goes on a bloody rampage, slaughtering corrupt elites before storming a nearby sports school! The stands become a living nightmare, and the sports field turns into a hunting ground

items.title: The Agonist
items.overview: Sebastián was born with spasticity. Living with that discomfort, he films his life: his loves, friends, children and family. But as the years go by, the pain in his body becomes too much to bear, and the idea of risky brain surgery that could change him forever takes hold. Is that what he really wants? Is he ready to become someone else?

items.title: Christmas at the Zoo
items.overview: An entrepreneur brokering a sponsorship to build the city zoo's new penguin habitat finds herself caught between business and romance after falling for a compassionate zookeeper over the holidays.

items.title: While She Was Sleeping
items.overview: After waking from a sleepwalking episode to find her best friend murdered and a bloody knife in her hand, a small-town writer must prove her innocence despite having no memory of the night.

items.title: I'm not crazy. Maybe a little...
items.overview: A desperate middle-aged alcoholic and a heartbroken young woman escape from a psychiatric hospital and embark on an absurd journey through the nighttime streets of Riga to save a cat and, perhaps, themselves as well.

items.title: Latir
items.overview: Chile, 2022. During the constitutional plebiscite in Chile, Manuel, a retired university professor, takes part in a body percussion workshop that profoundly transforms his life and helps him cope with his wife’s terminal illness.

items.title: Love & Sex on Streaming
items.overview: Having stumbled upon a crazy sex video featuring his girlfriend and her ex-boyfriend, and his perception of sex and love overturned by a sexy camgirl, a young man found himself in the world of live streaming.

items.title: Cervantes Follies: A Documentary
items.overview: Through interviews with its creators, footage of rehearsals, and scenes from performances in the main auditorium of the Teatro Nacional Cervantes, the film chronicles the development of a show that pays tribute to a century-old Argentine musical tradition: La Revista.

items.title: Fruitcakes: Dawn of Drag
items.overview: Jolanda, a retired archivist, has spent most of his life in the closet. In the late 1970s, he stood on stage alongside his friend Mummo in Finland's first drag show, 'Happy Gays'; the performance was even broadcast on television, and Mummo became one of the first openly gay men in Finland. Then came AIDS, fear and violence. In April 1988, Mummo was murdered in his home; the police were unwilling to solve the case and the entire crime was hushed up. Now, more than thirty years later, Jolanda is opening up his own archive and inviting a new generation of drag artists to bring 'Happy Gays' back to the stage.

items.title: Pegasus
items.overview: A DJ drifts through the spectacle of Miami nightlife, torn between the urge to create and the desire to be seen.

items.title: See You Tomorrow Tomorrow Tomorrow
items.overview: An aspiring, queer stand-up comedian grapples with her career and the greater duty of caring for her 99-year-old grandmother in her final years.

items.title: Sandal Jepit No. 10
items.overview: Akbar, a seemingly ordinary man, is taken into custody and interrogated regarding a serial murder case. From inside the room, he piece by piece reveals the timeline, underlying motives, and complex criminal plot through voice and narration alone.

items.title: American Baby
items.overview: A Filipino immigrant and her charismatic American husband, a casket salesman, share a life shaped by sacrifice and silence, as their child revisits the fragile promise of the American Dream inside the quiet fractures of their marriage.

items.title: Our Revolution
items.overview: He is exuberant, loud, and charismatic. She is courageous, delicate, and warm. Jacek and Grażyna Kuroń are utterly in love and convinced that together they can change the world. They give up their privacy to dedicate their lives to the fight for freedom. Their apartment becomes the "headquarters" of the opposition; a meeting place for people willing to risk everything in the name of a better tomorrow.

items.title: The Road Back to Us
items.overview: After finalizing their divorce, a couple must drive cross-country together to deliver their daughter's belongings to college - an emotional road trip that retraces the milestones of their marriage in reverse.

items.title: Boyzone: One for the Road
items.overview: Against the backdrop of decades of personal history and the pressure of thousands of expectant fans, the band return carrying unresolved tensions and unfinished business from their final tour in 2019. This time, they want to go out on their own terms and have the send-off that they – and the fans – so badly want.

items.title: Forever Mom
items.overview: Leonora is an overwhelmed mother of two young girls and an architect whose career has been put on hold. While her husband works all day, she carries the weight of raising their children and the quiet feeling that she has lost herself somewhere along the way. One afternoon, in the middle of her daughter?s birthday party, she drives away, leaving behind the noise and contradictions of motherhood.

items.title: Gravy
items.overview: Shust and his friends commit small-time scams for a living, taking advantage of any opportunity that comes their way. Meeting Ulyanov, the former Soviet Union shot put champion, and his daughter opens Shust's eyes to a completely different way of living. But under his gang's pressure, he uses Ulyanov to plan a heist on a Buryat jade-trading commune.

items.title: Weekend Warrior
items.overview: Tess goes to a Larp and transforms herself into the Elf General Tauriel. When her foot soldier is wounded in a fight with orcs she heals him with a magic balm, which gives the weekend war games an unexpected erotic turn.

items.title: Don't Forget the Sunshine
items.overview: After six years in Germany, Maria gradually loses touch with who she is, trapped between the routine of her work and the intensity of her nights in the techno scene. When her ailing mother and older brother come to visit from Greece for the first time, old wounds reopen and long-suppressed conflicts rise to the surface. Caught between her life in the Ruhr region and her ties to Thessaloniki, Maria is forced to confront her family’s past and search for her own identity.

items.title: Scorcher
items.overview: Elaine, a young crowd canvasser, struggles to raise money for women’s reproductive healthcare on the hottest day of the summer. She’s on the brink of being fired and showing signs of heat exhaustion when a coworker approaches her about starting a canvassing union.

items.title: Blind Game
items.overview: A suspended police officer tracks down a missing fortune and a dangerous secret.

items.title: One Night in June
items.overview: One Night In June is a dark drama that introduces Lydia and John, as they face a crossroads in their relationship. Through lies, betrayal and vengeful rage they both commit acts they cannot un-do. John is left with an ultimatum that will change his and Lydia's life forever. This gripping short film confronts the nature of the human experience. Our mistakes, our choices, how they impact the ones we love, and the extreme consequences we face.

items.title: Life 2.0
items.overview: An operative navigates deep-space isolation, with only an AI hologram for company, until an enigmatic new companion arrives. An accident uncovers the truth about their origins, forcing a fight for survival against motives engineered back on Earth.

items.title: ee
items.overview: When a young girl attempts to shoplift an old blind box figure from a collectibles store, the shopkeeper’s seductive wife takes an interest in her.

items.title: Wrapped in Christmas Memories
items.overview: Seeking a buyer for her family’s antique store this Christmas, tech guru Delphia butts heads with history buff Keenan, who wants to buy it. But when she discovers a mystery in the store’s famous Christmas Dollhouse, he’s the only one who can help her solve it.

items.title: A Chardonnay for Love
items.overview: When small-town writer Samantha Lane lands a career-making assignment to profile Maple Creek's local winemaker and most eligible bachelor, William Crew, her dream of moving to New York is tested by a deeper story.

items.title: School Girls; Or, The African Mean Girls Play
items.overview: Becoming Miss Ghana 1986 would mean fame, fortune, and prosperity. At least, that’s what Paulina—the queen bee of Aburi Girls Boarding School—believes. When the pageant recruiter comes to school, Paulina and her crew pull out all the stops. But to their surprise, a new transfer student from America kicks the competition into a higher, far more personal gear.

items.title: Meet-Cute
items.overview: Jaded by endless dates, two anxious misfits decide to reveal everything – pet peeves, red flags and sexual dealbreakers – in a brutally honest encounter that might just become something more.

items.title: KICK
items.overview: American runner Nikki Hiltz is on the brink of triumph, steps away from achieving the ultimate goal of representing the US in the Olympic Games. As Nikki approaches this career milestone, they reconcile their identity as a trans nonbinary athlete in a fraught political atmosphere.

items.title: The Black Pearl
items.overview: A young engineer's dream of becoming a fighter pilot for the Royal Moroccan Air Force is put on hold until he unravels the mystery of his missing parents.

items.title: Wayward: How Women Changed Snowboarding
items.overview: Wayward is a feature documentary about the women who changed snowboarding by refusing to follow the status quo. Spanning 4 decades of progression, the film weaves together rare archival footage and firsthand accounts from pioneering athletes who fought for visibility, opportunity, and respect in a male-dominated industry. As the sport has evolved and new generations push boundaries further than ever before, Wayward examines what it took to get here, and what still lies ahead. This is a story of resilience, rebellion, and the power of those who shaped a sport & a culture into what it is today.

items.title: Rambut Sewu: Satu Langkah Getih
items.overview: Wulan moves to a village with her mother, Ratih. After working at a tea factory, they move into an old house owned by the company. From then on, Wulan begins to experience strange dreams and mysterious events, eventually losing control of herself. The villagers attribute these disturbances to Marni, a former resident of the house whose story has remained a mystery for decades. When Wulan’s story spreads on social media, Damar, a reporter and native son of the village, arrives to investigate. Suradi, who is aware of the powers of the past, comes to help. Together, they try to sever Wulan’s connection to Marni and the power of Dhandhang Gendhing.

items.title: The Stationary Traveler
items.overview: Two filmmakers propose to Cristián Sánchez, a cult Chilean director, to make a film. The condition is that he resurrects the characters of his classic works, but in the form of zombies. He fights to protect his artistic principles but ends up trapped in his own film.

items.title: Rusty Horse
items.overview: Obsessed with understanding his Vietnamese girlfriend's final words before her suicide, a grieving young man seeks help from a therapist who speaks her language. Only to break down, as does meaning in the face of grief.

items.title: Henry's Ebb
items.overview: Henry runs away from an abusive home with his imaginary best friend, Ebb. The journey tests their friendship, as well as Henry’s inner 'need' for Ebb as Ebb’s control and manipulation over Henry intensifies.

items.title: The Easy Way Out
items.overview: Ted returns to his hometown to find his big brother Jim at the end of his rope. But is it too late to save him?

items.title: The Big Ashtray
items.overview: In a closed room, a man who may be guilty of something terrible prepares for the arrival of an unknown figure who brings eternal rapture.

items.title: Chocolate for Christmas
items.overview: When a woman returns home to save her family’s beloved chocolate shop, she finds unexpected love and a renewed appreciation for what matters most. This sweet holiday romance celebrates family, community and the lasting power of tradition.
stream: UP Faith & Family Apple TV channel

items.title: Bye Bye
items.overview: Henry decided to end his life by hanging himself. He planned everything carefully, but miscalculated one thing: when he sat down to write his suicide note, he suddenly discovered that his pen had run out of ink.

items.title: Celeste & the Cyan Sun
items.overview: On her last day in Italy, a young woman finds herself swept away by a new intimate friendship towards reckless abandon and tragic circumstances.

items.title: Red Ink
items.overview: In post-WWII New York, media propaganda, institutional power, and exploitation are interrogated amid the looming threat of a mysterious global virus.

items.title: Almost Cupid
items.overview: To get his wings, a newly hired cupid must choose between doing the job and honouring free will after being assigned to save a toxic relationship that shouldn't exist.

items.title: Au nord des hommes
items.overview: A group of journalists ventures deep into the Québec wilderness to investigate a camp offering a mysterious retreat for men. Behind the seductive rhetoric and apparent camaraderie lies a full-fledged radical cell: they might have walked straight into a very dangerous engine.

items.title: Sumpa Kingdom
items.overview: Raised in inland China, the protagonist Yangqing Lamu meets Baima, a young local guide, during an accidental trip to the plateau. The two travel deep into pastoral grasslands, embarking on a spiritual exploration of marriage, life and death, and morality amid the conflicts between dreams and reality, tradition and individuality. In the end, she achieves a profound reconciliation with both her homeland and her inner self in the vast wilderness.

items.title: DOUEN
items.overview: Sania, a first-generation Trinidadian American, is haunted by mischievous Douens and must confront the dark secrets and generational trauma buried within her family before the past claims her future.

items.title: Jean Gabin - La guerre, c'est pas du cinéma
items.overview: From Hollywood and Marlene Dietrich to the battles of the 2nd Armored Division, the seldom-known tale of monumental French actor Jean Gabin during the war.

items.title: Peter
items.overview: A trans man caring for his father with alcohol-induced dementia finds unexpected reconnection when the disease grants him temporary anonymity.

items.title: David Walliams: Power and Silence
items.overview: A three-year joint investigation by ITV News and the Guardian reveals allegations dating back to 2003 that David Walliams preyed on teenage girls and young women for sexual purposes.

items.title: A Proper Christmas
items.overview: When her beloved British grandmother Iris arrives just in time for Christmas, Nora, a warm-hearted small-town schoolteacher and devoted single mom, finds her carefully ordered life beginning to shift in ways she never anticipated. Settling into their cozy coastal Southern town, Iris brings with her six generations of family Christmas ornaments, an arsenal of proper British recipes, and an unmistakable talent for gentle meddling.

items.title: Gentle by Birth
items.overview: After her 23-year-old brother dies of an overdose, filmmaker Doree Simon Hatfield investigates the stigma she believes blocked his access to treatment and support. Her search takes her from her family’s living room to harm reduction sites, music festivals, and the halls of the Pennsylvania Capitol, where she meets experts working to change how addiction is understood and treated. But as her own fear and stigma around drugs begin to dissolve, Doree makes a radical choice to try them herself—transforming the film from a dissection of her brother’s addiction into a provocative reckoning that threatens her family’s fragile healing.

items.title: Kings of the Beach
items.overview: A documentary about the epic rise (and subsequent fall) of beach volleyball, featuring many of the boldfaced names from Southern California who helped popularize it.

items.title: Tummy Tom 3: Look Who's Visiting Tummy Tom!
items.overview: When a storm blows down the Squirrels’ tree, Tummy Tom invites them to stay with him, but sharing a home with new friends proves more challenging than he expected.

items.title: Black Cab
items.overview: Harry, a third-generation cab driver in London, struggles to find his place and purpose in a fast-changing world.

items.title: Shapes and Sizes
items.overview: On the same day she performed as the before picture for a weight-loss app, a young woman auditions for a high-profile body positivity campaign. As the casting process grows increasingly questionable, the language of empowerment begins to feel quite similar to the shaming it claims to oppose.

items.title: AKIAK
items.overview: A young indigenous woman in 1860's Alaska crosses paths with an injured bandit, who is being hunted by someone from the woman's past.

items.title: Crystal Apple: Unforeseen Consequences
items.overview: Psychic spies/jazz fusion artists Angelica Apple and Crystal Floredeliza go undercover as escorts to investigate the sale of alien technology.

items.title: Steadfast Woman
items.overview: This film centers on the ups and downs of an ordinary woman, Chunxia, chronicling her journey of growth — swept along by fate and healing herself amid suffering.

items.title: As Long As It Snows
items.overview: As a child, Margo witnesses her best friend vanish into a snowstorm, marking her for life. Twenty years later, now a teacher, one of her students vanishes under similar circumstances. During the search, she meets a man who bears an unsettling resemblance to her childhood friend.

items.title: Kyiv. Day-Night
items.overview: The beloved main cast of the cult classic TV series Kyiv. Day and Night decide to take a road trip, reopening the doors to the memories of the past.

items.title: I Love You Ex
