items.overview: Helena, a successful CEO, falls in love with the younger Eros, and their relationship leads to an engagement. Everything changes when Eros' father, Ariel, Helena's forbidden love from the past, returns. Helena must choose between her present love and her one true love.

items.title: The Romantics
items.overview: Liam returns to his hometown of Liverpool to reconnect with the memory of his long-missing sister, but an encounter with an old friend forces him to confront the grief he’s kept buried.

items.title: The Awakening
items.overview: Jason and Rebecca uncover a conspiracy to control the world. Their investigation leads them into a maze of secrets and dangers, making their quest to expose the truth a race against time.

items.title: Change of Heart
items.overview: Maia lives with her grandmother, Nora, on the family’s conventional cattle farm, which she will be taking over. After a devastating storm, Maia’s livelihood is questioned by her eco-minded neighbors and an anxiety is ignited in her, as she starts to grasp the disturbing scale of climate change. Maia must navigate between acting against the dire future of the planet and staying true to her heritage. Maia Against the World is a heartfelt and humorous drama about generational divides, eco-anxiety and cows.

items.title: Macumbaria
items.overview: The mystical element plays an unusual role in the civilizing process of Brazilian society. Realms such as samba, malandragem, soccer, and Carnival reflect this process, which unfolded in the shadow of the Precarious. On the street, in the terreiro, at the bar, in the favela, at the crossroads, or on the floodplain—a multifaceted historical and cultural identity was forged, resulting from the intersection of Amerindian and African spiritualities and European popular Catholicism. Macumbaria explores the phenomenon of the “macumba complex” through the lens of historian Luiz Antonio Simas, the film’s narrator.

items.title: When Angels Fall
items.overview: Inspired by true events, WHEN ANGELS FALL tells the story of a young and talented actress that becomes the 'Darling of Tinseltown' to only become discarded and cast-out. While at her lowest point, a divine encounter with someone not of this world helps her begin to see herself for who she truly is.

items.title: Death Knight
items.overview: Through dark magic, a medieval knight awakens in the 21st century, leaving a path of destruction.

items.title: The Sound of Malan Flowers Blooming
items.overview: Adapted from a true story of the Beijing Winter Olympics, the film tells the touching story of the Malanhua Children’s Choir. With the help of An Ran, the performance management supervisor for the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, the Winter Olympics team, and Principal Liu from the mountain village primary school, the children overcame numerous hardships to leave their mountain home and step onto the stage of the Beijing Winter Olympics Opening and Closing Ceremonies, singing *Ode to the Olympic* in Greek. Meanwhile, the film reveals more little-known warm and inspiring stories behind the Opening and Closing Ceremonies of the Beijing Winter Olympics and Paralympics, presenting a multi-faceted portrait of the Beijing Winter Olympics Spirit and the Olympic Spirit.

items.title: The Fight to Fight
items.overview: Arriving amid renewed challenges surrounding women’s service in ground combat, there are women who have stood their ground to serve in America’s military and the impact on society at large. Featuring the voices of numerous celebrated female veterans, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth ordered a Pentagon review in early 2026 to scrutinize women’s service in ground combat.

items.title: Bigg Homies
items.overview: The whole hood respects Rodeen. His momma just wants him to get a job. Bigg Jah stars as the neighborhood's "Bigg Homie"—a man with plenty of street cred but no business giving life advice. When money meant to save his family's home gets stolen, Rodeen sets out to get it back.

items.title: Advisor 101
items.overview: Short film companion to 4EVE's music video ที่ปรึกษา

items.title: The Lament of Spice Island
items.overview: Two lifelong friends travel to Spice Island for a carefree summer, only to find that something between them is beginning to change.

items.title: The Acres
items.overview: Christine enters The Acres estate with gardening tools and a plan, but then she encounters Ama, a lonely new mother. Ama reminds Christine of the early days of motherhood, a simpler time before things took a turn.

items.title: Molder Man
items.overview: Thrown into a shapeless prison, the Molder Man must face the music.

items.title: Beyond
items.overview: Follows people living with and beyond cancer as they discover strength, connection, and a new sense of possibility through climbing. Set between indoor walls and wild mountain rock, it is a powerful story about recovery becoming adventure.

items.title: Let This Stay Between Us
items.overview: After becoming involved with his student, a university professor is torn between desire and professional ethics. Determined to safeguard their secret relationship, he puts his personal and professional stability on the line.

items.title: We Used to Be Fun
items.overview: Jonas turns thirty and brings his closest friends to a remote cabin in the woods. Martin and Heather, who have always been the group’s mum and dad, arrive hiding a secret. They’ve just broken up.

items.title: Die Prinzessin aus Glas
items.overview: Hans is the son of a glassmaker – and deaf. Where his daredevil brother failed, he sets out to free Princess Anna, whom a powerful duke holds captive in a glass cage.

items.title: Teen Spirits
items.overview: In a deserted high school, a group of teenagers gathers for a mysterious choral ritual.

items.title: Delivery Girl
items.overview: Yao's boyfriend (29) is murdered while she's delivering an order for her Chinese restaurant. Now alone, she has to run the restaurant while dealing with the indifference of the police, the municipality, the entire city, and the deceased's parents, who want to take over the business. While coping with grief and the mystery surrounding the crime, Yao also experiences a newfound freedom that leads her to seek a less solitary and more exciting life, trying to become increasingly involved with this new world she still has to discover.

items.title: Monero
items.overview: A story based on true events and dedicated to the Mexican cartoonist RIUS.  In 1968 Mexico City, Mancha—a cartoonist for the magazine "La Garrapata"—battles government censorship of his work under Gustavo Díaz Ordaz, while one of his own cartoon characters manifests in the real world, urging him to be brave and fight for what he believes in.

items.title: Irreparable
items.overview: Alice has something to tell her sister Olivia; Olivia is buying some very sharp knives – she has a few things to take care of at home. They soon start talking about love and Olivia's husband (or perhaps ex-husband), Garcia. One of them needs to put on the brakes before they do something irreparable.

items.title: Sanctuary
items.overview: In a post-apocalyptic Earth, the discovery of a cryogenically suspended woman provokes fear in a desperate village, sending a young warrior and the mysterious woman on a quest for a lost city and answers that could restore humanity.

items.title: Лето в Бадене
items.overview: A Soviet intellectual is engaged in science and medicine, writing for himself. His only son decides to leave the country forever, breaking his heart and ruining his career and social standing. Having lost everything, he decides to write a novel about Dostoevsky, the subject he's been dreaming about his whole life. Like his beloved writer, he must lose completely in order to be reborn.

items.title: JJ: Every Inch a King
items.overview: Jüri Järvet didn't believe in talent. When praised, he would reply that if people knew how hard he worked, they would stop calling it talent. He went to drama school because of a girl. He could never learn his lines sitting down. He went to the screen test for Grigori Kozintsev's "King Lear" almost as a joke. Lear, and later Snaut in Andrei Tarkovsky's "Solaris", made him one of the most internationally recognised Estonian actors. Yet he opened the sports pages before the arts section, made a mean stew, and turned up late to performances because of a game of chess. Thirty years after his death, Järvet speaks again. Drawn from unseen home movies, letters, interviews and memoirs, his own voice returns through AI. Jüri Järvet's story is told by Järvet himself.

items.title: Animals
items.overview: In the near future, animals enjoy civil rights; the apparent normalcy of three privileged couples is disrupted by the arrival of a quadruped that has become all too humanized—a sheep running for political office, a dog that can sniff out lies, and a jealous cat.

items.title: Valleys of the Earth
items.overview: Valleys of the Earth is a story of redemption set in a post-apocalyptic United States several years after an enormous solar plunges Humanity into a new Dark Age. From the ashes, a militarized cult known as "the Watchers" rises. Led by their prophets, the Watchers believe this apocalyptic event was brought on by their Angels, and that it is as a means of giving humanity a fresh start. Isaac, our protagonist, attempts to flee his past and right his wrongs. Along the way, his story becomes entwined with Kellen, a young woman fiercely dedicated to upholding a promise she once made. If the two are to survive, they must learn to trust one another; however, the Watchers are everywhere, and will stop at nothing to recover what they have lost.

items.title: HUELLAS. Echoes of State Terrorism in Mar del Plata 50 Years On
items.overview: Can the sea wash everything away? Huellas reconstructs the circuit of state terrorism in Mar del Plata, 50 years after the civic-military coup. Through the testimonies of survivors, family members and specialists, the documentary probes the indelible marks left by repression and the resilience of a community that demands memory. Because history never ends, it is written.

items.title: ANON
items.overview: A brief encounter between a closeted taxi driver and a young male passenger leads to a frightening exchange with life-altering consequences.

items.title: Wishing Well Road
items.overview: A vlogger vanishes after becoming embroiled in a local legend. Leaving only questions, and his camera behind.

items.title: The Ambersons
items.overview: In 1960s suburbia, Barney Amberson finds meaning through the ordinary rituals of family life with the department store mannequins he calls his own.

items.title: Royal Opera House: Carmen
items.overview: Carmen declares that any man she loves should beware. However, even she is unprepared for what will happen when she decides to seduce Don José, an army corporal who initially appears uninterested in her charms. Don José soon abandons his sweetheart Micaëla and his army job for Carmen, and joins her and her smuggler friends in the mountains. But Carmen quickly wearies of Don José's possessiveness. When she turns her attentions to the dashing toreador Escamillo, Don José's jealousy erupts into violence.

items.title: Married to the Filipino Mafia
items.overview: Meet the Filipino Mafia Family.  “Blood is thicker than water. We’re happy to spill yours.”  Marrying into this family? Good luck.

items.title: Living On
items.overview: Art therapy, para-archery and summiting peaks: life on the front line against an enemy five times larger.

items.title: A Christmas Destiny
items.overview: Five years after one unforgettable Christmas Eve together, Serena and Jarrod cross paths again, except now, they’ve both moved on, and neither one is single.

items.title: Fest Godzilla II: Tokyo Vanishing
items.overview: As Godzilla unleashes energy powerful enough to engulf and obliterate Tokyo with its heat ray, a new threat, Monster X, emerges. Amidst the fierce clash between these two titans, a Self-Defense Force officer undertakes a perilous, do-or-die mission!

items.title: Target: Captain Black!
items.overview: Once, he was their most trusted agent. Now, they hunt him.

items.title: Broken English Theater
items.overview: Broken English Theater is a documentary-style comedy that revisits the bizarre legacy of Gerardo Directori, a Buenos Aires theater director who, in the early 2000s, ran a company dedicated to staging "educational" plays in English for language students, despite not speaking the language himself.

items.title: Time's Up, I'm Afraid
items.overview: A hypnotherapist discovers she may be the one who has been hypnotised.

items.title: When The Sun Burns Out
items.overview: Julia finds comfort in her high school teacher after losing her cat. This event triggers obsessions and fantasies that unsettle her for the first time. As the line between dreams and reality blurs, Julia must accept her pain to begin healing.

items.title: Getting Rid of Grunt
items.overview: Two housemates have to work together to get rid of a one-night stand, who refuses to leave, and refuses to talk.

items.title: Halo
items.overview: Min-joon, 27, who bears the burden of his broken family, delivers packages every day, dreaming of being a film director. A soothsayer lights a flame within him. Daily repetition and slippage create unique rhythms.

items.title: In the Name of the Father
items.overview: Three estranged brothers reunite at a notary's office to settle their late father's estate. What begins as a routine procedure turns into an emotional battlefield, where the true inheritance is silence.

items.title: Chirac sous les Tropiques, petits arrangements avec la République
The Malthus Law
items.overview: In an attempt to address overpopulation, TV host Olivia is selected by an AI that compels people to defend their right to life, leading to conflicts over the value and malleability of life between her and the other selected individuals.

items.title: About the Soufflé
items.overview: When Connor is unexpectedly told he needs to find another place to stay, he's thrust into the streets of Darwin with no safety net. A chance encounter with a local band of creatives leads him on a journey of growth and self-discovery as he battles to overcome personal traumas. Set against the unique backdrop of Australia's Top End, this experimental independent feature is both an intimate character study and a heartfelt love letter to Darwin - the city that inspired the filmmakers who call it home.

items.title: Bradley Walsh's Million Pound Shot
items.overview: A brand-new quiz where contestants can win a million. But there's one huge secret twist in a night of drama, tension and life-changing outcomes. Would you take the shot?

items.title: Silver
items.overview: To help the girl he likes, a boy tries to sell his grandmother's silver necklace, only to be swindled by an evil dealer.

items.title: This House Has Roots
items.overview: A man tells the story of himself and the mansion home he lives in.

items.title: GW:s mord - Sturebymordet
items.overview: 15-year-old Therese walks into the woods after a party near the ski jump in Stureby and never returns. Leif GW Persson examines the case.

items.title: Williston
items.overview: A vaporwave psychological thriller about landmen traveling to North Dakota to obtain rights to undeveloped land, owned by a man who hates the oil industry.

items.title: Just How Things Are
items.overview: Clement just lost the love of his life. Failing to reconnect with his sister, Nelle,  he learns that he must take drastic measures to ensure the possibility of ever reclaiming the ideal life he once had.

items.title: Amazing Grace
items.overview: On the brink of suicide, a deeply isolated man forms an unexpected bond with a crisis helpline volunteer who helps him confront the childhood abuse, addiction, and shame he has spent a lifetime trying to survive.

items.title: Foreign Blood
items.overview: Dennis, a man in his late fifties, leads a quiet life in Zakynthos, running a bar with Vera, his Bulgarian partner, and her 20-year-old son, Alex, whom he regards as his own. One winter night, Alex takes a mysterious foreign girl on a ride and causes an accident. Dennis rushes her to hospital, only to discover she is his estranged daughter. As her condition worsens and Alex disappears, Dennis must confront his past and choose between protecting him and seeking justice.

items.title: A Royal Christmas Secret
items.overview: When chef Emily Parker takes a job at Verdonia's royal palace for Christmas, she begins a romance with the castle's handyman Nick. But she doesn't know he's really Prince Nicholas and that his parents already have a bride picked for him.

items.title: Fortunes
items.overview: Marta travels upstate to reunite with her sister, but a stranger joins her along the way.

items.title: Night Watchman
items.overview: James takes on the job of a night watchman, unknowingly replacing a man who died just one week prior.

items.title: Trambólika
items.overview: Trambólika is an intimate and colorful journey into the life of Chelo, a queer artist from La Mancha (Spain), whose techno beats and staging shatter all established norms in a unique revolution of art and identity. A Venezuelan migrant director discovers her and is captivated by the reflection of his own yearning for life. It is a story brimming with love, authenticity, and acceptance, free from the usual conflicts experienced by the LGBTQI+ community in rural areas.

items.title: Résonance
items.overview: Lily, a young actress, loses her grip on reality when she discovers that her neighbor looks exactly like her—feature for feature.

items.title: El Equilibrio del Reloj
items.overview: Zoe is fired from her job for being constantly late. Then, a secret society of people whose sole purpose is to be late kidnaps her and offers her membership. Zoe initially resists, but later agrees to a mission to prevent a war, which convinces her to join them.

items.title: ReLive
items.overview: A freak temporal anomaly erases her son from existence, a grieving mother is recruited for an impossible mission: travel back twenty years in her own timeline to a college hiking trip to kill the inventor of time travel to save her son.

items.title: Prudence and the Wandering Eye
items.overview: In a strange, purgatory-like room where workers exchange small bundles for coins, Prudence notices an elderly blind woman waiting in line. She offers to help, but her seemingly good deed soon takes an unexpected turn.

items.title: Child of Sinaï
items.overview: In the Sinai desert, within sight of Sharm el-Sheikh's glittering resorts, nine-year-old Bedouin boy Jarah faces a very different future. His family sends him to camel herder Mohamed to train as a jockey for Zalaga, the region's most prestigious camel race. Victory promises honour for his family and freedom for the boy.

items.title: Behind The Passion
items.overview: A non-profit human rights organization in Argentina discovers what is happening to Nepalese workers in Qatar during the leadup to the 2022 FIFA World Cup.

items.title: El club de la seducción
items.overview: The film follows two men with opposing personalities whose lives unexpectedly cross paths. Driven by a debt, parties, romances, and impulsive decisions, they find themselves caught up in a series of chaotic situations that blend humor, action, and romance.

items.title: Mountain of Gold
items.overview: Gold fever has gripped northern Niger. In search of the precious metal, and despite the risks, an army of researchers has invaded the sites of interest. While camps are set up and dismantled as rumours of new leads spread, Moussa and his companions are banking on the Ikazan vein.

items.title: For the Family
items.overview: When a Slovenian-Australian teenager attends a community gathering, a secret she’s been hiding threatens her family’s place within their close-knit community, forcing her mother to choose between social acceptance and standing by her daughter.

items.title: Odium Zero
items.overview: 14 days ago, a comet ripped across the sky, unleashing the disaster now known as the Grayfall. Within hours, parasitic spores called Gray Matters transformed people into savage monsters known as Spikers, collapsing society overnight. Governments sealed off infected cities, buried the truth, and left the outbreak zones to rot. 16-year-old influencer Mai, refusing to believe the official story, breaks into Central Hospital—the outbreak’s ground zero—with her AI cobot, BooBoo. Inside, fear spreads faster than the infection as survivors turn on each other. After rescuing a little girl named Anna, Mai fights to escape a hospital overrun by Spikers. Her path collides with Ren Cade, a ruthless black-ops commander hunting her, while Dr. Theodore secretly pulls the strings from mission control. But Theodore has one more ace up his sleeve: Ares, a genetically engineered killing machine built for one job—and one job only: to take Mai down.

items.title: Summer Alone
items.overview: Gage, an orphan, documents her final moments in Adelaide, Australia, before she moves across the world to be with her long-distance partner. As her partner is busy with work, he asks her to make a film for him.

items.title: Todo lo que Nunca
items.overview: Before she goes to live abroad, Tali and Yayo reunite. That night will make them question if their lives are heading where they want them to.

items.title: Home
items.overview: Where does the Ukrainian road home begin and where does it end? The poetic journey follows a Ukrainian actress, Yelyzaveta, who emigrated to Lithuania, traveling back to her homeland country ravaged by war. Will we reach the final destination? How to reach home? Relatives? How to get back to the past which no longer exists? Can we wake up from the dream?

items.title: Synchronicity
items.overview: Two solitary walkers cross paths at night in a deserted city. As they draw closer, the city changes. Rhythm, synchrony, and direction come to the fore. The walkers and the city intertwine in a single movement.

items.title: Performance of the Year
items.overview: Olivia, a struggling actor, is forced into the biggest audition of her career with the last director she'd ever work for. Her whole life is turned upside down when she is pushed to her limits for this pretentious director's masterpiece.

items.title: My Tiny Little School
items.overview: With Ma toute petite école, Pascal Plisson follows, over the course of a year, the school life of the eight children living in the tiny hamlet of La Gurraz, in the Haute Tarentaise region. At the heart of this village of just 36 inhabitants, their school, threatened with closure, represents far more than a place of learning: it is the soul of an isolated community, where every birth and every pupil helps keep the village alive.

items.title: Astrodude: A SolarBalls Movie
items.overview: An older, future version of Astrodude's son travels back or intervenes to try and stop Astrodude from going missing on his next major space mission.

items.title: Weihnachten in Sommerby
items.overview: A dream come true for Martha, Mikkel, and Mats: they get to celebrate Christmas in Sommerby. They travel together to visit Grandma Inge, with their parents planning to join them shortly before Christmas. But then everything turns out differently than expected...

items.title: Sydney vs. Sean
items.overview: SYDNEY VS SEAN follows Sydney, a red-carpet host chasing perfection, and Sean, a bisexual nurse clinging to independence. A hookup grows into a passionate but volatile romance. After a year apart, the turbulent day of their divorce signing ricochets between past and present. When their eccentric notary arrives, he witnesses two lovers confront a bond that can’t be sustained, yet refuses to fade. Starring JANEL PARRISH (Pretty Little Liars, "To All The Boys" Trilogy) , T.R. KNIGHT (Grey's Anatomy, The Flight Attendant), RYAN POWERS (She-Hulk, The Mandalorian), and ARDEN MYRIN (Free Bert, The Righteous Gemstones)

items.title: Something That Sticks
items.overview: A conversation between Derrick Gloop and William Fletch about the worst masks known to humanity- the ones that don't cover your face.

items.title: Plan B
items.overview: When a hippie dealer and his pregnant, latina girlfriend find themselves transporting more than just mushrooms in the back of their car, they will either grow together or apart as new parents.

items.title: LYCEUM
items.overview: After the entire student body mysteriously drops out, a young and obedient maths teacher must survive an absurd training session to land the first job he so desperately needs.

items.title: The Ungrieved
items.overview: Seven years after his son's disappearance, a father returns to his mother's house, where the tragedy unfolded. As he confronts her fading mind, he questions his own memories as his family must face the truth and trauma that haunts them all

items.title: Maut
items.overview: Defying his father's wish to pass on the family reindeer-herding business, a young Evenk decides to leave for the city to work—a choice that becomes a personal tragedy for the herder.

items.title: Harvested 4
items.overview: A small town legend returns from the dead to serve vengeance on Thanksgiving night.

items.title: Stellar Romance
items.overview: Their first meeting transforms an extraordinary space expedition into an unforgettable love story. As they explore strange planets, witness the birth of stars, and uncover secrets hidden within the fabric of time, their love begins to challenge the laws of the universe itself.  But their relationship faces an impossible choice: save the woman he loves, preserve the future of an entire civilization, or risk changing the destiny of the cosmos forever.  Can love survive across galaxies, dimensions, and time itself?  Somewhere among the stars, two souls may discover that love is the most powerful force in the universe.

items.title: Rushes of a Killer
items.overview: Footage found in Amsterdam reveals the horrific events that took place behind the scenes of a sinister film project. The recordings show the disturbing creative process of an obsessive filmmaker in pursuit of absolute control.

items.title: Cornfield
items.overview: A creative child with a passion for drawing escapes the confines of a rigid school system through her imagination, where epic battle between mice and a hawk mirrors her fight for self-expression - changing both her world and her teacher's.

items.title: Gece Köpekleri
items.overview: A minor mistake made during a small-scale robbery attempted by three friends causes the entire night to spiral into a complicated and inescapable mess.

items.title: Lola and the Lollipop Lady
items.overview: When the lollipop lady at Green Orchard Primary school disappears, Grade 6 student Lola makes it her mission to find out where she went...

items.title: I Already had a Family
items.overview: A girl revisits her family and complications arise.

items.title: Tides Eye
items.overview: In a world of endless seas the pirate Scarlett of the Siren Blades and Guardian monk-warrior Adrien are sworn enemies racing to claim the Tides Eye, a legendary relic that control the ocean currents. Captured by the ruthless Tideholders and chained together aboard an enemy ship, the rivals are forced into an uneasy alliance to survive and continue their hunt for the ultimate power.

items.title: Tua Tua Keladi
items.overview: The quiet lives of elderly residents in a small fishing village are turned upside down when the Health Department announces that exposure to the chemical P172 triggers a dramatic surge in libido. Amid the panic and awkwardness, the villagers must navigate their suddenly chaotic relationships, reawakened by newfound passion.

items.title: Three Years Gone
items.overview: Maria and her father, David, search for an exorcism to rid him of the demons he believes followed him back from the war. David, haunted by his past, kidnaps Maria from her mother, Veronica, who faces her inner battles.

items.title: Jeepers Capers
items.overview: A musical caper about a grocery store clerk named Jules and the stolen jewels in a jar of capers that might be his ticket to Hollywood. Set in a reimagining of the 1930s that only ever existed in cinema and dreams.

items.title: 5D
items.overview: A grieving woman reflects on the toxic relationship she had with her recently deceased boyfriend.

items.title: The Taste of Democracy
items.overview: Worldwide, 545 restaurants currently hold two Michelin stars. Earning two stars is a rare achievement. Closing such a restaurant to start again takes courage. In 2018, Onyx in Budapest became the first restaurant in Central and Eastern Europe to earn two Michelin stars, thanks to Katalin Pintér's dedication. In 2020, she transferred a 42.5% stake to her daughter Anna, who boldly decided to reinvent Onyx.

items.title: Un'altra me
items.overview: A comedy about social newtorks.

items.title: Lost and Found: Thirty Years, Not Together
items.overview: Canadian Jessi's search for her Romanian birth mother reveals a sister adopted under the same name and a web of lies.

items.title: Blind Man's Bluff
items.overview: Home alone while their parents are out, four cousins play "gato mia" (blind man's bluff). Their fun ends when two of the kids get into a heated argument, which escalates to sinister circumstances.

items.title: A Vision for Vision
items.overview: Directed and produced by 2x Emmy-award winning filmmaker Wayne Chesler, this special documentary follows Irish nutritional scientist Professor John Nolan’s 20-year exploration of the link between powerful antioxidants - Carotenoids - and their effects on nutrition, vision, and brain health. From the marigold fields of Mexico to research labs in Ireland, the Omega-3 enriched Norwegian seas, and elite performance centers in Singapore, the film uncovers breakthrough science behind these incredible nutrients that support how we see, think, and age.

When a young woman receives mysterious phone calls from her future self, she is given the chance to ask three questions about the life ahead of her. Unsure what to ask or what the calls might mean, she must decide how much of her future she truly wants to know.

items.title: My enslaved heart
items.overview: My enslaved heart

items.title: in the heart there is a stone
items.overview: Naomi calls Matteo and compares him to the sea: how can you ask the waves to be anything other than waves? To have known him is enough. His answer is less enthusiastic, and finding herself emptier than she had thought, she heads into a rocky valley to find inner connection: to hear what the rocks, trees, and wind have to say about it all.

items.title: Shining in the Mountain
items.overview: A disappearance case quietly unfolds in the heart of the Loess Plateau. Various characters become entangled in a massive trap woven by money. Baiguo, stuck deep in the mire, is about to have her fate rewritten. As the truth comes to light, the shackles are broken, and all these characters rediscover the value of life and the true meaning of existence.

items.title: The Road to Sydney
items.overview: A documentary that follows the life of Jay Loyola, a Filipina transgender dancer and choreographer, from her early years training and performing traditional dance in the Philippines to her later move to the United States. After transitioning and taking the name Sydney, the film documents the practical consequences of this change, including job loss and housing insecurity. Shot over several years, it traces her movements between the U.S. and the Philippines and her decision to return home, where she revisits places from her past, reconnects with family members, and continues her artistic practice.

items.title: A Photographer in Cannes
items.overview: Red carpet photographer Erlend Štaub, who has also been the Tallinn Black Nights Film Festival official photographer for several years, spends his days at glamorous parties, socialising and taking pictures. Then he spends his nights working on these pictures to deliver them the next morning. He is very much in demand and his talents as a photographer are also highly appreciated abroad. He has been attending the Cannes International Film Festival for fifteen years in a row. It is a hard job that requires social skills and great physical strength. Part of his success is to find out "where is the line when people start feeling great".

items.title: Complications
items.overview: No longer working for the CIA, Dietrich is now a ruthless mercenary on a mission to execute a high value target. But all is not what it seems, and before long the mission becomes a lot more complicated than Dietrich could have imagined.

items.title: Ubuntu Nation - The Voice of the Voiceless
items.overview: Created in 1994 with the goal of housing ten thousand people, the Dzaleka camp now has a population of 44,000 refugees. These are people fleeing political, religious, and ethnic conflicts in various countries, mostly the Democratic Republic of Congo. Living in poverty and victims of prejudice, the refugees are not allowed to leave the camp. Faced with this situation of abandonment, four young people came together to bring dignity, work, education, and above all, hope to the people of Dzaleka through the philosophy of Ubuntu.

items.title: Nika's Room
items.overview: Jakob, a single father by day and sex worker by night, watches his teenage daughter Nika losing herself in the frenzy of nightlife. The more Nika rebels against him, the more desperately Jakob seeks comfort and validation from his client Martha.

items.title: Where's Dinner?
items.overview: Horror film about a woman in a toxic relationship. Visual companion for Grace Pehrman's album "SUBURBIA"

items.title: Max
items.overview: During World War II, in a sealed room, a brutal psychological duel unfolds between Jean Moulin, the leader of the French Resistance, and Klaus Barbie, the Chief of the Gestapo.

items.title: The Wild Soul
items.overview: An odyssey towards the self, an invitation to rediscover sensitivity. It is a journey through time, countries, and elements – water, earth, mountains, form – an expedition that intimately explores, without judgment or taboo, the relationship humans maintain with other species, as well as the awareness we have of ourselves and of our planet.

items.title: Aunty Ji
items.overview: On her daughter’s birthday, Kulsoom finally leaves her flat. Cut off from the world, a series of simple errands spirals into an everyday odyssey that shakes her as she struggles to find her way home.

items.title: A Vida é Assim
items.overview: A tiny ant crawls diagonally across the still-blank page. But that night, he didn’t write a single word. Why should he? The thrill and mystery of life had already passed through those pages...

items.title: What Was She Thinking
items.overview: Four close friends, all proudly childfree women, take on every question the world throws at them with honesty, humor, and zero apologies.

items.title: A Garota Mágica
items.overview: Aline seeks relief from the boredom of everyday routine in the brutality and fantasy of a magical world that seems closer to collapse with every passing day.

items.title: Marriage Test
items.overview: In a mosque waiting room in 1980s South Wales, a young Welsh woman and her Iranian fiancé prepare for an Islamic conversion ceremony that will test the strength of their love and their resolve.

items.title: Gorilla Gorilla
items.overview: After her divisive debut feature, Anne, an up-and-coming filmmaker, sets out to make her sophomore film, In Memory of Anne Heche. But as scenes go awry, actors drop out, and her prickly friendship with her lead actress becomes increasingly toxic, Anne employs questionable tactics in an attempt to save her movie.

items.title: Word of mouth
items.overview: A flood alert disrupts life in a small town and intertwines three stories marked by family conflicts, secrets and urgent decisions.

items.title: Florêncio Guerra e Seu Cavalo
items.overview: Is time a sentence? Florêncio Guerra, a simple old pawn, goes over life in this essay on humanity when he receives the difficult mission of his boss: to kill his horse!

items.title: Magic in the Mundane
items.overview: A cinematic journey into the overlooked miracles of everyday existence.

items.title: Ice, Men and a Starling
items.overview: On the frozen waters of Hiiumaa, 87-year-old Vello Jürjo, a legendary figure in the world of ice sailing, begins building his very last iceboat. Hearing the news, his grandson, director Mihkel Oksmann, rushes to document the process.

items.title: Ghosts of the Gold Rush
items.overview: From the creators of Haunted Discoveries, Ghosts of the Gold Rush explores California’s darkest Gold Rush legends, from Hangtown’s violent past to a deadly mining disaster and asks whether history can leave something behind that never truly dies.

items.title: Gnomes
items.overview: A trip to a road side grave turns into a whirl of emotions as two people struggle to process the loss of a loved one.

items.title: Motu Patlu & the Mystery of Nagmani
items.overview: Motu and Patlu chase John into a time portal after he steals a precious diamond locket, sending them 900 years into the past into the ancient city of Andherius.

items.title: Jan Van Eyken & Pascal Braeckman: Backstage
Egg
items.overview: Mahiro (32), anxious about losing her eggs, forms relationships with the men in her share house through egg dishes. But as she becomes aware of their strange dreams and her own growing obsession, she begins to confront herself.

items.title: Un ángel para Maruja
items.overview: All but resigned to being trapped on the ground by an illness that makes orientation in flight impossible, a pigeon finds refuge in the home of Maruja, a lonely old woman determined to help the bird return to the sky.

items.title: The Trans Girl Next Door
items.overview: Yuta, a second-year middle school student, lives with his single mother. One day, a woman named Yuka suddenly appears at Yuta’s home. Yuka claims to be Yuta himself, having come from 10 years in the future—after enduring various hardships, he underwent gender confirmation surgery to become who she is now. Yuka urges Yuta to begin the process of gender transition as soon as possible, before he reaches adulthood. Although Yuta had begun to feel a slight sense of dissonance among his friends, he resists Yuka’s forceful pressure. A tug-of-war ensues between Yuka, who has chosen to live as a woman, and Yuta, who finds it difficult to accept that future.

items.title: Larger Than Life
items.overview: Two imbeciles — a B-list country music star and his friend, a manipulative Pentecostal preacher — are relentlessly pursued across Appalachia by a demonic Toyota Prius.

items.title: BIGFOOT
items.overview: The film follows Rémi, a man in his fifties who raises bison in the Laurentides region. One morning, while working, he comes across a six-year-old boy in pajamas, Hugo, on his land, who claims to be looking for his father among the bison.

items.title: First, Do No Harm
items.overview: Christian Polish gynecologist Alicja is visited by her old friend asking her to terminate her pregnancy. She has to make a difficult decision if she is going to obey her faith and laws or help her friend.

items.title: The Unthinkable Daughter
items.overview: Decades of questions and a crime that shook Brazil. Suzane von Richthofen, convicted for the murder of her parents, tells the whole story in her own words.

items.title: Twisted Tie: The Movie
items.overview: An intoxicating office romance begins when Kang Do-jin, a perfectionist team leader at a VVIP spatial design agency, and Lee Sun-woo, a rookie who admires him, cross the line during a rainy night shift. Do-jin tries to control Sun-woo through secret "hands-on tutoring," but their dynamic shifts when sly client manager Baek Yi-geon intervenes, stirring intense jealousy and possessiveness between them.

items.title: Holofiction
items.overview: The experimental film explores the visual representation of the Holocaust through a montage of thousands of excerpts from fictional films and television series produced between 1938 and the present. Drawing from an extensive archive of over 3,000 narrative works the film critically examines how Holocaust imagery has been codified and reproduced in cinema across decades.

items.title: Rusalki
items.overview: A girl wakes up by a lake with a collection of women and no memory of how she got there. As fragments from her past resurface and memories come flooding back, tensions rise between the women and the girl tries to find a way to escape…

items.title: Monster
items.overview: Consumed by grief, a disfigured anti-hero embarks on a series of desperate attempts to relive his past – but it’s not the same.

items.title: The Fencing Tournament
items.overview: At the final match of a fencing tournament, Anja watches her son lose to one of his friends. When his rivalry turns into racism and violence, she becomes the only witness to what truly happened. Torn between shame, ambition and the fear of admitting the truth, Anja finds herself caught in a profound moral conflict.

items.title: The House with Chimaeras
items.overview: At the peak of his career, famous Kyiv architect Władysław Horodecki is desperately fighting his own demons. At the same time, darkness emanated by the evil forces bringing menace to the city is gradually enveloping the entire Kyiv. To defeat evil, Horodecki has to take on the mission of creating an architectural Quadrangle of Good.

items.title: Play Gun
items.overview: Atlas picks up a pantomime firearm.

items.title: Finding Faith
items.overview: A short film contextualising the cultural significance of George Michael's Faith album via unheard interview voice-over, unseen images by Herb Ritts, and behind-the-scenes footage of the Faith music video.

items.title: Tomson Highway: Permanent Astonishment
items.overview: Tomson Highway: Permanent Astonishment, inspired by his award-winning memoir Permanent Astonishment, follows Highway's extraordinary life, from his birth in a tent in northern Manitoba and years at residential school to his groundbreaking plays The Rez Sisters and Dry Lips Oughta Move to Kapuskasing, which transformed Canadian theatre.

items.title: The Innocence of Water
items.overview: In a community in Jujuy, where access to water is a privilege, Pamela works for Amelia, who is responsible for the town's water crisis. As the neighbors confront her, a children's game pushes the conflict beyond its limits.

items.title: Suzie dans la forêt
items.overview: Devastated by a painful loss, Suzie gradually rediscovers her zest for life through her encounters with animals, both domestic and wild.

items.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000: The RiffTrax Experiments — The Mummy Theme Park
items.overview: The RiffTrax Experiments continue with Mummy Theme Park! All the best theme parks have “Theme Park” right in their names, right? That’s why the theme park in Jurassic Park turned out to be such a mess — if only they’d called it “Big Bitey Lizard Theme Park,” the guests would’ve known what they were in for.

items.title: Bloom Where You Are Planted
items.overview: Three land rights activists contend with their volatile notions of home amid terror and red-tagging in Cagayan Valley.

items.title: Algo Más Para Decir
items.overview: Algo más para decir revisits images produced by the Cine Escuela Argentino project, an initiative launched by the Ministry of Education between 1947 and 1952 to support classroom instruction across the country.  The short film offers a journey through these images—acting as a window into the past—to observe what remains, what has changed, and what no longer exists.

items.title: Worthy
items.overview: The discovery of an icon, which Ilias believes to be crying, sets him on his journey from cemetery caretaker to the chosen one. While he is on his quest to bring the icon to the people of the small town, we also follow three other stories of people who could do with a little help from a miraculous icon.

items.title: My Son, My King
items.overview: My Son, My King is a coming-of-age drama set in Melbourne's west, that follows Negus, a young Ethiopian-Australian boy navigating adolescence while caught between the expectations of his community and the stereotypes imposed on him by society. As he searches for identity, belonging and what it truly means to become a man, one reckless decision forces him to confront the pressures shaping his future. Rooted in the Ethiopian diaspora and inspired by the lived experiences of African Australian youth, My Son, My King explores family, masculinity and resilience through a perspective rarely seen in Australian cinema.

items.title: The Goyfriend
items.overview: Aviva is excited to bring James to his first Passover Seder, until her parents admit that grandma has no idea that her potential future grandson-in-law isn’t Jewish. Determined to keep the peace, Aviva’s family attempt to pass James off as ‘one of us’.

items.title: Aktor Gagal
items.overview: Vertical drama actors whose work got threatened when their production house started making AI-based drama.

items.title: Changing Landscapes
items.overview: Returning home after 19 years away, Michael revisits familiar places he frequented with his late partner, Anna.

items.title: Buddy
items.overview: A heartwarming Filipino family dramedy about family, friendship, forgiveness, and the connections that bring people back together.

items.title: Zindabad
items.overview: In the heart of the Karakoram, a Pakistani climber attempts a first ascent in his own backyard, where the biggest peaks have long been claimed by outsiders. Set against the long shadow of 9/11, which reshaped access, perception, and opportunity across Pakistan’s mountains, the expedition becomes a lens on a deeper imbalance. Mueez’s climb is an attempt to shift that dynamic, and to imagine a future where the next generation of Pakistani alpinists define their own routes, on their own terms.

items.title: Body to Heart
items.overview: In the picturesque village of Mazan in Southern France, known for the Gisèle Pélicot rape case, three women embark on a journey to heal from domestic and sexual violence by doing horse therapy sessions.

items.title: Altera Partem
items.overview: Adam and two other men find themselves trapped in the hold of a ship. While the prisoners desperately search for a way out, the discovery of a strange breach in the wall will upend each of their beliefs.

items.title: Captain Scarlet Retrometabolised: Revenge of the Mysterons From Mars
items.overview: A brand new documentary exploring the edits, omissions and creative changes made when transforming the original episodes into movie form.

items.title: Sheepwell
items.overview: A rural Alabama woman and her daughter help a mysterious naked stranger who appears in their backyard. As they shelter and feed him, conversations about trust and relationships unfold, leading to unexpected complications.

items.title: Particles of Dust
items.overview: The corpse of a young man shows up at the shores of Atalante marking the return of Isidore to the territory of the living. But coming back from the dead is a delicate affair. As he follows the traces of his past lives in search of lost memories and the promise of a story, Isidore finds himself caught in a deceitful web of narratives within narratives, a world of Time Travelers and Doppelgängers, Picture Eaters and Textile Merchants, Phantom Friends and Phantom Lovers.

items.title: Evanescent
items.overview: A young girl makes a bid for connection with her emotionally unavailable father.

items.title: Wasington
items.overview: This is the sad tale of the township of Wasington, nestled in the uttermost reaches of the northwest of the US of A.  Two young Americans had planned to travel there for an evening of light music, but that was where the trouble already began.  For what they had failed to realize was that the 6th of July was not much unlike the 4th of July after all…

items.title: A Ray of Sunlight
items.overview: Okhee is a lower-class diver in the city. One day, Eunyoung, the daughter of her late husband, comes to visit. What’s more, Kyeongsik, Okhee’s son, who is being chased by creditors, leaves his young son Junseo with them and disappears. Eunyoung wasn’t planning to stay long but misses the chance to leave due to Okhee's accident and the appearance of her step-nephew, Junseo. Eunyoung starts to live together with Okhee, but everything feels uncomfortable.

items.title: Flocked Mallard Male
items.overview: In a series of accounts, two men question why the woman they have both dated left them. With no answers, they eventually find common ground rooted in misogyny.

items.title: Memory of a Sunset
items.overview: An elderly man visits a cemetery after being summoned by his brother, who died several years ago. The meeting turns out to be a ruse orchestrated by Death itself, which has come to claim him because his time has come.

items.title: Sunday
items.overview: Over the course of a week in Santiago, Anastasia tries to maintain a sense of normalcy between work, her friends, and her relationship. But the approach of an inevitable event ultimately shatters the fragile balance that has allowed her to keep moving forward.

items.title: Do You See What I See? Cinéma Fantastique Then and Now
items.overview: Exploring France's rich history of fantasy cinema, this film details the genre from it's foundation to the present.

items.title: The Beauty of Intensity
items.overview: An introverted young man hires a service called “Epizos,” which replaces past romantic relationships with actors. But when Adán hires the service, the person who knocks on his door is the very person he wanted to replace.

items.title: A Gentle Apocalypse
items.overview: Consumed by a world of setbacks and expectations, Juno navigates the struggles of love, work, and loneliness. As her entire world crumbles, a strange encounter changes how she sees everything...

items.title: Sound is the Body
items.overview: A Venezuelan city is emptying. A labor less priest struggles with a sonic sleep disorder while trying to safe-keep his meek buffalo from being taken. As the intentions of the remaining ones become more desperate, the priest’s malaise becomes more alive.

items.title: OJ’s Accomplice
items.overview: While the world was distracted by the media circus around O.J. Simpson's trial, they might have ignored a chilling possibility: he may have had help.

items.title: And What Do The Pigs Think?
items.overview: In a contemporary art museum, a zealous guard discovers that a taxidermied boar has fallen — in the span of a single sneeze. An investigation erupts.  Wild accusations, paranoia, and delusional theories turn the incident into a vortex of absurd and awkward chaos. A biting satire on collective fear, where only the taxidermied pigs keep their cool.

items.title: Allure of the Flesh
items.overview: When three witches move into a suburban neighbourhood, a conservative mother fears that her son will be seduced by their darkness.

items.title: The Bully Club
items.overview: Seventeen-year-old Sue is sentenced to two years in a juvenile detention facility after becoming violent to protect her bullied friend Lynn. The girls first became friends in a secret online group called 'The Bully Club', where bullied and ostracised teens find support and understanding from each other. For a while, it was the only good thing in Sue and Lynn's lives and gave them a chance to escape their other problems.

items.title: Black Cocaine
items.overview: The discovery of audio tapes recorded by Eugenio Berríos, known as the "chemist of Augusto Pinochet", forms the basis for reconstructing his rise and fall. His life traces a thin black line through Chile's recent history—dictatorships, lethal poisons, and mountains of cocaine—within a political life so violent it ultimately led to his own self-destruction.

items.title: Field Reports
items.overview: An autistic documentary filmmaker studies two neurotypicals, trying to understand their shared way of being through objects, language and small social gestures. As the day draws on, his sense of alienation slowly emerges.

items.title: Chicken Tenders And Hard Liquor
items.overview: A college student gets too fond of a rotisserie chicken after a night of hard drinking, and wakes up to some unusual consequences.

items.title: Miracle Whip
items.overview: Sebastian Winterfold (Michael Louis Hassiepen) applies for the job of a lifetime.

items.title: Gemma
items.overview: Gemma and Amber grow closer on a date, which throws Gemma into a surreal conflict across the different arenas of her body. Her Fear and Desire wage a battle that disrupts their fragile, budding connection.

items.title: Erased from the Map
items.overview: A man tells a journalist about the photos and memories from his childhood in home and village that will soon disappear for the new national capital city. With his brother, he returns to the places they once played, taking pictures and recreating stories as if the land was still the same.

items.title: Noise & Neighbours
items.overview: If you ignore the music, Liza Ludick’s new short film, Noise & Neighbours, can be classified as a silent movie. Still, with striking animation and the moving piano notes of composer Wesley West, the silence in this movie is significantly meaningful.  Veteran actor Tobie Cronjé and newcomer Olwethu Kuene play the roles of Helmut and Bolelo, two neighbours who can’t stand each other, but who, through the universal language of music, assume unique roles in fulfilling each other’s lives.

items.title: Connection Lost
items.overview: After winning a scholarship, Bruno, a lonely young man, travels to Buenos Aires for the first time and sets out to meet Tomás, the virtual friend who accompanied him throughout his childhood but with whom he lost contact. To do so, he must follow the trail of photographs that Tomás used to send him in the past, reliving his day-to-day life until he reaches his house. The thread of images and past chats will be the key to understanding why the friendship broke down and, when the photographs lead down a dark path beyond the house, why his tragic fate came to be.

items.title: Ascesis
items.overview: The brutal murder of the priest of an old village paralyzes Loren and Laura's anthropologic investigation. When trying to get away from this place, an accident traps them in Agua Negras, forcing them to unearth a dark plot linked to the figure of Father Pius.

items.title: The Nutcracker Wish
items.overview: After Clara, a small town dance teacher, is gifted a 'magical' Nutcracker, the real-life version shows up at her front door. But what seemed a holiday serendipity may instead destroy her family legacy.

items.title: Control Line
items.overview: A determined Black woman in her mid-30s navigates the emotional and physical challenges of conception, loss, and motherhood, all within the intimate confines of her bathroom.

items.title: 4 OUTS: Back to the Ballgame
items.overview: Masaki Aiba plays the lead role of Yagami. After being released from a corporate baseball team and feeling despondent, Yagami finds a new job at a sports center for people with disabilities. There, he takes on the role of manager for a baseball team consisting of just five players with disabilities… At first, Yagami was skeptical, wondering, "Can people with disabilities really play baseball?" But as he works up a sweat alongside the players and grows into a true manager, his journey is sure to touch the hearts of many.

items.title: The Date
items.overview: Jazmín is excited: this afternoon she will have her first date in years. Filled with a nervous energy, she wonders what the day will bring – but as the minutes roll by, things do not turn out the way she had hoped…

items.title: Frozen: Biggest Sledding Adventure Ever!
items.overview: Snow has arrived in Arendelle, and Anna and Olaf are excited for their first sled ride of the winter! When the hills aren't thrilling enough, Elsa uses her ice magic to create an epic sledding course filled with giant jumps, twists, and icy surprises. But when royal duties call Elsa away, Anna and Olaf come up with a special plan to bring the winter fun back and surprise their sister.

items.title: Stars Above Us
items.overview: A man reflects on his teenage years and the deep bond he had with a friend who, despite being bullied and struggling with severe depression, seemed untouchable in his eyes. As he looks back on their time together, he grapples with her tragic death and the haunting memories of the girl he thought was the coolest person in the world.

items.title: Primetime Production Diary
items.overview: Go behind the scenes with Primetime director Lance Oppenheim in a new making-of mini doc directed by Wes Ellis and Christian Vazquez & edited by Wes Ellis.

items.title: On the Heights
items.overview: After a suicide in the family, mother Hae-sook and daughter Yoon-seul withdraw into separate silences, each carrying grief in her own way. When Yoon-seul returns home after a long absence, the distance between them becomes impossible to ignore. They share the same space yet remain estranged, bound by what neither can fully name. Hae-sook attempts to endure the loss through restless, self-destructive impulses, while Yoon-seul retreats into emotional numbness. As traces of the past surface in their daily lives, they are confronted with the fragile thread that still connects them. An unforeseen incident disrupts the stillness of their days.

items.title: 100 Women
items.overview: A young career woman named KiKi struggles to balance her personal and professional life and must fight against a male-dominated workplace.

items.title: EXO PLANET #6 - EXhOrizon [dot] in CINEMAS
items.overview: EXO brings the grand finale of its sixth solo tour, the [dot] encore concert of EXO PLANET #6 - EXhOrizon, to cinemas around the world. The show is broadcast live on 8 November 2026, with delayed screenings in some territories, on the big screen with immersive sound.

items.title: Tendu Pointe Battement
items.overview: A celebration of dance, music, movement, language, and animation.

items.title: The Uprooted
items.overview: Two teens dig up a tree and embark on a journey to bring it back to their grandmother.

items.title: Starting Towards the Finish Line
items.overview: Unable to reach Lianhua Town, Xiaoqing stumbles upon the frame of a car buried under silt four years ago. Then a wild idea strikes him: restore the car and drive there. Meanwhile, Dapang, eager for a tasty treat, and Gezi, who needs to deliver a letter for his grandma, also need to head to Lianhua Town. They strike an agreement with Xiaoqing. Zhang Zhigao, a volunteer teacher concerned about the children’s education, joins the team to rebuild the car. And so begins this pursuit of a dream. United by the resolve to set off, they embark on an extraordinary journey.

items.title: The Life of the Party
items.overview: A year after an event that changed her and her loved ones' lives, Natalia must return and face those she hurt.

items.title: Night Shift
items.overview: A near-future dystopia. During his first shift guarding the coastline, a young cadet has to confront the enemy whilst dealing with his retiring mentor who has a love for cake.

items.title: The Little Ring
items.overview: A suspicious man drifts apart from his girlfriend over conflicts surrounding their artistic careers, forcing him to put his marriage proposal on hold indefinitely. After the pair travels to the Tibetan regions together, their relationship crumbles completely, culminating in an unexpected ending.

A young Bulgarian man drives a truck along an Austrian highway, 71 people sealed in the cargo hold with little air. Will he follow instructions from his handlers or lean into his humanity? Based on a true story that changed Europe’s refugee policy in 2015.

items.title: Sestry
items.overview: Ema (23) returns home unexpectedly and reunites with her sister Mia (15), mother and grandmother in their beloved garden colony. The sisters relive childhood games, laughter and nostalgia and their bond is quietly renewed as they say goodbye.

items.title: Chopin
items.overview: “Chopin” tells the story of Chopin Wu (played by Liu), who returns home to small-town America where he grew up to amend an estranged relationship with his workaholic father (Dai). With a sudden appearance from his ailing grandmother (Chen), he is confronted by a past he had left behind. In the midst of a health crisis and a broken family, Wu is forced to re-examine old relationships, embrace a heritage he once denied and discover the importance of family and identity.

items.title: Alexander the Great and the Accursed Dragon
items.overview: In Karagiozis's dream, a man‑eating Dragon seizes control of the city's aqueduct. In order to prevent panic, Rigas persuades him to accept his victims by lottery. When the lot falls on Rigopoula, twelve‑year‑old Alexandre, searching for the horse he adores, unexpectedly comes upon the Dragon. He does not panic. Selfless love completely conquers fear.

items.title: Apple Slices
items.overview: A desperate young man who is thrust into a relentless chase across the city, forcing him to confront how thin the line between survival and greed truly is.

items.title: Daughter of Mine
items.overview: Closeted trans girl, Ruby fails to assert her identity to her Thai Immigrant mother. However, after an intimate encounter with an older trans woman, their one night together at the pool leads Ruby to find the strength to confront her mother again.

items.title: The Witches of Pool Bottom
items.overview: When a teenage girl's body-image fears become physical, she decides to destroy them - quite literally.

items.title: Good Time Girl!
items.overview: A young woman still healing from a painful past, pushes herself to go on a first date in hopes of reclaiming a sense of normalcy. What begins as a playful, promising night out soon tests the fragile line between moving forward and confronting what she hasn’t fully left behind.

items.title: Memory from the Sea
items.overview: Arūnas is an ageing fisherman on the Lithuanian coast. Yet every year, the fish are becoming scarcer. His second occupation is older than his first: after a storm, he goes down to the beach to search for amber, as has been done in these parts for centuries. During the long winter, when he cannot go out to sea, he sits at his kitchen table polishing the pieces he has found into jewellery, for which there are also fewer and fewer buyers. Amber was once the backbone of the local industry and tourism. Now it is one man’s way of filling his days and preserving his memories.

items.title: Slava
items.overview: Karlsruhe, Germany, 1962. KGB agent Bogdan Stashynskii is trialed for the assasination of Ukrainian revolutionary and head of the now disbanded Organization of Ukrainian Nationalists, Stepan Bandera. However, Slava Stetsko and her spouse Yaroslav decide to take action and turn the trial into not just a memorial for Bandera, but a  thorough critique of the USSR's web of political assasinations  and the political indifference to the situation in the West.

items.title: Let Me Change Your Mind
items.overview: Jane must stop a memory-altering machine from fixing her dying Ah Gong's biggest regret, or else his perfect imagined life will erase Ah Ma completely.

items.title: a pink and red dress, made of satin… covered in flowers, mostly roses
items.overview: Elsa remembers her mother truly happy only when she was singing. As a child, she and her twin brother would secretly watch her perform at The Little Onne Theatre. Now grown, Elsa sings on the same stage, in the same flower-covered dress her mother once wore.

items.title: Mysteries of Our Summer
items.overview: A team of filmmakers travels around Lithuania’s summer festivals – from Midsummer’s Day and Assumption Day to the first day of September, which marks the end of summer – capturing short, playful moments of their journey on 16 mm film. By asking people they meet about miracles, faith, childhood, and memories, the filmmakers unexpectedly reveal hidden stories and sensitive confessions.

items.title: Rate My Ex
items.overview: Jonathan prepares for a date with Penny, a girl he recently met, when she accidently sends a confusing text. She immediately deletes it, making Jonathan suspicious. He searches her name online and he stumbles upon a website called ‘RateMyEx.com’, where he finds numerous reviews from her former exes. With the reviews in mind, Jonathan contemplates whether the date is even worth going on anymore.

items.title: To The Front
items.overview: On Driving Ukraine's 51st convoy, a group of volunteers drive five donated vehicles from Oxfordshire to Lviv, where the keys will be handed over to Ukrainian defenders. Among the group are a Cornish farmer, a Ukrainian evacuee, and one of the writers of Ace Ventura: Pet Detective.

items.title: The Beast in Me
items.overview: A man has something to hide from his date.

items.title: Children of Palestine
items.overview: The documentary reflects on the situation in Palestine from the perspective of a journalist, an activist, and a geopolitical analyst. It offers a deeply human perspective that seeks to raise public awareness. In a world where numbers are counted every day, the director attempts here to count the names. An important message of love for Palestine and for humanity, reminding us that «we are all children of Palestine»—meaning that each of us must consider ourselves part of the same human family.

items.title: Etude
items.overview: Etude follows a filmmaker attempting to reconnect with his estranged family. After years of his father's absence while his mother struggled to hold the household together on her own, his father returns terminally ill. With little time left, father and son must finally confront years of unspoken words and silence.

items.title: Blood Money
items.overview: After their train robbery turns bloody at the hands of Texas Rangers, the survivors of one of America's last outlaw gangs rendezvous at their safehouse where they investigate who, if anyone, sold them out to the law.

items.title: Living Among The Stars
items.overview: Seventy-year-old Irena lives alone and spends every day following gossip about showbiz stars and binge-watching her favorite TV show. Her life changes when a famous TV presenter in a sequin suit shows up at her door.

items.title: This is Not An Apple
items.overview: Palestinian brothers Yahya and Reda live in a neighbourhood in Oslo where their role models are often local gangsters. What begins as a seemingly insignificant argument within the gang ends in an attempted murder that leaves Yahya with life-threatening injuries. Against all odds, he survives. The brothers are faced with the choice of taking revenge or choosing forgiveness.

items.title: O.C.D
items.overview: A young man's job interview takes a strange turn when he realises someone is watching, and testing, his every compulsion.

items.title: Only Old Friends Left Alive
items.overview: Retired Lao Cao and Xiao Lai, two old men, sit on opposite sides of a drinking table under an arcade in Taipei. They toast and talk nonsense like this every day, and they have done it for more than thirty years. A young director who meant only to watch somehow ends up at the table too, spending many absurd and moving nights with them. Years pass. Someone leaves, someone falls ill, and some relationships are repaired and then break again. The two men are old, they are nearly done with drink, and they no longer see each other often.

items.title: Joe and Mike's Wine Bar - Opening Night!
items.overview: Joe and Mike are 2 brothers opening a wine bar, there’s just one problem… they don’t have any wine. When a mislabeled box leaves them with a mountain of peanuts instead, the brothers scramble to save their opening night and an escalating series of disasters leads to everything ultimately falling apart.

items.title: Hollow
items.overview: The young Lennart, a poor farmer, is out hunting with a friend when he stumbles and falls down in a hidden cave. And his life is forever altered.

items.title: Unification of Japan 77
items.overview: With Kyowakai’s new leadership in place, Himuro (Yasukaze Motomiya) becomes its fourth chairman and Tamura (Yoshiyuki Yamaguchi) becomes Wakagashira. Former Keihin Rengokai leader Sunaga (Masataka Naruse) becomes shateigashira after the group is absorbed into Kyowakai. Soon after, Sunaga warns that Chinese delinquents are causing trouble in Yokohama, and former Keihin chairman Sakagami is kidnapped by a Chinese group.  Himuro and Tamura rush to rescue Sakagami, now considered a brother, and defeat his captors. Meanwhile, a conflict between Chinese groups and an extremist nationalist resident over a condominium leads to the stabbing death of café employee Han. The café is also forced to vacate after its landlord changes. Determined to uphold their code of protecting the weak, Kyowakai uncovers the Chinese organization Makino Group behind these incidents.

items.title: A Pilgrimage of Dreams
items.overview: In the Azores, Tom and Lila collect dreams from island inhabitants. Through nocturnal stories and volcanic landscapes, an invisible dialogue emerges between territory, memory, and the unconscious.

items.title: Wish You Long Life
items.overview: Wish You Long Life follows Adi and Maya, two childhood friends who have become estranged in recent years. When the sudden death of their best friend Reuben brings them back together, they reconnect and retrace the lives they once imagined for themselves and reckon with their past experiences with bullying, exclusion and antisemitism. Through this journey, they grapple with whether they should hide their cultural identity, or be proud of it.

items.title: Julienne
items.overview: Julienne intimately follows a woman whose obsessive diet and exercise regimen gradually drives her towards a fate she never saw coming.

items.title: American Woodcock
items.overview: What's that buzzy sound? It's the woodcock, baby!

items.title: On the Edge
items.overview: After years of meth-fuelled chemsex, Jay is caught in a relentless cycle of relapse, paranoia, and recovery. With the support of close friends, he begins confronting his addiction through self-awareness and openness. But even as he recognises its devastating cost, the grip of addiction continues to test his mind, his relationships, and his hope of reclaiming a healthy life.

items.title: Clench Your Fist Tightly
items.overview: Summer vacation begins at a high school in the countryside. Han-wool, an otherwise ordinary student, finds himself preoccupied with a major question: "What does it mean to be strong?" A few days later, a boxing tournament is held at a small local gym, and a spark of excitement begins to ignite within the students. Yet, amidst it all, Han-wool continues to sense something strange, something he cannot quite put his finger on.

items.title: Albe su la mont
items.overview: In an isolated mountain shack the paths of three unnamed men collide. As the tension brews, a fickle, capricious and thoroughly alive Mountain asserts itself as the ultimate force over their fates.

items.title: Delicatessen
items.overview: A dinner turns into a ritual of subjugation when a woman is forced to eat her meal. The consumption becomes an uncontrollable, monstrous impulse, revealing the face of guilt.

items.title: It's Been a Long Time Since It Rained
items.overview: After weeks without rain, Milagros and Rocío stumble upon a mysterious red arch and a flowing stream. Convinced they've found their salvation, they decide to take the water home. But their grandmother orders them to return it, warning that the place they discovered will awaken an ancient curse. Now, they must decide whether to obey her and endure the drought or defy the warning and face the consequences.

items.title: Rooster Girl
items.overview: After her return from abroad, sister Dongming plans a grand Western-style wedding for her younger brother Ajie. Yet their family brings home a rooster to ward off ill fortune for him, ruining all her arrangements. Their father's sole concern is the rooster, while their mother quietly settles an old score with Dongming over her past as a daughter. No one pays any heed to Ajie himself. On the wedding day, Ajie goes missing. Dongming then sets out to expose the absurdity of this family in her own way.

items.title: Fish the Moon
items.overview: Follows a writer who begins getting calls from a government appointed censor who is tasked with monitoring his online output for ‘public security purposes’ and has a front row seat to his every move. Within that space—where things are created, consumed, edited and debated—a strange and unlikely connection occurs.

items.title: Follow You There - A War Bride Story
items.overview: Andrew Rodgers is a professional musician from St. John's, NL. As a songwriter, he is always on the hunt for new and interesting stories to write about. After discovering a remarkable story in his own family, Andrew travels to Fair Haven, NL to talk to his Great Grandmother, Joan Masters, who is a war bride originally from the London area of Great Britain. She lived through WWII, met Andrew's Great Grandfather, Sam Masters, during his service in WWII, and together they travelled back to Sam's hometown of Fair Haven, NL to begin a new life after the war.

items.title: Petali e grattacieli: dentro al Giappone che cambia
items.overview: A journey through contemporary Japan: a nation suspended between tradition and innovation, grappling with profound social, economic, and demographic shifts. From high-tech metropolises to the most secluded corners, Marco Clementi’s reportage explores a complex society, touching upon phenomena such as hikikomori (social withdrawal), an aging population, and emerging forms of loneliness. Spanning Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka, and Nara, the narrative traverses both the world of robotics and ancient, time-honored traditions: from the art of kintsugi and the crafting of katana swords to the rituals of sumo wrestlers and the culture of the geisha. The account also delves into gastronomy, craftsmanship, and daily life, encompassing everything from sushi and sake to exquisite kimonos.

items.title: The Whores Feast
items.overview: Filmed during a shared harvest dinner with organizers and collaborators, The Whores Feast brings together Ceyenne Doroshow of G.L.I.T.S., Victoria Von Blaque of Trans Equity Consulting, Lisa 张小华 of Red Canary Song, and Amalia Valentine of Decrim NY. Their conversation lingers over nourishment, labor, chosen family, honoring the collective practices of care that sustain communities through ongoing precarity.

items.title: The Bus
items.overview: After serving ten years in prison for a murder he did not commit, a man is finally released. Determined to take revenge on the detective who framed him, he tracks him down—only to discover that the detective has already died.

items.title: 5000 Strokes
items.overview: Carolina Modena and Cristina Ganem arrive in Antarctica with an extraordinary challenge: to swim five thousand strokes in its icy waters, without thermal protection. They barely know each other, but the expedition confronts them with the cold, exhaustion, and an extreme landscape that tests their bodies and transforms their relationship. What begins as a connection between fellow swimmers gradually becomes a deep friendship.

items.title: Roaming over the Horseback
items.overview: On the vast, desolate grassland, injured Mongolian rider Sichintu is forced to end his horse-racing career and return home. Faced with the fate that his beloved horse may be sold, the departure of old friends, and uncertainty about the future, he finally makes a choice true to his heart. He leaps onto the horse’s back once more, reuniting with all that he once lost.

items.title: Kitty
items.overview: Neurodivergent Kitty, lover of trinkets and Kate Bush, finds her favourite jumper ruined and must find a replacement. When the perfect jumper seems unattainable, she’s left with one choice: sell her precious collections, or risk losing the jumper forever.

items.title: King of the Jews
items.overview: When Alice and Benj’s eight-year-old Jewish son, Ezra, is cast as King Herod in his school Nativity, the couple clash over whether to intervene. The debate escalates as the two argue over who has final say in an interfaith family. Benj, playing the ‘Jewish card’, insists they should stay out of it, scarred by memories of his own overbearing parents, that is, until he sees Ezra’s gleefully murderous rehearsal.

items.title: Blind Date
items.overview: A nervous couple on a first date finds out they have a lot in common. But how much do they really know about each other?

items.title: May
items.overview: May was filmed as a backdrop to part of a theatre performance D36-D37 under the E. F. Burian's lead inspired by the classic Czech poem of the same name by Karel Hynek Macha.

items.title: Pianke
items.overview: The story of a young German boy and his father who befriend a Jewish family during WWII.

items.title: Captain Scarlet Retrometabolised: Captain Scarlet VS The Mysterons
items.overview: A brand new documentary exploring the edits, omissions and creative changes made when transforming the original episodes into movie form.

items.title: Smooth Summer
items.overview: As Hanna and her ten-year-old niece, Erle, get ready for a day at the beach, Hanna is faced with a dilemma: How can she manage to be both a cool aunt and a good role model in this situation?

items.title: Touken Ranbu the Stage: Hiden Tsuki to Taiyou to Hoshiboshi yo
items.overview: Stageplay based on Touken Ranbu.

items.title: Five Minute Brides
items.overview: Twice a year, Skipton seamstress Mandy Abramson invites women of any age, shape or size into her bridal shop to have a wedding dress-up day of their own. Mandy’s simple act of generosity elicits moving stories that this documentary compassionately captures.

items.title: Moroccan Mint
items.overview: A gruff piano teacher is forced to confront his deeply buried grief when an energetic new student begins to break through the distance he keeps between himself and others.

items.title: Tootsie Doomsday
items.overview: When the "Tootsie Virus" spreads globally, it compels men everywhere to fall in love with one another, triggering an unprecedented crisis of a severe shortage of straight men.

items.title: SHE
items.overview: Liva, a young woman, is cleaning up after her and her late twin sister's 21st birthday, when she suddenly starts to hear strange sounds. She starts to investigate, but what she stumbles upon turns her birthday into her own personal hell.

items.title: Love Is Blind: The Reunion
items.overview: From whirlwind romances to fumbled connections, the Boston Pod Squad dumps all the tea about their love lives in this wicked dramatic reunion.

items.title: We'll Be Ghosts
items.overview: Haunted by the recent loss of his daughter, Ukrainian soldier Yuri refuses to take leave and return home from the front line. Hiding his thirst for vengeance behind silence and his grief behind duty, he volunteers for a dangerous operation.
