But when duty, vengeance and survival collide and the mission spirals out of control, Yuri has to face the cost of what he’s become.

items.title: Mr. Happy
items.overview: Mourning the loss of her partner, a grieving woman's evening is interrupted when she starts receiving taunting messages featuring a faceless figure known as "Mr. Happy."

items.title: The Korean Black Eyes
items.overview: In 1966, the girl band ‘All Stars’ was formed centered on drummer Kitty (Jun-im Lim), a third-year high school student. They left the country with an understanding that they were going to perform in Southeast Asia. However, they arrived and put on a spot to perform, sometimes risking their lives, for the soldiers on the battlefield of Vietnam. Kitty was recognized for her musical talent, and formed the five-member girl band ‘Korean Black Eyes’ in Bangkok in 1971. The band moved onto Beirut as their base and toured throughout the Middle East and Africa, including Egypt and Nigeria. When they entered Spain in 1973, they went on a concert tour with Cliff Richard, Julio Iglesias, and others. They recorded an album in Portugal at the suggestion of a local producer, but had to quickly escape the country when the military revolution broke out. Wherever they went, including Vietnam and Lebanon, they encountered turbulent scenes of modern history.

items.title: Hooja and the Last Journey
items.overview: Hooja and Mårdis are two upstanding men from the Malmfälten region with grand plans—and a complete lack of a sense of direction. Tasked with transporting the ashes of a relative’s deceased elkhound along the Torne River, they embark on a journey for which they are neither prepared nor fully grasp the magnitude: they are to discover the soul of the Torne Valley. In the back: an urn. In the front seat: two men doing their absolute best. Ahead of them: encounters with the very best the Torne Valley has to offer.

items.title: Blood Money
items.overview: After a robbery goes wrong, Ali reunites with his partner Mike in a desrt street to await their contact. But when an unexpected revelation throws their reunion into question, Ali finds himself caught in a nightmarish situation.

items.title: Home of the Uninhabitable
items.overview: A young woman refuses to hide her emotional edges while learning to craft home in a world that is historically uninhabitable.

items.title: Next Stop Paneriai
items.overview: A train pulls into snow-covered Paneriai, raising a cloud of snow in its wake. Eitvydas Doškus’s Next Stop Paneriai offers a distinctive continuation of the cinematic exploration of the city begun in Once Upon a Vilnius. This time, however, the railway becomes the axis of a story about multilayered time. Traces of the past are preserved by the Paneriai Memorial and an abandoned tunnel inhabited by bats, semi-feral cats and crumbling houses mark a vanishing present, while children playing at school turn our gaze towards the future. These layers of time overlap like images changing one after another through a train window, making it impossible to clearly distinguish what has already happened from what is yet to come. A meditative film distinguished by its evocative soundtrack, Next Stop Paneriai creates a sensory portrait of a part of Vilnius that is most often simply driven through.

items.title: Allowed to Birth: The Journey of a Global Midwife
items.overview: Across cultures and continents, birth has become shaped by systems of control and intervention. A documentary on the maternal health crisis.

items.title: A Work of Fiction
items.overview: During a therapy session, a woman describes her fantasies and the meaning of love and desire. As these fantasies deepen, guilt, shame, and buried trauma resurface. As her therapist is revealed as her vision of ‘ideal beauty’- embodies the freedom she craves. Caught between her desired self and her inescapable past, she must confront the memories she’d rather escape.

items.title: Caso Isolado
items.overview: Following an accident involving a delivery worker at her workplace, Cristina - a light-skinned Black woman - begins delivering cosmetics in João Pessoa. As she moves through the city, everyday encounters reveal tensions surrounding racial perception, a sense of belonging, and colorism in contemporary Brazil.

items.title: The Valley At Dusk
items.overview: When a late-night radio host receives a sinister call from a self-proclaimed messiah, the two are drawn into battle to confront the grim shadows buried deep in their subconscious.

items.title: Dear Son
items.overview: Mariam, a mute nun in a remote Lebanese convent, cares for an abandoned baby. When a French family arrives to adopt him, their painful separation awakens a maternal instinct that conflicts with her vows, forcing her to question her commitment to virginity and the life she has chosen.

items.title: Swings
items.overview: Zdena and Jiřina are two women who, under normal circumstances, would probably never have gotten along. However, a chance encounter changes both their lives, and gradually an unexpected and strong friendship develops between them. Each of them is struggling with her own family problems. Jiřina is tied to her domineering husband Pavel and her son Emil, while Zdena, after her husband’s death, finds solace in her garden and has a hard time dealing with her daughter Jana’s overprotective nature. Gradually, they both become witnesses to the other’s humiliating situations and, at the same time, give each other the courage to take their lives back into their own hands. Their journey together turns into a series of unexpected adventures, embarrassing moments, and misunderstandings. But the trip ends unexpectedly, and their friendship faces its toughest test.

items.title: The Black Sheep
items.overview: When her troubled younger brother bursts into her home covered in blood and carrying a bag of stolen cash, a woman must decide whether to save him or finally let him answer for his actions.

items.title: Dust
items.overview: A horsewoman unpicks her memories and regrets.

items.title: IO SONO L’ASSENTE – Storia incompleta di un disadattato di successo
items.overview: A journey into the human, poetic, and artistic universe of Alessandro Benvenuti, an elusive artist who has worked in theater, film, television, and music, pursuing an expressive and creative exploration marked by a distinct personal style. Composed of assonances and juxtapositions, the film is a mosaic of images, memories, and short circuits

items.title: Don't Be Discouraged
items.overview: Short student documentary detailing some of the mental health struggles dealt with by the young people of South Australia

items.title: The Dungeon: West Virginia Penitentiary
items.overview: Ever since I was a kid I have been interested in the paranormal and now as an adult I can finally discover the truth for myself. I visited the West Virginia Penitentiary in Moundsville, West Virginia to see what I could find. Who knew that on my first investigation, I would get far more than I ever bargained for.

items.title: Maria Merciful Mind
items.overview: A woman tormented by trauma, anxiety, and a fractured sense of reality reaches her breaking point until a life-changing confession forces her to confront her past, setting her on a powerful journey toward faith, healing, and redemption.

items.title: The Cover Up
items.overview: The Church, long-proclaimed bastion of virtue, is now facing an historic reckoning as residential school survivors in Canada seek justice. With the discovery of 215 bodies at the former residential school site in Kamloops, BC in May 2021, a watershed moment in Canadian history exploded into the world's consciousness. First Nation, Inuit, and Metis survivors across the nation told police their stories of abuse, neglect, experimentation, and even murder for decades -but their truths were considered lies until physical evidence proved otherwise.

items.title: The Last Round
items.overview: Lana Reyes, once a very prominent MMA fighter, made the decision to walk away from a successful career in order to have a family. After raising her son alone, she decided to step back in to the cage to do the one thing she knew how to do. FIGHT. On the night of her comeback fight, after a brutal two rounds, she shakily steps into the third round with a fractured hand a potentially career ending TBI. She shakily steps forward and by the grace of god sees an opening that only instincts would see that ends up winning her the fight. 3 months later, before properly healing up, she takes another fight. Her interactions with her Cut man, Manager and the Commission Doctor lead her to the decision of choosing between walking out injured --- or walking away from the sport before it takes everything she has left.

items.title: Into Black
items.overview: Amidst the chaos and destruction of the London Blitz, four women become trapped in an abandoned warehouse, where they must fight to survive against a murderous stranger known as The Blackout Ripper. Inspired by true events.

items.title: Tony Spiteri
items.overview: A one-on-one game of basketball becomes a fragile confrontation between two men struggling to process loss.

items.title: The Lacey Way
items.overview: Teenage George Lacey does not fit in. She’s a weirdo amongst her conforming peers and a conformist amongst her weirdo family. Only the cows are kind to her. The real world calls to George. Tonight she answers.

items.title: Day One
items.overview: While Yu and F are taking their dying friend, Sea, to see Avengers: Doomsday on day one, the trio gets trapped on the 50th floor after a blackout kills the elevator. They must find a way down before the movie starts, as Sea’s time runs out too.

items.title: I promise I won't bore you.
items.overview: Failing birthday clown and cam-star Mary wades through the messy world of T4T dating after being voted out from her polycule.

items.title: I Am Late!
items.overview: When two friends find themselves running late, their separate paths through New York City unfold into a vibrant, comedic portrait.

items.title: At Home
items.overview: Two young siblings are happily at play in their blanket fort, until an ominous shadow with a life of its own threatens their safe haven. As they hunt the shadow down through a dark deserted house, make belief melts into reality and the memory of that night bleeds across timelines.

items.title: 生中継！相川七瀬 30th Anniversary ROCK KINGDOM TOUR 2026 -FINAL 日本武道館-
Good Old Days
items.overview: Four young skaters spend an afternoon claiming an abandoned factory as their playground, moving from one forbidden urban spot to the next. When the security abruptly cut their session short, the day ends with one of them under arrest. Years later, one of the skaters looks back on a fleeting moment of youth, freedom, and friendship that has stayed with him ever since.

items.title: Keynes, un économiste au secours du XXème siècle
Portrait of possible grief
items.overview: The memorial card — a small, rectangular piece of paper. A name, a date, a face. It is given when something has to be let go: an administrative act, wrapped as a memory. But what if there was someone whose job it was to create that final image?  Lilith is a photographer specializing in portraits for memorial cards. She is contacted when people believe the end is near. From nursing home rooms to cramped kitchens, she moves through the uncomfortable space between existence and farewell, where routine and mortality strangely and effortlessly intersect.

items.title: Too Much Light Makes the Baby Go Blind
items.overview: The NHS Production of Too Much Light Makes the Baby Go Blind is an ensemble-driven, high-octane theatrical experience where the cast attempts to perform 30 short 1-2 minute plays in a strict 60-minute timeframe. Maintained by an onstage digital clock, the performance functions as a living experiment where actors play themselves in the immediate present. There are no traditional characters, no times where the ensemble is off stage, and no fourth wall.

items.title: Saheb's stolen Redmi
items.overview: When Saheb loses his beloved Redmi phone, a precious gift from his girlfriend, he is left devastated. Desperate to get it back, he seeks help from his three friends—Lal, Bahadur and Shastri. Despite their initial reluctance, the trio joins him in a chaotic search filled with hilarious encounters and unexpected drama. When their efforts fail, they turn to Baba, a quirky astrologer, for help. Eventually, they find the damaged phone and visit a mechanic, who suggests an unusual alternative: stealing a phone from the notorious Lambu Don. What follows is a madcap adventure of comedy, drama and dance, leading to an unexpected twist!

items.title: Come To Me
items.overview: A beautiful girl is drawn into the depths of a forest by an eerie, other worldly presence calling out to her. As she ventures deeper and deeper into the darkness of the woods, she discovers something sinister and haunting, eventually falling into a dreamlike nightmare.

items.title: Jangan Dicium
items.overview: After a long-term relationship, Jali risks losing his chance to marry Ainun—all because his body odor is potent enough to knock out his prospective in-laws. Now, Jali is in a race against time to find a way to smell fresh before Ainun is married off to someone else. Can Jali save his romance, or will his body odor end up being his final "partner"?

items.title: Wolfgang Staudte – Feigheit macht jede Staatsform zur Diktatur
items.overview: Wolfgang Staudte, one of Germany’s most important film directors, learned from his mistakes during the Nazi era and went on to make satirical political films of high artistic merit. Former colleagues, film theorists, and his biographers are interviewed; his estate and the film archive in Potsdam are examined in detail; and his most important feature films are taken a closer look at.

items.title: Entre Boulangerie et Charcuterie
items.overview: In the small town of Moisy-sur-Orge, Jean and Painprenelle live a budding romance. But one fine morning, their story will take a completely different turn...

items.title: Fragments and Rubble
items.overview: A fragmented collection of legends born from the rubble of the catastrophic Friuli Earthquake of May 6, 1976.

items.title: Where’s Dinner?
items.overview: Surrealist horror short film about a woman in a toxic relationship. Visual companion for Grace Pehrman’s new album “SUBURBIA”.

items.title: Chambord : les derniers trésors d'un géant de pierre
The Space Between Stars
items.overview: An acrophobic suicide jumper and a hitman pick the same rooftop to end a life.

items.title: Project Eggman
items.overview: The untold backstory of one of gaming's greatest villains, Doctor Eggman

items.title: Larnaca
items.overview: After embarking on a sailing trip on the way to their wedding in Larnaca, Ruth and Yona find themselves stranded at sea with no wind in their sails. As they wait for conditions to change, Ruth's past resurfaces.

items.title: Suspiro
items.overview: A bakery cashier who can’t cook decides to bake meringue cookies to confess her love to the boy she likes on Valentine’s Day.

items.title: Out of Service
items.overview: Good Friday, north of Athens. A young drummer walks out on the far-right politician who keeps him and ends up at a bus stop where every bus that passes reads Out of Service.

items.title: Come Over
items.overview: A triptych of intimate encounters where the same invitation, ‘come over’, sparks three entirely different expectations. Each scenario reveals the consequences of miscommunication, all shot in single, unbroken takes.

items.title: Rightleft
items.overview: Sofia lives with her grandmother, who has dementia and no longer recognises her. To maintain their closeness, she pretends to be someone different every day. When her neighbour – with whom she has been in a casual romantic relationship – invites her to move with him to Germany, Sofia finds herself facing an almost impossible choice.

items.title: Retour gagnant pour la cuisine d'antan
DEADLINE
items.overview: In a crowded waiting room, a nervous young man watches other people around him talk vaguely about some kind of deadline. A secretary calls them in one by one.

items.title: Lobsters
items.overview: Surrounded by his best friends for a bachelor party at the family vacation home, Sami runs into a childhood friend who accuses him of abusing her a few years earlier. Throughout the weekend, Sami navigates his own conscience, sometimes misguided, sometimes pushed around by his friends. To recognize the truth, he will have to break through and abandon his shell.

items.title: the Air Purifier Jester
items.overview: An absurdist dogma-breaking tale of a Jester enslaved to his fixation on Air Purifiers. Society's indifference towards jesters and clowns threatens his existential, provocative lifestyle.

items.title: Never Too Late
items.overview: Centers on a married couple in their 80s who decide to divorce, which proves shocking news to the small country-town community of Huaihua in Hunan province. Director Yang, who is their granddaughter, unpicks the story behind the separation and a marriage that began 60 years ago through matchmaking.

items.title: A Town Called Needville
items.overview: Told through 35mm photographs and first-person narration, A TOWN CALLED NEEDVILLE traces the filmmaker's four-month inpatient stay at an all-women’s mental health facility in Needville, Texas.

items.title: Return to Bloom
items.overview: Kazuki visits Bohol Island with his girlfriend, Sara. After spending happy days together, Sara suddenly disappears one morning. As Kazuki searches across the island, he senses a mysterious connection between Sara and the island’s nature, eventually leading him toward an eternal truth.

items.title: Dark Wizard of Hyeongwang Villa
items.overview: Dai, a middle school student, wants to curse the person responsible for killing Norangi, a stray cat he dearly loved. With the help of Belzerok, a conversational AI, he attempts to summon Nekphoros, the legendary great demon of cats. However, his devout Catholic grandmother, Gyeongja, who lives with him, keeps interfering with the summoning ritual.

items.title: String
items.overview: Manuela Quispe (Camila Saettone) lands a career defining interview with local musician Leo (Duncan Torres) as she becomes the target of an anonymous stalker with a specific interest in her past.

items.title: Tatt00
items.overview: Waking up with no memory just a tattoo that changes, turns into a race against time to find out what it means.

items.title: TOMORROW(?)
items.overview: A guy spends a night out with his childhood best friend for what seems like the last time.

items.title: Meat the Future
items.overview: Tommy Watanabe, a kind-hearted but naïve Japanese yakiniku chef in Taiwan, believes that good food can make the world better. When a cynical teenager tells him to “become president and fix society,” Tommy takes it literally and launches an unlikely grassroots campaign. As his sincerity attracts public attention, a conman exploits Tommy’s trust and steals campaign donations, forcing him to confront the harsh realities behind idealism and politics.

items.title: Light Memories
items.overview: In the family of photographer-turned-filmmaker Misha Vallejo no one ever talks about his grandfather. He only hears about him for the first time as an adult, thanks to an abandoned photo collection. Who was this shadow? And what legacy looms over the family? In his debut film Light Memories, Vallejo shows how the effects of neglect can persist across generations.

items.title: The Bride
items.overview: Undead Elizabeth searches for her husband, for whom she was crafted.

items.title: Just Out of Reach
items.overview: A teenage boy finds himself on a delusional journey in search of a missing piece of a letter left to him by his grandfather.

items.title: FYRE 2: The Billy McFarland Story
items.overview: A behind-the-scenes documentary following Billy McFarland's attempt to revive the notorious FYRE Festival. From preparations, negotiations and setbacks surrounding FYRE 2 to his subsequent ventures in the Caribbean, the film explores the complicated pursuit of a comeback landing him on the small island of Utila in Honduras.

items.title: Uncle, Where Are You Going?
items.overview: A peculiar journey begins on Jeju Island. The artists transform into Sim Bong-sa and Ppaengdeok Eomeoni, slipping into a playful parody of The Tale of Simcheong, where reality and performance blur. A philosophical yet joyful road movie about failed artists restoring themselves.

items.title: IRUL
items.overview: A boy receives mysterious calls and warnings from unknown number, only to discover that something has entered his locked room—and he is already gone.

items.title: Calexico
items.overview: Ash, a 28-year-old Chinese American and rebellious aspiring artist, escapes her family's expectations. He travels to Calexico, a border town in California, where he forms a close bond with Lo, a Mexican student who crosses the border to deliver flowers to his uncle's florist in the United States. Both are stuck in limbo – living castaways in a foreign country, facing social pressures, family expectations, and questions about identity. During the last day together, they are forced to define their relationship.

items.title: Goddess Of Wealth
items.overview: Set in a small town in India during the festival of Diwali, Dhan Ki Devi follows a day in the life of a child influencer, Ayesha, whose parents have unintentionally traded her innocence in pursuit of social media fame. Using Goddess Lakshmi as a metaphor, the film critiques the commodification of children and the silent loss of childhood in the age of likes and shares.

items.title: Vampires Surf
items.overview: Three immortal vampire girls have spent centuries surfing beneath the moon. When fate changes, they leave the shadows behind and become legends amongst mortals. But the return of the Blood Moon summons them to Coffin Bay, where an ancient prophecy and a powerful evil will decide their future. Spooky, funny and heartfelt, Vampires  Surf is a timeless tale of surfing, friendship and following your destiny—even if it takes an eternity.

items.title: Take Care Of Me
items.overview: A woman finally receives her immigration approval to join her husband abroad, but her dog’s severe respiratory condition makes it impossible for him to travel. Caught between leaving her loyal companion behind or giving up the life she has long awaited, she faces a painful and deeply human choice.

items.title: The Invitation
items.overview: A cryptic email leads to a "world" beyond imagination.

items.title: Burn It All
items.overview: A young couple, determined to build their future on land confiscated from the Mafia, find themselves fighting an enemy challenging their very notion of resistance and love. A tense, straight horror that will leave you on the edge of your seat.

items.title: Dancing Queen
items.overview: Cas is an excellent student who is constantly praised for her achievements, all the while secretly bearing the heavy burden of the problems she carries.

items.title: Mutiny
items.overview: At the end of the War of Spanish Succession in 1713, the captain of a privateering vessel faces a difficult confrontation with his disgruntled crew.

items.title: Hidden Colors 6: The Culture of Resistance
items.overview: Hidden Colors 6 examines overlooked stories of Black American resistance, resilience, innovation and cultural survival.

items.title: Nation Wants to Guess: Battle of the Champions
items.overview: Anirban Dasgupta, Shreeja Chaturvedi and Rahul Subramanian with host Gursimran Khamba open Season 2 with questions on a goat shortage in Kashmir, camel passports in Saudi Arabia and waiters dressed like lawyers, then face a blindfolded round of guessing fictional characters.

items.title: MLW Saturday Night SuperFight 2026
items.overview: Saturday Night SuperFight marks MLW’s return to pay-per-view for the first time in seven years and represents the biggest premium live event on the league’s 2026 calendar.

items.title: Saudade
items.overview: A baseball passes through different hands, connecting people and moments along the way.

items.title: Tingatinga Between Two Homes
items.overview: An orphaned painter returns from China to his native Tanzania for a wedding, with warmth and gentle humour.

items.title: Читка пьесы
items.overview: The events in the play take place back in the 1980s and are based on the documentary accounts of those who took part—a group that includes the legendary Dmitry Alexandrovich Prigov, the play’s central figure.

items.title: Birthday Candles
items.overview: Kamran Baxşızadə went to fight as a volunteer in the Second Nagorno-Karabakh War in the autumn of 2020. In a battle that coincided with his birthday, he lost his sight. The film begins where the war news ends: a young man returns home – to a world he can no longer see – and must learn everything anew, from the space around him to the question of what to do with his life now. The camera follows him through his everyday life, which is not heroic but tests his tenacity and endurance. The film observes how hope and stubbornness build a life where it seems impossible.

items.title: Tokyo, Outsider
items.overview: As boundaries and relationships continue to shift subtly, young people drift on the cusps of "outsider" and "insider", wandering between the foreign and the familiar.

items.title: Ninja Skooler
items.overview: Rappa is an orphan who idolizes fictional ninja. One snowy night, he falls from a rooftop and is saved by a real ninja named Okachimachi and his master. Rappa turns up at their door asking to become an apprentice, and the three begin living together as a family. Years later, Rappa throws himself into training to become a ninja who can protect the town. The children who look up to him gather at the master's traditional Japanese candy shop, a place where he can laugh with family and friends. Rappa thinks these days will last forever, but he sees Okachimachi tending to their retired master and catches a glimpse of the pain the master has kept hidden...

items.title: Milk
items.overview: A tooth extraction introduces a watchful child to his mother’s new love. In Milk, tenderness turns grotesque, ordinary gestures uncanny, and love unfolds as a tale equal parts sweet and unsettling.

items.title: La vente secrète des juifs de Roumanie
Par 4 chemins
items.overview: In the 12th century, Brother Antoine and Brother Vincent decide to leave the monastery to return to the world and help people find joy. Filled with enthusiasm, they encounter all kinds of situations on a journey that transforms into a voyage of initiation.

items.title: Goodbye, Ren
items.overview: At a quiet beach, a Christian-convert meets a teenager who knows of his dark past. The encounter leads to a series of disorienting events.

items.title: La foil histoire de la Route du Rhum
Lucky
items.overview: Tess is minutes into a blind date when the world suddenly falls apart. Should she accept Sebastian's offer to escape to his remote island? It would mean leaving behind everyone she loves for an uncertain future with a stranger. It might also be her only chance to survive. She's got six minutes to decide.

items.title: The World Comes Home
items.overview: As Flight PR2002 flies home, an unexpected occurrence happens in this wacky suspenseful comedy.

items.title: MADE IN X
items.overview: Blending raw documentary realism with surreal, stylised dreamscapes, MADE IN X follows a young immigrant navigating life on the margins of a society that sees her as a label before a person. From workplace microaggressions to housing discrimination, her daily struggles are interwoven with poetic sequences where traditional garments, textures, and memories become tools of resistance and an escape. As fashion transforms into a language of identity and protest, the film explores how origin defines worth - not only for fashion items, but for people as well.

items.title: The Gloom
items.overview: A social worker witnesses some disturbing events. She decides to trust her intuition and find answers to the questions that trouble her.

items.title: Les grands buffets, bouillon : les coulisses des plus grands restaurants
Treading Water
items.overview: Treading Water is a short film directed by Takashi Ogawa, selected for the competitive Asian Students' Film Conference section of the 39th Tokyo International Film Festival, where it will have its world premiere.

items.title: We Lift Each Other
items.overview: Follows North Carolina-based modern dance company Black Box Dance Theatre and their work with Veterans, giving them the courage to step into a creative process that fosters trust, healing, and resilience.

items.title: A Virada
items.overview: The documentary portrays the great popular mobilizations and social participation that culminated in the election of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in 2026, addressing the democracy and future of Brazil from the perspective of the collective organization. The narrative focuses behind the scenes of the last 21 days of the campaign of the second round, detailing the impact of million of votes, the militancy and mobilization strategies in the streets and digital networks.

items.title: Some Like It Hot
items.overview: A short documentary about the magnificent madness of the Finnish sauna culture, in which no place is too strange, too small, or too dangerous to build a sauna.

items.title: Forever Home
items.overview: Forever HOME  follows a young couple’s dream to provide the best possible life for rescued farm animals by rethinking the concept of “home.” At their refuge, they base their designs on the needs of the individual animals, replacing conventional barns with customized homes. Paul, an architect, calls it "animal centered design." With empathy and boundless imagination, they’re bringing architectural design to the world of animal care and providing a blueprint for a compassionate, sustainable future. This unique film is a celebration of life and creativity!

items.title: Scatterbrain
items.overview: Scatterbrain by VULGUS365

items.title: Crunch Point: Hunger and Hardship in Food Bank Britain
items.overview: Through intimate interviews and animation, people experiencing food insecurity in the UK share the journeys, stigma and realities behind food bank use, revealing a hunger crisis that could affect anyone.

items.title: The Disco Dancer's Dead
items.overview: The producer of a hit disco TV show arrives on the day of the premiere to find the star dead in his dressing room. Detective Brooks, a persistent investigator with an exceptional sense of smell, must interrogate the crew of the show to find the truth. However, as their stories unfold, she finds everyone has something to hide in this 70s inspired comedy murder mystery.

items.title: Manual for (un) Inhabiting a Body
items.overview: A film essay based on the reappropriation of family photographs and videos that explores the relationship between images, the memories created from them, the words we are called by, and the gender roles assigned to us.

items.title: The Fourth Cut
items.overview: Planning a heist.

items.title: Christmas Owes Me Nothing
items.overview: From Fruit Bearing Studios comes a heartfelt holiday story about family, forgiveness, and finding hope in the most unexpected places. Christmas Owes Me Nothing follows two families navigating grief, broken relationships, financial hardship, and the pressures of the holiday season, only to discover that the true meaning of Christmas cannot be found in gifts, appearances, or tradition. As lives intersect through one unexpected opportunity, long-buried wounds begin to heal and hearts once hardened by disappointment are reminded that love, grace, and redemption still have the power to restore what seemed lost. Set against the warmth and tension of the holiday season, this uplifting drama blends heartfelt emotion, faith, humor, and community into a powerful story about second chances and the realization that sometimes the greatest gift is simply being seen, loved, and forgiven.

items.title: Taranta
items.overview: Taranta is a portrait of the world surrounding the Santana factory in Linares, following its inhabitants as the city undergoes an unusual process of re-industrialization. The film follows four young people, two from Linares and two Chinese engineers, just as the old Santana factory, a symbol of the city, reopens. In this context, the protagonists debate whether to stay and embrace the new industrial era or leave, carrying with them working-class pride, memories of decline, and generational distrust.

items.title: METALVERSE #3 - GARDEN OF EDEN
items.overview: This release is METALVERSE's first live video work, capturing their solo concert "METALVERSE #3 - GARDEN OF EDEN". Furthermore, it includes many songs that have not been released digitally, making it a special release that allows viewers to check out songs they haven't been able to see or hear before. This release captures the energetic performance of MIKO, SAKIA, and COCONA from METALVERSE, who "appeared" before a sold-out, packed audience. Also noteworthy are the incredible playing of HAL-CA (g/ASTERISM), Li-sa-X (g/KOIAI), Yunika Impact (b/Kakumei Meroik, KOIAI), and Fuwawa (dr/Kakumei Meroik), who participated as part of the girls' band project METALVERSE VΛND PROJECT (MVP).

items.title: Three Comrades
items.overview: Two Ukrainian teenagers and one Russian begin adult lives in France, where war divides and loneliness connects them.

items.title: The Grizzlie Truth
items.overview: To die-hard fans of NBA franchise, the Vancouver Grizzlies, like filmmaker Kat Jayme, the team’s abrupt move to Memphis in 2001 is much more than a sore spot, it’s an unsolved mystery and possibly a criminal conspiracy. What begins as a superfan’s investigation into her hometown team’s disappearance, becomes a love letter to the worst professional sports franchise in history, and an exploration of the deep roots of fandom.

items.title: Nail Polish
items.overview: A young woman, confined by the claustrophobic walls of her room, forms an intrusive thought and quickly spirals into a frenzy of overindulgence and self-destruction.

items.title: The Big Nothing
items.overview: A delusional crime scene cleaner searches for a way out of the life, an impossible feat in the face of his vengeful boss.

items.title: In-Between
items.overview: Wynn’s life has been consumed by the search for his sister’s killer, little does he know, they found him first.

items.title: Where Are the Pigeons ?
items.overview: Victor, a passionate birdwatcher, is convinced that all the pigeons have vanished. When he meets Abby, a photographer, there’s no doubt for him : she is the mastermind behind their disappearance. What follows is a duel between Abby's budding love and Arthur's growing paranoia, where everything is held together by a feather.

items.title: República Da Traição: O Filme Nunca Lançado
It's A Very Naughty Nasty Nathaniel Wanker Christmastime Dream: The Holiday Special: The Movie
items.overview: Nasty Nathaniel Wanker only has one night, to change his fate before Christmas light, through the trials he must pass, to learn that being naughty isn't meant to last, and as Santa watches with a sigh, he'll have to prove himself before Christmas night flies by.

items.title: Łódź Fabryczna
items.overview: Short hypnotizing documentary about the train station and it’s problems.

items.title: Grace Comes Crashing
items.overview: As a strange red lichen spreads across the countryside, Geryon confronts the emergence of sexual desire and an animal metamorphosis that drives him to flee into the mountains.

items.title: Klaus Nomi - Chanteur du troisième type
Estigio
items.overview: Obsessed with her parents' death, Julita convinces her friends Pino and Elisa to contact them through a Ouija board, only to find something darker waiting.

items.title: Escape Routes
items.overview: Adapted from a short story by Lucy Caldwell. In 1990s Belfast, a lonely young girl becomes entranced by her teenage babysitter, who introduces her to the computer game ‘Zork’ and a brief, bright world of secret codes, imagination, and escape.

items.title: Let Me Go
items.overview: Following a death in the family Anna must confront her past in order to carve her future

items.title: The Space Between Myself and Myself
items.overview: A young soul called "The Self" recollects the memory of his past while having an ego death in a possible future.

items.title: Nathan
items.overview: When an ordinary situation takes an unexpectedly dramatic turn, one name becomes the centre of everything: Nathan. This cinematic comedy transforms a simple internet joke into an unnecessarily intense motion picture, complete with dramatic storytelling, questionable decisions, and absolutely zero explanation.

items.title: Bwgan
items.overview: Six-year-old Betti isn't used to sharing her Mam, especially on her birthday. But when a baking disaster sends them into town for a new cake, an unwelcome gatecrasher turns a simple trip into an unexpectedly difficult adventure.

items.title: The Wallet
items.overview: Two Florida gangsters Vinny and Pauly kidnap nerdy tech kid Teddy in search for his crypto Wallet. The Question isn't if he hid it, but where he hid the Wallet.

items.title: Pallavi
items.overview: A troubled writer finds himself drawn into an intense confrontation with Pallavi, who demands answers about a tragic incident and the justice she has been denied. As their conversation unfolds, an unexpected phone call and a series of unsettling events blur the boundaries between reality and illusion. Haunted by guilt and helplessness, the writer faces a heartbreaking truth that reveals the devastating consequences of delayed justice.

items.title: Could Have
items.overview: Your eyelids could have been a fortress  for those beautiful eyes of yours.  You could have seen once more  how far the traces of your footsteps had reached.

items.title: Article
items.overview: Local sleuth Vigilante The Article, aka Erik Schiller, known for stopping crimes from a distance with his trusty camera, is stuck in a rut. Unsure of what to do with himself. But he has bigger problems, such as somebody prying into his life...

items.title: Videotape
items.overview: A cinematic essay about an interrupted film, using footage found within the walls of a gated community, documenting the living dead.

items.title: Prange 2 - Man ist ja jetzt Paar
items.overview: Half a year has passed since Ralf Prange confessed his love to the woman of his dreams, Dörte, on New Year’s Eve. Now everyday life is setting in, and Prange feels like he’s losing control on all fronts. But Prange’s spirit of resistance has been awakened. With the help of his neighbor Horst, he hatches plans that are bound to lead to disaster...

items.title: Letter from a Tree to Humans
items.overview: COP31 Climate-Themed Short Film Competition finalist. Synopsis TBA.

items.title: My Dyslexic Mind
items.overview: A journey of acceptance, growth, and confidence within a mind with dyslexia, revealing the cracks of inaccessibility embedded in the education systems.

items.title: How Would You End It
items.overview: Desperate for attention, a social misfit dials a suicide prevention line, only to reach a counselor with a twisted hobby of pushing callers to end it.

items.title: Maintaining Normalcy
items.overview: After a college teen is told he might have a rare case of male breast cancer, he tries to continue living his life normally with the dread of that possibility while he patiently waits for his results.

items.title: Blame It on the Movies
items.overview: During a therapy session, a tormented young man reconstructs his life story, which has been marked by abandonment. Just as he reaches his most intimate moment, a film director interrupts to halt the scene, blurring the lines between truth and fiction.

items.title: Under the Peach Trees: The Story of the Hochstetler Family
items.overview: A massive family association gathers hundreds of people from across the country to celebrate their common ancestor: An Amishman named Jacob Hochstetler. Living on the frontier of the French and Indian War, this family’s faith is tested as they are attacked, kidnapped, and adopted into a new way of living that would change the family forever.

items.title: Anaimia
items.overview: A pregnant woman selling her home is haunted by bizarre cravings. After a night of binge eating, the Seller must hide herself, and a half eaten bag of mulch, as a Realtor takes a terminally ill Buyer on a tour of The House.

items.title: Remy
items.overview: For more than twenty years, Remy has investigated cases for New York City’s Department of Homeless Services while quietly pursuing the dream that never left him: becoming an impressionist painter.

items.title: Beam
items.overview: Yoonjae orders a Tsai Ming-Liang DVD, but an adult video arrives with it. When he visits the store to ask what happened, he meets Juwon. Beyond their awkward distance, the two begin to fill the empty spaces in each other’s lives.

items.title: Trapiá, Um Outro Sertão
items.overview: In the heart of the hinterlands of Paraíba, in Northeast Brazil, trapiá is the name of a tree that defies both the sun and the drought. This documentary portrays a rural community in the midst of a transition away from a traditional way of life. Its subjects endure the setbacks of existence: stories of heartbreak and loneliness, but also of joy and resilience.

items.title: Aim For The Bushes
items.overview: 686 presents Aim For The Bushes, directed and filmed by Oliver Hoblitzelle. The film follows Jake Mageau, Parker White, Dakota Connole, Oscar Weary and Charlie Gnoza as they seek out new and lesser-known spots, approaching each in ways only a skier’s mind can. Aim For The Bushes captures a shared pursuit of creativity, progression and the

items.title: Bhāvāntara
items.overview: Rooted in real-world human emotions and sacred traditions, a poignant story unfolds around the transgender experience, blending scripted narrative with unscripted footage from the vibrant Koovagam Festival.

items.title: Hermetica
items.overview: When a man goes missing from her district, solitary Irene agrees to meet with an investigator. What begins as a routine inquiry gradually turns into something more unsettling, drawing Irene into a surreal night where the boundaries between the investigation and her own past begin to blur.

items.title: Some Other Place
items.overview: Esther is back in her rural Utah hometown with one intent only: to break into her parents' house. She desperately needs her identifying documents in order to legally change her name and gender before it’s made illegal. Along the way she recruits her old friend and only ally in town - Markus - to assist her. Between the break-in and navigating Markus's intentions, she doesn't intend to stay long.

items.title: Tadej Pogacar: Anatomy of a G.O.A.T.
items.overview: Through expert analysis and first-hand insights, this documentary examines the genetics, mindset and team support that have helped make Tadej Pogačar one of cycling's most successful riders.

items.title: Mañero
items.overview: At a forgotten roadside motel, Silvio and Luisa lead a routine life until Aldo arrives, a desperate man searching for his missing son.

items.title: Atheer
items.overview: In a quiet market, a perfume seller is given a few bottles by a mysterious old woman. As customers begin to react in unexpected ways, his curiosity turns into unease, leading him to follow her into the unknown.

items.title: Trunkload
items.overview: A jaded used car salesman, under the threat of losing his job, struggles to find a car for his most difficult client yet: A group of circus clowns.

items.title: The Crack
items.overview: Religious rift enters into a small group of Hijras and threatens to break the tradition of a centuries old marginal practice. However, compassion wins in the end.

items.title: Piojo
items.overview: In the near future, a father must confront his spirituality when the authorities use a new technology to take his son from him.

items.title: Amor de padre
items.overview: Cayetana's father is about to die. She went to their family home to say her last goodbye, but their relationship has always been a disaster, and the farewell won't end too well.

items.title: Acrophobia
items.overview: This Psychology Horror Film about Man who has Acrophobia in lunch time in school, While he was trying climb stairs, he was too scare so he backup to rest but he find someone standing and later Man who has Acrophobia regret and cry in bathroom.

items.title: Bad Habit
items.overview: A medieval convent is thrown into chaos when one of their nuns mysteriously disappears.

items.title: I was Made by Clay
items.overview: A stop-motion short film.

items.title: MGP: The Untamed Circuit
items.overview: This film centers on the 2025 Macau Grand Prix, telling the story of world-famous racers competing on the Guia Circuit. It also weaves together the history of the 72 editions of the event, showing the changes and constants of the Macau Grand Prix, and highlighting the development achievements of China’s automotive industry and motorsport events.

items.title: Kakek
items.overview: Ferdi is haunted by terrifying visions and decides to visit his Indonesian grandfather Lex in search of answers, awakening long-suppressed trauma from their colonial past. A wonderful film about hereditary guilt.

items.title: Between the Herds
items.overview: COP31 Climate-Themed Short Film Competition finalist. Synopsis TBA.

items.title: grass is always greener
items.overview: Last winter, Forster Meeks, Andrew Branch, Chase Mohrman, and Sam Lobinski set out in search of untapped spots across Japan, Poland, and the Midwest. Safe to say they found some heavy ones along the way.

items.title: Obsession Obsession
items.overview: Everyone loves Obsession. Except Eddie. When his friends Brad and Callum find out, Brad takes this into his own hands...

items.title: Bananafish
items.overview: A trip to the nearby shop takes an unexpected turn for eight-year-old Maks when his grandfather, who has dementia, decides to go looking for a woman he once loved.

items.title: Frankenstonya
items.overview: Following a mysterious disappearance, actress Tônya Frank reemerges in the public eye transformed: new look, new persona, and starring in the latest film by the unknown underground director Victor. On the Jorge Borges Show, she unleashes biting commentary on Brazilian cinema as she recounts the journey behind her metamorphosis.

items.title: Sympathy for the Virgin
items.overview: Struck by a sudden Annunciation, Seokmo, a virgin, visits a gynecology clinic seeking an illegal abortion.

items.title: Louve, une vie dans les Alpes
Wanderer
items.overview: WANDERER is a religious action thriller set in an alternate, dystopian future where the United States has been disbanded and divided into eight individual factions. A lone wanderer journeys across these factions, carrying a forbidden item: a Holy Bible. Hunted relentlessly by faction leaders and their military forces, the Wanderer uses the Word of God to spread hope among the oppressed citizens and fight back against the evil forces controlling them.

items.title: Abílio
items.overview: The story follows a misunderstood man who is placed in an impossible situation by his own family, exploring themes such as loneliness, human cruelty, and unrequited love.

items.title: Awkwardness
items.overview: In just a few seconds, it can be an awkwardness between two people who avoid facing each other.

items.title: To the Last Drop
items.overview: Plagued by nightmares, Joel is handed an impossible assignment. The Boss wants a new fix, but in the ruined world there is nothing left to collect. Wandering across the apocalyptic wasteland, Joel stumbles upon sunburnt Maarit, who decides to tag along. Back at HQ, The Boss, wracked by withdrawal, gives Joel an earful, while Maarit unexpectedly takes matters into her own hands.

items.title: Wrapped in Wool
items.overview: On a cold snowy winter day, Bernadette, a sweet lonely older woman sits alone in her warm but quiet house. Surrounded by empty sofas, wool and knitting needles, she feels useless and longs for someone to knit for, to look after and to love. Until a frozen puppy suddenly appears at her front door.

items.title: Half Order
items.overview: Filmed and directed by Eric “Remrod” Mayes and co written by Warren Armour, the film dives into the world of St. Louis style fried rice, neighborhood chop sueys, St. Paul sandwiches, and Vess sodas while uncovering the traditions that shaped generations across the city.  Through raw conversations, cinematic storytelling, and an original soundtrack, HALF ORDER explores identity, nostalgia, and the cultural connections built through shared neighborhood experiences. More than a documentary about Chinese food, HALF ORDER is a heartfelt portrait of St. Louis, its people, and the culture that continues to connect them.

items.title: Le bruit intérieur des choses
items.overview: Sophie and her partner Alex have a meeting with a man who might be able to help Sophie fulfill her dream of motherhood, but things don't go as planned.

items.title: Every Stadium Counts - The groundhoppers from Braunschweig
items.overview: Groundhopping with a twist: a local league team from Braunschweig plays in abandoned stadiums, bringing these forgotten football temples back to life one last time.

items.title: Pactum
items.overview: Six high-society women gather in a mansion bound by a secret pact, a pact one of them has broken and whose consequences will be disastrous. Who is the traitor?

items.title: Johnny Jokester: an Atticus the SD Card special!
items.overview: Johnny Jokester cracks some jokes

items.title: Live through this
items.overview: Jane Remover offers a candid look into the realities of touring as a musician. This documentary follows the behind-the-scenes moments, travel experiences, and performances that define life on the road, balancing the pressures of fame with the artistic dedication required for live shows.

items.title: nothing.
items.overview: a moment passes. a memory remains. somewhere between time and memory, moments come and go.  a quiet journey along the Baltic Sea. nothing to explain. nothing to hold on to. just the passing of time.

items.title: Mother Duck
items.overview: A self-perceived failing mother yearns for a connection with her son, only to find it even more challenging when he forms an inseparable bond with a duckling.

items.title: Pūtaringa
items.overview: Follow Pete as he explores the struggles of an overwhelming new environment and finds comfort in the small things that remind him of home.

items.title: Las orejas no tienen párpados
items.overview: Mariela unexpectedly reunites with her first boyfriend, Leandro, when an old book she dedicated to him decades earlier finds its way back into her hands. As a love that has lingered for over 30 years is rekindled, Leandro must make a decision.

items.title: ENDGAME: Trump’s Midterns
items.overview: Trump's midterms: Democracy under threat in America. From Washington DC to Mississippi, South Carolina, New York, Tennessee and Colorado, Four Corners reporter Mark Willacy investigates whether the greatest threat to the elections comes from within the Trump administration itself. Donald Trump may not be on the ballot, but the election is a referendum on his presidency. With his approval rating at a record low, Trump is rallying his MAGA base, warning of electoral fraud and impeachment if the Democrats take control of Congress. Former Trump insiders are sounding the alarm over efforts to undermine confidence in the vote, including the prospect of ICE agents being deployed at polling places. Their warning: a desperate president could go to extraordinary lengths to cling to power.

items.title: Souly - Braths Session - ARTE Concert
items.overview: As part of the Braths Sessions, a string orchestra led by musician and composer Braths transforms Souly’s distinctive blend of rap, pop, and R&B into an intense live experience. An exclusive encounter filled with surprising musical moments.

items.title: Nosce te ipsum
items.overview: Andjelija is a high school girl who is trying to find herself, her style, and her own identity by looking up to the people around her.

items.title: Krypto Saves the Day!: Tales of Puppy Past
items.overview: A holiday scrapbook sends Superman and Supergirl reminiscing about puppy Krypto's earliest Christmases on Earth.

items.title: His Daughter
items.overview: Based on the life of Susan Atkins, who was forced to step into the role of a parent for her younger brother while her own home was broken by her parents' alcoholism and the death of her mother, this is how the constant struggle and the lack of a support system led her to trade one form of survival for a much darker, more destructive life that became her permanent reality.

items.title: The Torch
items.overview: Meira foregrounds the historic and continuing resistance of the Meira Paibi, “women with torches” of Manipur. Emerging in response to the pervasive climate of fear produced by the enforcement of the Armed Forces (Special Powers) Act, 1958, the film traces how ordinary women transformed themselves into vigilant custodians of their communities. Meira situates the movement within a longer genealogy of women-led resistance in Manipur.

items.title: Forgotten War
items.overview: Narrated by Steve Paikin, Forgotten War explores post-World War II conflicts through the eyes of Canadian veterans. This is an existing TVO-produced series, edited into an hour-long program and includes conflicts in Korea, Afghanistan, Cyprus, and the former Yugoslavia.

items.title: User Not Found
items.overview: During his live selling, Sebbie receives an unexpected comment from a mysterious stranger. As the messages grow more personal, he is drawn into an unsettling encounter that stirs something long buried within him and leaving him with one haunting question... who is on the other side of the screen, and why does it feel like he has been waiting for them all his life?

items.title: School Assignment
items.overview: A school boy cannot think what to write in an essay assignment about spring. His father cannot come up with any new ideas either.

items.title: Angélique Kidjo à la Philharmonie de Paris
Behind Our Eyes
items.overview: Lucy finds herself drawn to her best friend in a way she feels she shouldn't. What does she feel, and what does this mean for their friendship?

items.title: Zdrowaśki
items.overview: A poetic coming-of-age, in which the characters drift through memories, searching for a place in a world that constantly casts them aside. An intimate, indie-aesthetic story about reminiscences preserved on camera, lost and regained bonds and people learning to grow up within a space lacking both home and the assurance that anyone is waiting for their return.

items.title: On the Wings of Time
items.overview: Two college graduates grapple the progression of time.

items.title: Resurrecting the Night
items.overview: The Film explores the inner world of artist Ma Wei-a small town-scene trapped in eternal night. Initially, there were only dull spectators, flat characters and Ma Wei herself, paralyzed by a creative crisis. Everything changes when her own creation, He Ling, gains free will. Between the creator and the work begins a fascinating struggle. Through the collision of illusion and hard reality, he Ling breaks the narrative shackles, and Ma Wei undergoes spiritual liberation, embarking on a new artistic journey.

items.title: In Plaster
items.overview: In Plaster is an experimental short film that expresses layered and fractured identity through physical brush strokes of paint on canvas

items.title: Coroliocus, Unfortunately
items.overview: A tyrannical wizard forgets his name.

items.title: La Muerte Es Renacer
items.overview: "La Muerte Es Renacer" is about inner story from Latin Culture.

items.title: Mizrahi Mismatch
items.overview: Judith and Menahem met in 1959, and wed within weeks. They are fire and water, ghormeh sabzi and gachun, yet somehow have survived 67 years together.

items.title: My Friend, Kev
items.overview: A filmmaker reconnects with an old friend, quietly revealing the distance time can create.

items.title: Eye to Eye
items.overview: Tyler wakes up with the ability to read others’ minds upon making eye contact, but must immediately say their thoughts out loud. Now he and his friend Brick must get rid of the curse.

items.title: "KABOOM!"
items.overview: In the city of Newcastle, an ordinary idiot gets given a bomb by a terrorist. Now it's up to him to dispose of it and save everyone!

items.title: The Labyrinth
items.overview: A liminal tour of Brock University's infamous labyrinth-like Mackenzie Chown Complex.

items.title: Coeur de Louve
items.overview: In a future where criminals are sent into humain bodies, two prisoners try to retrieve their freedom.

items.title: Pessoal do Ceará - Lado A Lado B
items.overview: Pessoal do Ceará - Lado A Lado B explores the music scene from the Brazilian state of Ceará between 1969 and 1979 - a period marked by the military coup, the implementation of the AI-5 decree, and intense socio-political ferment. The focus is on the "Pessoal do Ceará" movement, which brought artists such as Fagner, Ednardo, and Belchior to prominence. Taking the 1973 álbum as a starting point, the work examines its common association with these three singers - even though, in reality, only Ednardo (alongside Rodger and Teti) is featured on it.

items.title: Dayshift
items.overview: While cleaning a pole dance studio, a middle-aged woman drifts from routine into reverie.

items.title: Sophie
items.overview: A young woman, isolated and recovering from a severe injury, finds herself battling a mysterious phenomenon as she’s hurtled towards a devastating realization.

items.title: Outra vez sonho aqui
items.overview: In her grandmother’s house, a young woman dreams. Through her relationship with the space and the objects kept there, long-held memories and feelings resonate.

items.title: Spaghetti
items.overview: A boy finds himself in a room.

items.title: TO REMA
items.overview: A Muslim girl lives in a Jewish household. The head of the family has adopted her and is deeply attached to her. As the girl grows up, events quickly escalate.

items.title: Forgiven
items.overview: Essence/interpretation of a prayer

items.title: Bon appetit
items.overview: The way to a man’s heart is through his stomach.

items.title: Our Songs
items.overview: For thirteen-year-old Michel, boundaries between childish imagination and adolescent reality begin to blur, when his older brother leaves the family. OUR SONGS explores the echoes of childhood in the everyday life of a mutigenerationioal family, telling the memory of a separation.

items.title: Smoking in the Desert
items.overview: A young dictator awakens in purgatory, where he encounters a mysterious, nearly blind old man who also turns out to be a dictator. Trapped in a strange space with no apparent way out, the two begin to unravel their relationship, gradually turning their encounter into a confrontation that will force each of them to confront their own sense of superiority.

items.title: Journey to the End of the Ego
items.overview: The scene is the almost mythical landscape of Ben Loyal, one of Scotland's most remote mountains towering over the Arctic Ocean. The cliff is one of the finest sweeps of clean unclimbed rock to be found anywhere in the land. The climber is the thought-provoking controversial live-wire, who goes by the name of Franco Cookson. This is the epic story of the UK's most dangerous trad route and the 105 days of climbing it took to realise one man's dream; 'Nothing is Lost' E12 7a.

items.title: Halcyon
items.overview: A short film consisting of entirely of natural sound and image. The footage shows still water, birds, ducks and shifting light through a quiet stretch of the day

items.title: The Foul-Mouthed Granny
items.overview: A man's loving memories of tending to his acerbic mother weave together remembrance, routine, and artistry in a lyrical reflection on familial bonds, loss, and generational connections.

items.title: I Think You're Hurting Them
items.overview: Through a series of real and imagined memories, a mourning woman reflects on her life and the person in the mirror that she doesn’t recognize.

items.title: Louder Than the Odds: The Mr. Smalls Story
items.overview: This documentary explores the long-awaited story of the survival and cultural impact of Mr. Smalls, a family-owned, independent music venue founded by Rusted Root’s Liz Berlin and pro skater Mike Speranzo. Blood, sweat, and tears went into turning the 18th-century Catholic church into a legendary music venue and community hub in Millvale, PA, and for over 25 years they have continued to beat the odds, including during the COVID-19 pandemic

items.title: The sea is not blue
items.overview: El mar no es azul explores the possibilities of the cinematic image through the textures and colors of videotape. Through fragments of perception and scenes of the sea, the work builds a world of dreamlike resonances that invites a meditative experience.

items.title: Der große Stasi-Leak - Helden oder Verräter
Féminin sacré : enquête sur des dérives sectaires
The Yellow Car
items.overview: A disabled student is relentlessly bullied by two of her classmates. One day, she accidentally gets murdered by one of the two classmates as part of a dangerous children's game and he tries his best to cover up her death, but it may not be as simple as it sounds...

items.title: Ways That I Have Died
items.overview: ‘When I was six, I fell into a well. Whether I ever got out, I couldn’t say.’  Based on a surrealist prose poem, Ways That I Have Died is one life story told through multiple deaths, following a melancholic and mortality-ridden road towards what it means to be alive.

items.title: Glass Sky
items.overview: When a girl sacrifices her dreams to care for her ailing father, she discovers his illness was a fabrication, and now must choose between the life she surrendered and the cage she built around herself.

items.title: Law of Human Action
items.overview: In a desolate, post-apocalyptic landscape, a nomad stumbles upon a rare relic of the old world.

items.title: DRAIN
items.overview: A man gets ready for the day

items.title: In Emptinesse There is No Form
items.overview: How can we document the form of energy in an era of energy transition? Through cinematic movements, the film unfolds as an inverse journey to Plato’s allegory of the cave̶descending instead towards a mine originally built during the communist period. There, the energies of geology, collective labor, industry, and spirit converge and accelerate, forming a meditation on materiality, transformation, and speed.

items.title: Carrascal
items.overview: The film tells the story of women in rural Brazil who, over the course of three generations (1970–2025), respond to violence and exclusion through strategies of cooperation and a sense of solidarity.

items.title: Taking a Chance
items.overview: Across three generations, a family’s life in racing unfolds through memories, archival footage and intimate interviews, revealing the highs, lows and triumphs behind a family-run passion.

items.title: God Bless, My Child
items.overview: When Thai immigrant Mali’s mother secretly converts from Buddhism to Christianity, she is left searching for what still remains between them; across culture, distance, and faith.

items.title: Try Your Luck
items.overview: As a woman enters the elevator of her building, she finds a die lying on a board on top of a pedestal with the phrase TRY YOUR LUCK engraved on it. She soon realizes that it is only by using the die, and not the elevator buttons, that she can move between floors.

items.title: PORTRAITS
items.overview: PORTRAITS is a meditation on the intersection of memory, art, and identity. The film follows Vik, a photographer who revisits his past with Meena, an artist at home in the undefined. Deconstructing the frames of their shared history, a quiet friction emerges between his drive for order and her grace in letting things drift.

items.title: All The Things We Haven't Done
items.overview: A lonely young man goes through an ordinary day while listening to a voice message, slowly rediscovering the small moments and connections that make life feel a little less empty.

items.title: This Happened Here
items.overview: Militants of Tierra y Libertad shot a film in 1970s Monterrey that was left unfinished. Through 8 mm, VHS and memories, Edén Bastida Kullick reconstructs its fragments.

items.title: The Corselet
items.overview: Inspired by Andrea Mantegna's 'The Triumphs of Caesar ', shot on 16mm and hand-processed using nettles from Cornish woodlands, this film acts as a follow-up to Dubieniec's eco-somatic debut short 'Moth Wood'

items.title: Three Left Feet
items.overview: Summer heat over the Adriatic. At the Kolovare pool in Zadar, the older boys rule with a testosterone-fuelled pecking order in which the slightly younger Lovre has yet to find his place. A look from a girl, a leap from the ten-metre board: what begins as a dare becomes the first step out of childhood.

items.title: Voice Message
items.overview: A young man living far from home ignores a voice message from his grandmother. When her condition worsens, he tries to make things right through work, money, and a plan to return home — only to realize that the simplest thing he avoided can no longer be done

items.title: Go For Orbit
items.overview: More than a dozen flight tests and years of development, with countless hours worked by SpaceX engineers and technicians, all come down to this: the first orbital Starship launch carrying advanced Starlink satellites bound for space. Watch “Go For Orbit” and experience the moments behind flying the most ambitious Starship mission yet.

items.title: The Tower
items.overview: On the eve of Eloise's college graduation, she receives an alarming tarot read that sends her down a spiral of bad luck.

items.title: Sunstrokes
items.overview: The hybrid film Sunstrokes portrays a group of young adults in Los Angeles, California, as they drift between parks, flats, and cars. By integrating documentary techniques with fictional interventions, the film explores the social interactions of its characters as they navigate their relationships and identities.

items.title: Royal Ballet & Opera 2026/27: Carmen
items.overview: Under the oppressive heat of the Spanish sun, the fiercely independent Carmen attracts the attention of Don José. She warns him not to fall in love with her, but his obsession knows no bounds. Damiano Michieletto’s searing production returns, casting scorching light on the lust, violence and destructive desire of Bizet’s ever-popular opera. An all-star cast brings this white-hot drama to life, with Ginger Costa-Jackson in the fiery title role, alongside Russell Thomas as the jealous and despairing Don José. Following his 2023 Royal Opera debut, Sesto Quatrini returns to conduct Bizet’s electrifying and sensual score.

items.title: Erinnerungen
items.overview: As she spins, the woman recalls the beautiful moments she shared with her partner, which causes her to break down.

items.title: The Bovannian Descent
items.overview: Filmed inside GTA: SA following the plot of a country named Bovannia, undergoing change in it's government continuously, but what is the change that really happens?

items.title: The Policewoman
items.overview: Former Victoria detective Narelle Fraser investigated some of Australia’s highest profile crimes. Her easy manner allowed her to gain rapport with many perpetrators, leading to their convictions… but it all came at a price. The constant daily exposure to horrific crime had a cumulative effect on Narelle’s mental health. She hid the effects for 27 years, but after suffering panic and amnesia, she received a diagnosis of PTSD, which forced her discharge from the Police. THE POLICEWOMAN illustrates the crimes that caused her descent into hell, and the battle to claw her way out. Narelle’s positive outcome in this true crime feature will demystify the stigma of mental health and speak to millions of first responders around the world.

items.title: O quarto no fim do corredor
The Hotline
items.overview: A suicidal hotline operator helps one last caller.

items.title: Hawla Ng Tigre
items.overview: After a humiliating loss, a young boxer fights to win his final match, but must overcome his father’s expectations and find his own way to fight.

items.title: Influen't
items.overview: An aspiring influencer struggles to balance friendship and ambition when he enters a famous streamer's competition

items.title: The Ooze
items.overview: A woman encounters a strange ooze emanating from her pantry.

items.title: Los portadores (heraldos neón)
items.overview: New short by Bruno Varela (Mexico City, 1971), an experimental film and found-footage artist based in Oaxaca.

items.title: "Ecce Homo!"
items.overview: The humiliation of being alive. A crushing, visceral response.

items.title: The Old Man and the Grave
items.overview: Set in late 19th century Korea, in a desolate cemetery, an old Gravedigger faces a life-threatening situation when a Dead man comes back to life from inside the coffin.

items.title: 산 MYO TEAMTAGE FIVE 산
items.overview: They said we couldn’t make it to five…  They were almost right…

items.title: Dear Henry: Our Fight for Justice
items.overview: Henry Nowak’s family speak for the first time.  In this documentary, they say they may have been “manipulated in their darkest hours” by both Hampshire and Isle of Wight Constabulary and the police watchdog in the months following his murder.  Bodycam footage shows the officers arresting Henry as he lay dying on the ground.  The family has spoken to ITV News’ UK Editor Paul Brand about the way Henry was treated and their own dealings with the police in the months after his death.

items.title: Every Grain of Dirt
items.overview: Every Grain of Dirt documents life in South Lebanon under ongoing threats of displacement and war. As sweeping evacuation orders force over a million people from their homes, some choose to remain. Among them is Ismail, a shepherd who refuses to leave his village — even as bulldozers arrive to erase it, nearly burying him alive as he stands in defiance before the machine.

items.title: The Tea Alchemist
items.overview: In the mountains of the Golden Triangle in Asia, The Tea Alchemist follows French tea expert Olivier Schneider on a journey to the origins of his work. For him, tea is not only something to drink, but an artistic medium: a way to touch time, memory, culture and emotion.  Between tea gardens, wide landscapes and morning mist, a search begins to take shape: an attempt to transform leaves into an experience that no money can buy and no language can fully describe.

items.title: Fabrica
items.overview: A collection of portraits from Drobeta-Turnu Severin and its surroundings.

items.title: Inventario de invisibles
items.overview: The project was developed in collaboration with scientists from CONICET and the National University of the Northeast, who have been conducting research in the area for over four decades. Together with them, we delved into the thresholds of other geological eras, exploring interspecies coexistence and dialogues.

items.title: Big and Large: A Basketball Story
items.overview: The story behind the intramural basketball team known as "Tha Biggest Tha Largest," a team made for the big fellas, and their road to the championship in their inaugural season.

items.title: CANS.
items.overview: CANS follows a heated rivalry between two top-dog local 10 cent can collectors. When “The Collector” is ‘set-up’ by her rival, “Blondie”, and loses all her cans, she hatches a plan to exact revenge on him.

items.title: Remembrance of Me
items.overview: A tragic story set in the 1890s of two young women in love who run away from society and find solitude in the countryside.

items.title: El cante roído de la excava
items.overview: Animated collage film by Andrea d'Arbel

items.title: C4-101
items.overview: Do you see the ghost?

items.title: Houden van Mij
items.overview: During a student date dinner, Casper meets Eline, a girl he has been set up with. While it's meant to be a fun and casual introduction, Casper hopes it might be the beginning of something more.

items.title: Naples, Florida
items.overview: The pure joy that makes the old home videos so enchanting is crushed by the mother's tired voice as she recalls that time. Though the Lithuanian filmmaker's family emigrated to Florida in 1997, their hopes for a better life remain unfulfilled.

items.title: I Will Try to Find You in the New System
items.overview: Years after their friend Alex went missing, Chris and Giada have been receiving strange videos from someone claiming to be him, and saying he needs to be found.

items.title: Affair with a Photocopy
items.overview: A couple must face that their relationship isn't what it used to be.

items.title: Kinship
items.overview: Embark on a global journey, with a seasoned world traveler as your guide, as we seek to understand our changing relationship with animals. With food, tradition, and innovation as our touchstones, we'll see what it means to leave behind exploitation in favor of compassion and kinship.

items.title: Fox
items.overview: An off-hand confession about ‘helping a fox’ turns a tipsy date night into a claustrophobic reckoning of mercy, reason, and the terrifying impossibility of knowing another person.

items.title: Faultline
items.overview: Charlie and Sage Jackson are growing up in a world where the rules don’t affect everyone equally. As their family faces pressures shaped by law and circumstance, the siblings must navigate questions of belonging, opportunity, and the futures available to them. Faultline is a social drama about the systems that shape young lives—and the people too often left out of the story.

items.title: A Night Tale
items.overview: In the turning of night and day, one girl stays awake; the other seems to have lost her words. They exchange with each other, and their silence—is she her companion, or her reflection? The city will wear away in time, but some frequency still lingers in the damp dark.

items.title: Asstral Rectuming
items.overview: THE END IS NEAR!!!  A group of three siblings prepare for the end of the world. However, after following the instructions of a cult leader, things begin to become more serious than imagined...

items.title: Director's Cut
items.overview: While filming an audition tape for a reality television show, Keith Thomas, a film nerd, goes camping in the woods, only to make a shocking discovery as to why the campsite is eerily quiet.

items.title: Walking in Circles: Shinjuku with Hisayasu Sato: Part 5
items.overview: Hisayasu Satô revisits the locations in Shinjuku where he shot the films featured on the Volume 5 anthology from Vinegar Syndrome.

items.title: Feral City
items.overview: A disgruntled Big City detective hunts down his prime suspect in a city known for nothing good.

items.title: Wolf's Egg
items.overview: A child growing up in the countryside is caught between the masculinity role imposed on them and the identity they find in fairy tales, while in real life also being forced to become a wolf.

items.title: Respite
items.overview: A young Danish man travels to Norway to clear out the house of his late mother, confronting the remains and the place. As he moves through unfamiliar surroundings, the film unfolds a story about family tensions, loss and belonging.

items.title: Garbage Man Stan
items.overview: A disgraced sanitation worker steals whatever treasures they can find from the garbage of suburbia. One day, they find an unlabeled bottle of pills that seem to unnaturally turn their life around.

items.title: GRITA, CON LA GARGANTA
items.overview: A young man waits for his date at a Tim Horton's cafeteria, without knowing that a strange creature is about to meet him.

items.title: Warm Blooded Animals
items.overview: Under vanilla skies, two dreamers lust for a life of freedom in a restless age of discontent. The young lovers stand at the precipice of adulthood, lingering on a stage in life where they could fade into oblivion or burst into flames.

items.title: A Summer in M.
items.overview: In 2005, in the heart of the Swiss countryside, Raphael spends his summer helping on his family’s tobacco farm. One evening, while anonymously browsing gay dating forums, he recognizes Jan, a Polish harvest worker he works with.

items.title: Ezzed'Jean
items.overview: COP31 Climate-Themed Short Film Competition finalist. Synopsis TBA.

items.title: Auto-Anxiety
items.overview: Thoughts cannot be suddenly stopped, just like we cannot simply stop on the highway. The asphalt turns into a hypnotic stream, and the real world blends with absurd visions of a catastrophe. An experimental film about fear, an accelerated mind, and the impossibility of stopping the inevitable crash.

items.title: Étrangers
items.overview: A young boy must confront his Arab heritage, which he has denied for years, at his father's funeral in a mosque.

items.title: Aliens of UC
items.overview: Jamie and Alex are UFO hunters and students at University of Canberra. So when they discover that their uni is housing alien students for the CIA and the Vanourian Empire, who have diabolical plans of their own, they jump onboard to expose it. However, some conspiracies are too good to be true…

items.title: Bee Taylor and the Lexington Philharmonic String Quartet : The Movie
items.overview: When independent songwriter Bee Taylor joined forces with the Lexington Philharmonic String Quartet for a single night; the raw, sold-out performance left hundreds of fans heartbroken not being able to get a ticket. Now, this cinematic 85-minute concert film—introduced on screen by Silas House—captures the sweeping arrangements of strings and electric moments of the band. This film gives the community a second chance to experience what happens when a small town girl lives her dream; playing with members of the orchestra.

items.title: Un jazmín prendido fuego
items.overview: A voice moves through fragmented archives —that compressed and ripped survived a damaged hardisk— rambling about what we reconstitute and imagine when the devices we thought inmortal finally die.

items.title: Memento Amoris
items.overview: A woman's bleeding hand rests against a tree with a dying leaf in her palm. Through a fable of a leaf that falls far from home and the stranger who lands beside her, Memento Amoris asks what a brief love is worth and why do we need to live after we have fallen.

items.title: Rua 16
items.overview: Fed up with constant power outages caused by the utility company's negligence, the residents of Rua 16 decide to organize a collective effort to install solar panels and take control of their own electricity supply. However, internal disagreements and the fear of retaliation threaten the community's unity - even before the first panel is installed.

items.title: Spiwanje – co nas zwězujo
