items.overview: Three people, one language: music. Singing activist Marek Slodička, music editor Gregor Kliem and harpist Karlina Margrafojc meet at the Zapust carnival in Jänschwalde, in the recording studio, at a concert and at a summer language course.

items.title: Tantalum
items.overview: A chunk of tantalum - commonly known as coltan, mined in eastern Congo - travels in military materials to a Ghanaian dumpsite, and finally to space. Along the way we discover the connections to mythology, children, technology and colonisation in a critical reflection on political and economic systems.

items.title: Misrouted
items.overview: “Big” a young man from the fringes of Bangkok, begins working as a packer for an online general store. There, he meets “Kom” a senior colleague. Both feel they don’t quite fit into life in Bangkok, yet they find a sense of comfort in each other’s company. As their individual goals begin to diverge, Big is forced to reflect on his own path—whether to continue with his current life or to leave this place behind.

items.title: Bloom
items.overview: During the first months of the pandemic, an old woman withers and blooms alongside her flower.

items.title: Joonè Delam
items.overview: In a bid for closure a first-generation Iranian-Australian woman is compelled to confront her abusive father on his deathbed.

items.title: Aimless Walk
items.overview: This first true Czech avant-garde film turns away from a purely celebratory approach to the city. The camera follows a detached protagonist on his wanderings, as his highly subjective journey becomes a fragmented visualization of urban landscapes.

items.title: THE CURE
items.overview: Years after leaving her family and hometown behind to build a life of her own, Nisa returns to her aunt Zehra’s home for her uncle’s funeral. Having come from the same past but drifted into different lives, the two women recognize familiar traces of themselves in one another, as well as the possibilities of lives that might have been. Their encounter leads Nisa to reconsider her own past and future.

items.title: The Standard
items.overview: The world’s most popular bodybuilding champion wrestles with the emotional and physical cost of his final competition, and the question of who he will be once it’s all over.

items.title: Other's Meadows Flowers
items.overview: When her younger sister Róża mysteriously disappears, Morwa begins searching for her and recalls the last moments they spent together.

items.title: Nnéoma
items.overview: A mother's greatest mistake becomes her chance at redemption when love demands the ultimate sacrifice.

items.title: Fractured Euphoria
items.overview: All life is about to be destroyed and no one knows it's about to happen. Thomas works on his next idea for a book and his mind slowly starts crumbling.

items.title: Lizzie
items.overview: A young woman, Eliza, returns to her hometown for summer break, and must confront a fragment of her past.

items.title: The glimmer of tears
items.overview: Seven-year-old Abril is taken from his mother and placed in foster care in the hope of giving them both a better chance. There, he finds an unexpected companion in Luna, who helps him navigate the loneliness and heartache of their separation. But when he is finally reunited with his mother, happiness proves fleeting, and another loss awaits. Forced to confront separation once more, Abril embarks on a tender, heartbreaking journey that will shape his understanding of love, longing, and the things we carry long after someone is gone.

items.title: i. exists
items.overview: In 2008, a landmark court ruling in the Philippines allowed Jeff Cagandahan, an intersex man to legally change his name and gender marker. 16 years later, his historic win inspired many others to come out—yet, as their visibility grows, it unveils harsh societal prejudices proving that the fight for true acceptance is only just beginning.

items.title: HIDDEN
items.overview: After the sudden disappearance of a loved one, a woman is haunted by a shadow from her past.

items.title: One More Cup
items.overview: As toddler Leona is about to host her very first tea party with her stuffed animals, it inexplicably turns into a worldwide spectacle—but all she really wants is to share tea with her friends.

items.title: How to date a guy
items.overview: How to Date a Guy follows Rodrigo and Niamh, two friends in a Dublin acting class search for love and meaning, only to discover that real connection begins when they stop performing and start being present.

items.title: The Chaser
items.overview: A desperate young man who is looking for love goes to an enigmatic potion seller to buy a love potion.

items.title: Kate in Maize
items.overview: Katherine kneads clay, shapes it, and fires a cup. A curiosity sparked by this physical sensation leads her to reveal her own body. Sensing this, a lustrous linden blossom breaks away from the tree and begins to drift toward the girl. She crushes it with her hand, and an allergic reaction rash appears on her groin. Back home, the girl encounters three cats.

items.title: Tnani: Sacred Bundles
items.overview: The sun’s passage over the zenith heralds the first rains, and the ritual opens the gates to sidereal time—a temporal flow that dissolves the boundary between past and present amidst the intricate paths of a territory where hallucination and memory weave bridges between human beings and gods.

items.title: Haus Tumbuna
items.overview: A socially engaged project and commissioned documentary film in Ulingan Bay, Papua New Guinea that documents the establishment of a self-sustaining, culturally specific timber surfboard factory within the local community. The project, founded by Nickolas Kirriwom and Nicholas Wynnychuk, aims to decolonize cultural impact, foster cultural revival and healing, and highlight the connection between community, culture, spirit, and the natural world through the sustainable practice of building traditional ocean-going craft.

items.title: Don't Let The Bastards Grind You Down
items.overview: "Don't Let The Bastards Grind You Down" is a documentary film about British social policy. The focus is on the political struggle against neoliberal austerity policies, which have their origins in the hated Thatcher government.  The film features the former socialist MP Dave Nellist, who is now the national chair of the Trade Unionist & Socialist Coalition and Hannah Sell, the general secretary of the Socialist Party. The film features a local election campaign in the miners' town of Nuneaton, students campaigning against an increase in tuition fees and refuse workers from Birmingham striking against massive cuts to their wages.

items.title: Trasadi
items.overview: Darpan Maskey, 20s, is haunted by someone performing a weird ritual. Severe hand wounds and whispers haunt Darpan as he slowly begins to realize the predicament he is in. To get out of this situation, he takes the help of his friend, Kiran, a young priest who desires to help out his friend and to stand up on his own feet, independent of his father. He takes Darpan and tries to help him in his own way, as Darpan has to make tough decisions. This leads to a situation both of them could never have predicted.

items.title: The Days We Still Have
items.overview: The Days We Still Have is an emotional short film about determination, family, and hope amid the conflict affecting the UAE. As a student's education shifts online, his daily routine is disrupted by uncertainty, fear, and constant news updates. Miles away, his father, an overseas Filipino worker, continues working whenever it is safe, carrying the responsibility of providing for his family while facing the same fears. Meanwhile, a teacher struggles to keep her students motivated despite the circumstances surrounding them. As the student begins questioning the purpose of building a future he cannot be certain of, a heartfelt conversation with his father changes his perspective. He slowly realizes that determination is not about knowing what tomorrow holds, but finding the courage to keep going despite uncertainty.

items.title: Pouramika
items.overview: A poetry short film

items.title: Year of the Little Tiger
items.overview: It’s Chinese New year in Wellington, and Daniel, a Chinese-Pākehā teenager, is feeling insecure about being half Chinese. After being bullied by his Chinese peers, he realises how out of touch he is with his own culture and begins to feel lost within his mixed identity. All Daniel wants is to get closer to his crush Kaya, a headstrong Chinese girl, but his insecurities are getting in his way. How will Daniel find the courage to be proud of his mixed identity and confess to his crush?

items.title: Oslo Court
items.overview: About the 1970s-style London restaurant, Oslo Court, and its cultural importance to the Jewish community, with waiter, Neil, at its beating heart.

items.title: Reina de puerto
items.overview: Deep in the Valparaíso night, Panxita, an older trans woman crowned queen, meets Príncipe, a young man adrift in the port city. Amid stairways, dive bars, and alleyways, a fleeting connection forms, shaped by desire, care, and loneliness

items.title: Kumusta, Trek?
items.overview: On his 21st birthday, Trek, a self-doubting guitarist returns to his hometown after abandoning his band. But as he wanders old haunts with his childhood friend, a simple birthday gift triggers a quiet, surreal reckoning with the fears and insecurities that forced him to walk away from his passion.

items.title: VV
items.overview: When a businessman is found dead, police begins to investigate the murder case. Varun becomes one of the suspects and his brother Vetri who is a police officer takes charge of the investigation.

items.title: Hanya Suara Yang Pulang
items.overview: The Mockingbird Line

items.title: Ring Ring...
items.overview: A seemingly normal meeting between a man named John Smith and a lawyer named C.C. Baxter takes an unexpected turn.

items.title: The Fleeting Rhythm
items.overview: What does it take to leave the only place you've ever called home and chase your sound somewhere new? Following Jacob Ledesma, a producer from Reno, Nevada, as he packs up and moves to the Bay Area to take his music to the next level.

items.title: Weaving Our Wisdom
items.overview: Indigenous men go in the bush to discuss the problems facing the people in this day and age.

items.title: Nostalgia.
items.overview: On a morning like any other, a young man recalls the summers of his childhood.

items.title: CHIPCINEMA ODYSSEY
items.overview: An animated journey through the niche genre of chipcinema AKA 8-bit cinema. This film combines a variety of retro shorts with the surreal works of Ikko Ohno into one leisurely voyage. Take some puffs and enjoy the journey through this pixel-art dreamscape.

items.title: Three Hits
items.overview: After getting hits on each other, three assassins converge on a citizen's house for their kills.

items.title: Chapecó, el último sobreviviente: nace una hermandad
items.overview: The rescue of footballer Hélio Neto, one of the survivors of the 2016 Chapecoense plane crash in the mountains of Antioquia, Colombia, and his reunion with Marlon Lengua, the police officer who led the effort to save his life.

items.title: Gazawyat: Maha
items.overview: The film tells the story of Maha Abu Ammouneh, a displaced mother who, in the heart of genocide, becomes a mother, teacher, doctor, and refuge, reinventing life for her children from nothing through imagination and play to shield them from fear and create a safer world within the ruins.

items.title: The Kingdom of Cream and Glass
items.overview: Film student Matt Newsom spends the summer of 2026 doing god knows what and records all of it for some reason

items.title: Pride of Scotland
items.overview: In the heart of Edinburgh, a renowned Kilt manufacturer works to preserve a centuries-old Scottish tradition while training the next generation to carry it forward.

items.title: The Moon Laid Bare
items.overview: Néstor is a theater actor who has been streaming since the pandemic. As he rehearses a nearly autobiographical text, he transforms into a dazzling diva.

items.title: What We Leave Behind
items.overview: After receiving a call that her estranged father has died, Lara must face resentment and change by discovering who he became in the years before his death.

items.title: London Vice
items.overview: An adrenaline-fuelled, indie heist thriller following an architect caught in the dangerous web of a ruthless mob boss. Forced to orchestrate the ultimate heist, he assembles a crew of four elite thieves for a high-stakes operation: infiltrating a heavily guarded London casino to steal the multi-million-pound "Chameleon Diamond."

items.title: The Last Diary
items.overview: Khmer movie

items.title: Hit the Books, Harry!
items.overview: A stressed, under-prepared college student spots a girl across the empty library as he crams for his exams.

items.title: Shitbox
items.overview: An aspiring hitman takes on his first job before realizing the odds are against him.

items.title: Medicine Ball
items.overview: Medicine Ball follows Native college athletes Lexus and Leroy as they uncover their university’s dark history as a former Indian boarding school, revealing how basketball is more than a game—it’s a symbol of hope, resilience, and cultural pride in Native communities.

items.title: Glass Saints
items.overview: A group of young men ranging from the ages of 18 to 24 live their bizarre eccentric lives in a world that doesn't understand them. They navigate life's course one day at a time.

items.title: My New Form
items.overview: Bob, a young conspiracy theorist, is convinced that a powerful corporation is using young men as unwitting tools in a global surveillance system. When his worst nightmare suddenly becomes reality, he flees into an absurd world where the line between paranoia and reality begins to blur.

items.title: Portraits of Slovak and Czech Britain
items.overview: Transitioning from a photographic exhibition to film, this documentary captures multi-generational stories of Slovak and Czech migrants building lives and finding belonging in Britain. It highlights individuals who have impacted modern British society through personal archives and intimate conversations.

items.title: Postum
items.overview: In a Romanian village, families gather to remember their dead through memorial rituals held at specific intervals after a person’s death.

items.title: Flycatcher
items.overview: Ava and Sally cope with the death of their father in opposing ways. Exploring grief and memory, the solution to their unity may lie with the sighting of a Pied Flycatcher.

items.title: There is Not Only One Kind of Love!
Olsenbanden og Statshemmeligheten
items.overview: Egon Olsen escapes from Høland Prison and discovers that the legendary Pickford diamonds conceal two highly sensitive, incriminating documents and a microfilm that could expose an extensive political conspiracy. Together with Benny, Kjell, and Harry, he embarks on his most dangerous mission yet: to infiltrate the National Museum in broad daylight, collaborate with a clandestine shadow organization known as "The Archive," and secure the evidence before it falls into the wrong hands. With a corrupt government, nail-biting car chases, and hidden agendas, the gang is drawn into a life-or-death game where the future of Norway hangs in the balance.

items.title: Ha, Ha, Mr Wilson
items.overview: An epic odyssey through 1960s London with Prime Minister Harold Wilson and some very, very, special guests.

items.title: Das Monument bewegt sich
items.overview: Documentary about rememberance of the victims of military dictatorship in Argentinia.

items.title: It Always Equals to You
items.overview: Centuries had to pass. Now I am here, next to you as you laugh, and I smile because you are so impossibly beautiful. You are a mosaic of unimaginable time.

items.title: Yendo contra el viento
items.overview: With 16mm images and black-and-white photographs, a personal essay film guides us through Santo Domingo. Shaped as it is by unrest, habits and reflections, it becomes clear that the cityscape also mirrors an inner state.

items.title: The Americans
items.overview: Fleeing violence and persecution, refugees start new lives in the rural town of Storm Lake, Iowa, working the meatpacking line by day and reaching for something greater. Chronicling six years of their lives against a backdrop of political turmoil and a global pandemic, THE AMERICANS explores what the pursuit of happiness truly means.

items.title: The Deranged Drummer
items.overview: A drummer drums and keeps on drumming but slowly loses his sanity in the span of a couple minutes.

items.title: Angélica
items.overview: A chance encounter on a cold, misty morning on the outskirts of Valdivia changes the life of 33-year-old Angélica forever. After a brief, mundane ten-minute conversation with Fernando—a wandering passerby—he vanishes without a trace. From that day on, Angélica’s life becomes a nightmare: she finds herself the "key witness" in the case, subjected to intense public scrutiny, hate campaigns on social media, and harassment by the family’s lawyer, Raúl.

items.title: This is the House: If I Don’t See You, I Love You
items.overview: A Ghanaian-American father and daughter duo work through their crowded basement in search of family archives. Through intimate questions and answers, they reconcile the distance caused by immigration, divorce, and loss.

items.title: La entrada
items.overview: The door that is never where you leave it it's the image of an inestable life, where uncertainty is the only certainty. Every return home becomes a disturbing search not only for the door itself but for the conviction that inside it resides something to belong to. As routine repeats, the man tries to adapt, memorize and negotiate with the unpredictable. But the effort itself wears him down: the house it's not a shelter anymore but a constant reminder that nothing is guaranteed.

items.title: Smirnov
items.overview: Wordless portrait of the outstanding filmmaker Andrei Smirnov.

items.title: Organisation
items.overview: Nokturn, a secret agent working for Agency 1989, is sent to infiltrate a criminal organisation known as Organizacja through its ruthless recruitment process, hoping to find Preludia, a fellow agent who disappeared two years earlier. The truth behind this mission may be very different from what he believes.

items.title: Reflection
items.overview: After losing his father, Ahmed becomes trapped in isolation, grief, and emotional numbness. On the night of his birthday, while standing on the edge of suicide, an unexpected phone call and a mysterious girl named Layan pull him back from making a fatal decision. Her words give him a small sense of hope and connection he has not felt since his father’s death. As Ahmed struggles to reconnect with reality, his mental state begins to deteriorate. He starts hearing voices, seeing disturbing visions, and encountering a mysterious double of himself that seems to represent his inner darkness and unresolved trauma. Torn between healing and self-destruction, Ahmed is forced to confront his grief, loneliness, and fractured identity before losing himself completely. “Reflection” is a psychological drama that explores loss, depression, isolation, and the silent battle within the human mind.

items.title: Searching for Orchids
items.overview: Some people speak of landscape as the earliest expression in shaping culture. Here preserving plants becomes about preserving cultural identity. In the forests of Taiwan, a man searches for endangered orchids, as a filmmaker searches for belonging. Her family name “蘭” (Lan), meaning orchid in Mandarin, turns this parallel search into an exploration of preservation and finding belonging on disputed land.

items.title: EYES OF GOD
items.overview: Eyes of God explores love, divinity, and survival through a surreal, non narrative lens grounded in Black faith and human fragility. Set in the contemporary South, the film searches for holiness beyond religion finding it instead in care, endurance, and creation. Through recurring images of life, death, and restoration, it honors the spiritual force embedded in Black love, revealing a quiet grace that sustains even within cycles that cannot be broken.

items.title: The McAster Incident
items.overview: In the lead-up to Halloween, four students disappeared in the woods near an old prison, while attempting to film a documentary. This is the footage that was found.

items.title: What’s Forgivable
items.overview: A picture arrives on Jasim’s doorstep with a message threatening his family. Left with no choice, Jasim sets off into the night to carry out their demands.

items.title: In the Hands of Time
items.overview: Suffering from Alzheimer’s, a man watches a Super 8 home movie from the 1970’s at his son’s request. The images of holidays at his grandparents’ house awaken buried sensations, the gentleness of the wind, the warmth of the sun, the tranquility of childhood.

items.title: Langmarine
items.overview: A paranoid man who has locked himself in his apartment and watches the outside world through CCTV cameras must face his fears when invited to dinner by his new neighbours.

items.title: Ouroboros
items.overview: A detective is appointed to a murder case, and must look within himself to uncover the truth behind who the killer really is.

items.title: Boksburg sonder brieke
items.overview: When Vonk Vlok, a Boksburg mechanic, unexpectedly appears in the infamous Epstein files, his family's quiet existence is thrown into total chaos. As he tries to explain how he got involved in the scandal, family problems, social media drama and old secrets come together to lead to a collision of epic proportions.

items.title: Last Two Braincells
items.overview: A group of comedic and idiotic young men come together to do dangerous, disgusting and hilarious stunts, pranks and more. All with one goal in mind, to drop themselves down to their Last Two Braincells…

items.title: Jack Mountain
items.overview: Raymond Crow, a rural Arkansas store owner, reflects on the day he was shot by a prison escapee in 1966, and the hardships and rebuilding that followed.

items.title: The Andre Arns Show
items.overview: Featuring: D-Dogg, Zendaya, Ben Nelan

items.title: Quando è pronto, il fieno canta
O Sinal Estava Fechado, Nós Atravessamos
items.overview: One of the many demonstrations for democracy in Brazil, October 2026. One protest, standing for an entire movement.

items.title: the FUDGE BUNCH
items.overview: Daytime television at its finest: two brothers, one girl, and a baby that ain’t nobody’s. Follow host Garry Spooger as he gets to the bottom of a family feud to find out 'who is the father'?

items.title: c.s: A Melbourne Experience
items.overview: Vast landscapes of a suburb in Melbourne, Australia

items.title: Three Little Pigs
items.overview: Two teenagers' darkly comic mission to steal a pig's head sends them on a nocturnal journey through the heart of Hong Kong, culminating in a poignant act of resistance to honor an absent friend.

items.title: Surroundings
items.overview: Surroundings is a short film made to make you appreciate your surroundings

items.title: Douvina
items.overview: The film is a silent invitation to contemplation: on the winding paths of preserving memory, on what slips through our fingers in the present, and on our own place in the face of the departure of those we love, the disappearance of places, and the subtle marks we leave along the way.

items.title: local color
items.overview: Local Color documents the daily life of people who live, work, visit and play in Hanoi. Once the central city of America’s most elusive enemy during the Cold War, the film asks what is to become of the red that once brought the western world to its knees? Where is it fading? What colors replace it? Who will be responsible moving forward? Local Color is an observational documentary that investigates the limits of observational documentary. Starting with a relic of the Vietnam War, Local Color expands to explore how images, propaganda and a local scene is created.  Local Color is a film about labor and leisure. It is about the past, the present and the future and it is a film about a city and its people. Local Color a film about Hanoi, Vietnam.

items.title: faust.os
items.overview: A girl seeks love by making a pact with an entity emanated from technology, attempting to preserve her privacy and her humanity while chatting with her new artificial lover.

items.title: Retrovisor
items.overview: As dusk falls over Recife, hidden threats take an escape route from hellish traffic.

items.title: Pay As You Go
items.overview: A struggling tenant wants to escape his Pay-As-You-Go Life Tariff, but must first confront a relentlessly cheerful Customer Support officer conducting a routine “Life Utility Check-Up”. A Kafka-esque comedy set in a world where everything is chargeable.

items.title: Shh
items.overview: Investigating a supernatural disturbance, exorcist Paddy Mullins and his team venture into an abandoned military installation where silence is essential… until it isn’t.

items.title: Office Town
items.overview: Long live renewal, long live progress. Give us more and more and more and more. Who wouldn’t want that…? Outdated machines take control when they learn their existence is under threat. A film about powerful figures, obedient souls and rebels. Laugh, but with your head!

items.title: MaXXed Out
items.overview: A lonely and impressionable young man embarks on a twisted self-improvement journey guided by his online hero, a popular influencer with sinister intentions.

items.title: Speechless Expression
items.overview: On the day of her husband's funeral, a young widow finds a way to express her love without saying a single word. Studio Suggs presents "Speechless Expression," a new romantic musical drama starring Jasmine Ashanti Gillenwaters and Darious Robertson.

items.title: Memória em Projeção: Um Documentário Sobre o Festival Kinoarte de Cinema
The Last Bell
items.overview: Michael and Leo are two childhood best friends who have grown up sharing countless memories, laughter, and unforgettable moments together. From their everyday school adventures to their smallest conversations, their friendship has always been an important part of their lives.

items.title: Binta Is Okay
items.overview: Binta Is Okay is a mini coming-of-age story about a girl trying to understand her body, her faith and her relationship with her mother.

items.title: This vague hunger
items.overview: At work, Sound, Actor, and Camera are in a stalemate regarding subjectivity, penetration, disclosure; the relationship between artists and institutions; the subordinate condition of the image, of practice, of struggle.

items.title: Suavis Memoria Capsula
items.overview: A reflection on memory.

items.title: Waking
items.overview: As a famous actress slips into a waking nightmare, reality begins to unravel around her. Haunted by strange visions and cryptic clues, she is forced to confront a secret buried deep within her past.

items.title: Dick In a Box
items.overview: A cinematic retelling of The Lonely Island's touching and eclectic "Dick In a Box". Four friends decide to bring one of their most cherished dreams to life in the spirit of Christmas (Halloween).

items.title: Moon
items.overview: A young woman discovers herself within the connection between time, nature and queerness.

items.title: Forsaken
items.overview: A man trapped in his thoughts relives his last moments.

items.title: Where There are Nilad Flowers
items.overview: While walking the streets of Manila, a student filmmaker reflects on the phenomenon of change and time as they document the city's various heritage sites.

items.title: suno open pona
items.overview: An adaptation of one of the opening scenes from The Hobbit (Tolkien 1937) into toki pona, a constructed language from Sonja Lang (2001).

items.title: Dhana Dhanya Kalyana
items.overview: A feature-length observational documentary following Dhananjaya and Dhanyatha through an important chapter of their lives.  The wedding is part of the story, but not the whole of it. The film looks beyond the celebrations, into the everyday moments, relationships, decisions, and changes that make up a life together.

items.title: Covers
items.overview: A lonely drunk grows a desire to help another after discovering a seemingly confused naked man in his home.

items.title: I Made a Film in Excel
items.overview: A short animated film with visuals done fully in Microsoft Excel.

items.title: Breakfast is ready
items.overview: Olivia is out to get revenge. She helps out Maddie by letting her stay over. Doing her a favorite she thought. But maybe not

items.title: Dear Marcelle
items.overview: Four queer friends meet at Marcelle's house to get ready for Carnival, but Marcelle no longer wants to see them and leaves them standing on her doorstep without explanation. Shocked and confused, the four friends try to save their friendship from silence.

items.title: My soul is in a hurry
items.overview: After a life-changing diagnosis, Italian pastry chef Nicolas Gentile sets out to turn his dream of living like a Hobbit into reality. But as his Shire takes shape, bureaucracy, reality and time threaten everything he is trying to build.

items.title: Artful Intelligence
items.overview: After procrastinating on a homework assignment due at midnight, Ruby's friend convinces her to download a new A.I. companion app to get it done. She gets more than she bargained for when the voice assistant gets a little too personal.

items.title: Bloody Syllable
items.overview: A short experimental film.

items.title: Don't Go In The Garden
items.overview: After a serious accident in an attempt to trim down her overgrown garden, Lily has a chilling encounter with something terrifying lurking beneath the soil.

items.title: הסבתא הנאצית שלי
items.overview: Netta’s family has long carried an unspoken story: her German grandmother is the daughter of a Nazi army officer. Netta follows her to Germany with a camera trying over several years to break the silence. On October 7 as Netta shelters alone in a kibbutz near Gaza, the wars of past and present begin to collide.

items.title: Praying to a Cat
items.overview: Ben Zion, a student at a Hasidic yeshiva, struggles to leave his rabbi and his world behind. When he finally tells his rabbi, he discovers how much the rabbi depends on him. Within the study hall, Ben Zion embarks on a bizarre journey, somewhere between imagination and reality, that brings his predicament into sharper focus.

items.title: Versipellis
items.overview: When the night falls, a young nun transforms into a wolf.  She must escape the inquisitor who hunts her down.

items.title: Halloween Claws
items.overview: A teenage girl is home alone and keeps hearing, what she assumes is, her cat meowing. Anytime Kali went to check what the noise was, her cat wasn't there. When she went to check one last time, she was met with a masked individual staring back at her.

items.title: The Truth Files
items.overview: A documentary crew spends the week with Teddy Tedderson - a student with an urgent call to action.

items.title: Once Upon a Rex
items.overview: A documentary reminiscing on the 70 years history of a beloved cinema in Padua.

items.title: She Looks Like Latte
items.overview: After a dog named Latte mysteriously disappears, a filmmaker pieces together recovered footage and audio diaries to reconstruct the events surrounding the disappearance. The search for answers uncovers something unsettling about the neighborhood cats, and the dog that came back.

items.title: Table Cards
items.overview: What should be a simple seating arrangement becomes a high-stakes negotiation as a couple prepares to host a dinner party for friends whose shared history is complicated, at best.

items.title: AKRASIA
items.overview: After a bicycle accident leaves him struggling with medical bills, a young man turns to drug dealing as a quick solution to his financial troubles. As his newfound income begins to improve his life, the consequences of his choices force him to confront the cost of putting personal gain above morality.

items.title: Pearl and Pomegranate
items.overview: A young woman journeys on a quest to retrieve Neptune’s lost oyster shell, exploring the ocean, ruins and underworld. She faces mythical monsters that challenge the strength of her loyalties and faces her own mortality.

items.title: What If
items.overview: A Man. Deeply obsessed with his friend. A journey to depict his flow of emotions while he confesses his feelings. Will he get what he wants?

items.title: Mission Pinguin – Mit dem Segelboot in die Antarktis
Coal’s Human Cost
items.overview: From PBS Frontline; Working veteran underground coal miners are suffering from an incurable lung disease at the highest rates in nearly 50 years. With NPR, publichealthwatch, and Appalachia + Mid-South Newsroom (porchlightnews), we've been investigating how industry and government have failed to protect miners in Appalachia from black lung disease.

items.title: Cradled by Grace
items.overview: As iconic Austin trumpeter Ephraim Owens and composer Sam Lipman undertake an ambitious collaboration uniting Ephraim’s jazz style with the Austin Symphony Orchestra, a health challenge requires them to confront new realities and limits.

items.title: Posthuman Lament
items.overview: A creature searches for its identity in a strange castle.

items.title: Party Supreme
items.overview: Benny Ratner, a college slacker throws a party in his dorm while on academic probation. When his dorm gets infiltrated by an R.A., Benny finds himself on the run to reach the one person who can get him out trouble.

items.title: inseperable Gaze
items.overview: Two lovers seeing each other naked for the first time.

items.title: Recovering Our Voices
items.overview: Following a group of people who use creativity and performance to aid their recovery from trauma and addiction.

items.title: A Quiet Day
items.overview: It’s an ordinary day at the United Nations. Nothing unexpected, really. Except, perhaps, for this strange affliction that is spreading amongst the members of the council. But otherwise, everything is fine. Yes, everything is perfectly fine.

items.title: Kashti Paar
items.overview: A silent folk-horror parable from the Indian coast. When a fight for a place on a fishing boat turns to blood, young Shreyas loses the man who raised him and is left alone on a sea that remembers every death. In the mist, a girl with a lantern is waiting.

items.title: Bullet for Three
items.overview: Three men enter a decrepit room to play a game of Russian Roulette. One of the bullets is special and can fulfill their deepest desires. However, having such an immense opportunity in front of them doesn't guarantee fair play.

items.title: Wildgemis
items.overview: Wildgemis is the directorial debut of Anouk Suntjens. Set in the vast American wilderness, the film follows Dutch researcher Elke Tukker, who has spent years studying the lives of wild horses. What begins as a fascination with these free-roaming animals gradually becomes a personal journey into humanity’s relationship with nature. As activists, government agencies and ranchers clash over land management, Elke is confronted with difficult questions about control, freedom and our place within the ecosystem. When she witnesses a controversial horse round-up for the first time, her sense of “wild longing” reaches a breaking point. Wildgemis is a powerful and thought-provoking documentary about nature, power and the human need for connection.

items.title: Running on Luck
items.overview: An easy victim is being hunted down by two hit men. The job is straightforward, and escape appears impossible. However, fate changes when their gullible target discovers a four-leaf clover.

items.title: Gazawyat: Fidaa
items.overview: The film follows Fidaa Abu Maryam on her journey to wield storytelling as a psychological shield. By gathering the testimonies of Gazan women, she transforms their narratives into a living archive of feminist memory, defying oblivion and reclaiming the self from the heart of the ruins.

items.title: Of Times There Were Before
items.overview: Of Times There Were Before is a portrait of Romila Thapar, one of the world’s most influential historians and public intellectuals. At ninety-four, having lived through much of the making of modern India, she stands at an unusual distance from the past she has spent a lifetime studying. The film began with a simple question: who is the person behind the historian’s name? Shot at her home in New Delhi, it is an attempt to encounter Thapar beyond the authority of her work and the public image built around it. What emerges is a portrait of a life still in conversation with its own time.

items.title: Tony's
items.overview: A detective interrogates a man about the last night he spent with his best friend.

items.title: The Millstone
items.overview: A rural drama woven from silence and dust, the film explores human fragility in the face of aging—the hidden fissures in memory and the weight of bonds that gradually fade away. Through a man’s return to his native village, the film delves into questions of identity and lineage, while capturing the intimate conflict between medical efforts to halt loss and a collective memory—frail yet persistent—that refuses to vanish.

items.title: Un espoir tangible d'aimer les filles
Charles & Danny
items.overview: An ex high school basketball star learns to overcome personal struggles and pivots to a new chapter in his life by coaching a disabled teenager to play basketball.

items.title: Don't Touch The Artwork
items.overview: A museum's rigid façade shatters under the defiant gaze of a young brown woman. Her look is the trigger, instantly launching a "visual riot", where the known rules of reality dissolve into chaos.

items.title: Carry with Both Hands
items.overview: Leah is caught in the middle of her family’s divided view points on politics, culture and religious identity, and the ever-changing boundaries of acceptance.

items.title: Buen Viaje, Javier
items.overview: It is the final encounter between América and Javier. América pays him to visit and listen to her most intimate and disturbing stories. She pays, he obeys... perhaps a contract, an agreement to stay afloat. How many stories can a body hold after listening to them? Javier becomes the involuntary keeper and accomplice of América’s darkest secrets, while she remains alone. Now everything about her lives inside him.

items.title: Batty
items.overview: Confronted with his own mortality, a renowned septuagenarian writer embarks on one final journey to recover the lost manuscript of his debut novel. In doing so, he seeks to confront his past and reconcile with the person he once was in his youth, before time slips away from him.

items.title: What Was Taken
items.overview: A young woman is trapped in a surreal ritual and prepared as an offering for the Beast. As memory and reality begin to blur, she struggles to hold onto her humanity. Inspired by the experiences of women affected by extremist violence in Syria, Iraq, and Nigeria.

items.title: Chimeras Tonight (Too Mercury)
items.overview: In this dreamlike animation, two women fall in love and are metamorphosed into strange creatures, symbiotic with the natural world around them.

items.title: Canned Laughter
items.overview: on his 21st birthday surrounded by his friends, Matthew Sanford blows his candles on his perfectly lit technicolor life only to realize that his life may not be entirely what he imagined...but what's he gonna do about that?  follow Matthew Sanford as he attempts to continue on with his life after becoming self aware that he is a fictional cast member within a television sitcom.

items.title: The Gaggle
items.overview: A gaggle of geese goes glamping (with ghosts)

items.title: Senu
items.overview: Told surfing wasn't for girls, Senu Madushani learned on broken, discarded boards and became Sri Lanka's first female national surfer. An intimate portrait of a young woman and her bond with the ocean.

items.title: Rae's Video Diary
items.overview: Through unfiltered diary entries, a growing teenager documents her peculiar growing pains – both heartbreaking and hilarious – that shape who she’s becoming.

items.title: A Smaller God
items.overview: When one lets their mind wander too long into too far places , they might slip into the path of universal mind. Endless obscure knowledges can be obtained but they will soon turn into pain and suffering, Since they are too great to be comprehended  and too heavy to be contained by human mind.

items.title: Captain Jack, the Pirate Cat of Hatter's Hall
items.overview: He’s a sassy old cat who sits in the sun outside a second-hand record shop, but it might surprise you to find out about his past, and about just how special he is to the people who come and visit him.

items.title: Behind The Passion
items.overview: Qatar 2022 was the most expensive World Cup in history. Behind the spectacle sat a system built on bribery and forced labor, one that consumed the men who built it, and a governing body with every reason not to look. In Rosario, Argentina, a human rights organization shaped by the horrors of its own country's past set out to make sure someone did.

items.title: Air-Born: Cleared for Takeoff
items.overview: Returning back to Chino Airport, this documentary sequel follows the evolution of Cal-Aerofab Flight Academy through their restoration projects and new mentors for the next generation of aviators.

items.title: The Way It Goes
items.overview: Nilay, who rarely comes together with her family, travels by car with her brother Caner and her aunt Songül to their village in the steppe to bury their father. The hearse carrying their father’s body follows them on the road. During the journey, an unexpected event forces Nilay and Caner to face moments they have long avoided.

items.title: There's a Tulip in Vilnius
items.overview: Inspired by a deceased, extravagant Vilnius fashion icon, Indrė sets out to follow in her footsteps, only to face resistance from those around her.

items.title: Strategies to Block a Door
items.overview: A caramel bar, a school desk, a flowing river, and a blanket castle in the living room. Two adults recall fragments from their childhood, in which they experienced sexualized violence at the hands of other minors. Between intimacy and distance, it becomes possible to experience how violence adheres to everyday objects and moments. The film asks about the foundations of shame, silence, and responsibility.

items.title: The Magic of It All: The Story of Strawbs
items.overview: A Cape Town recording session becomes the final chapter in the extraordinary story of British folk-rock legends Strawbs, as frontman David Cousins confronts illness and prepares for the band's farewell performance.

items.title: Angel Infinity
items.overview: A young girl who is a victim of deep-faked porn meets a wage slave young man who creates virtual lover "Angel A" – a budding love story of two lonely souls caught between illusion and reality.

items.title: Dinosaur Horror Evolves: The Making of 'Nightfall'
items.overview: Go behind the scenes of "Nightfall (2025)," in this featurette exploring its journey from concept to final film. Through cast and crew interviews, on-set footage, and VFX breakdowns, discover how lifelike dinosaurs, tense night shoots, and emotional performances brought this prehistoric horror to life.

items.title: Language of Water
items.overview: How do you explain the sound of the ocean to someone who has never heard it? Shot on 16mm film, this intimate portrait follows surfer and photographer Lily Bertrand-Webb and her sister Bellaray as they explore the nature of sound and the space between hearing and deaf worlds.

items.title: Folded dreams
items.overview: A 10-year-old student quietly struggles under the overwhelming pressure of school, watching his childhood dreams slowly fold away

items.title: Police Detective Parker
items.overview: Alton C. Parker became the first Black police officer in his hometown in 1941, later rising to become Canada’s first Black detective. In an era marked by deep racial bias, he broke barriers within the Windsor Police Force, confronting skepticism and systemic obstacles. Through skill, resilience, and determination, he earned the respect of colleagues and the community. His journey reshaped perceptions within law enforcement and helped spark broader social change, leaving a lasting legacy of possibility.

items.title: Salzwasser
items.overview: When his father cries in front of him for the first time, Jona doesn’t know what to do. He leaves the house and enters the dark. He wanders through the woods with a torch, down to the water. A film about the attempt to put feelings into words and about all that remains unsaid between fathers and sons.

items.title: BABY MACK
items.overview: Documentary about rapper from Mestreech: $KEER&BOO$

items.title: Cadáver Esquisito
items.overview: Using WhatsApp audio messages from friends and family, medical exams, and discarded raw footage from previous projects, a film editor creates a “recycled” film. Amid the remnants and voices, an essay emerges on memory, identity, and the boundaries between reality and fiction.

items.title: Bowen's Beatitude
items.overview: A backwards-chronological experimental essay across the 20th century on Bowen Island, British Columbia.

items.title: Hopscotch
items.overview: In a room with two entrances and exits, four plinths are arranged at equal distances from one another, forming a square embedded in a corner. On each plinth a number from 1 to 9. A stationary camera is positioned several meters away, angled toward the lower half of the body. The characters enter and exit the room, sometimes interacting with one another and sometimes not.

items.title: Labirinto
items.overview: André Severo, a curator, cultural producer, and artist, shares part of his life story and seeks to prompt a brief reflection on his artistic work and on art as a whole, in his unique and, in some ways, eccentric manner of discussing his work.

items.title: Dialling...
items.overview: After a late night shift Jake cycles through his contact list of friends in the hope to get a lift home, but with none of them answering he becomes confined to this phonebooth.

items.title: Virar!
items.overview: MAYBE YOU NEED TO SEE THINGS DIFFERENTLY.  Bored with the obvious, a young woman puts on a pair of sunglasses and journeys through worlds of style and authenticity, proving that becoming a reference means showing that there’s another way.

items.title: Outside the Lines
items.overview: Monet spends her time painting and being with her roommates Vince and Henri. Everyday, she paints on the sidewalk by a mural. One day a girl, Brandy, sits next to her and draws. Monet immediately falls for her and keeps going back to meet this girl. Eventually the two girls start getting closer, leading to a deep connection and newfound love.

items.title: Spotters
items.overview: Jay and Kelley form a delicate connection while watching for UFOs in the desert, but as their friendship is tested, it becomes clear that what they're truly searching for may be even more elusive.

items.title: Sail Away
items.overview: Short film.

items.title: The Colt Pixie
items.overview: With their family fractured by loss, a resilient young boy must save his little brother from a mythic threat.

items.title: Waiting
items.overview: Nicolas has come a long way to find Sofiane again. But the meeting, which seemed like it would be simple, doesn’t go as planned. Nicolas moves through this drawn-out day, caught between what was promised and what is still to come.

items.title: Like Riding a Cloud
items.overview: Success in the mountains is never a solitary pursuit, but what makes the collective effort worthwhile? Elevated by each other’s experience, four athletes reflect alongside sports performance psychologist Dr. John Coleman on group flow — a sensation of limitless possibility that isn’t confined to the individual, but shared through connectivity.

items.title: Bulleji Boys
items.overview: In Bulleji, a fishing village on the edge of Karachi, a fisherman’s son dreams of a life his father cannot picture for him: one on a surfboard. 22-year-old Attiq Rehman is caught between the duty inherited from generations of fishermen before him and the pull of his own ambition – to put Pakistani surfing on the map. This is a beautiful and life affirming portrait exploring duty, desire and the grit it takes to imagine a life no one around you has lived.

items.title: Honorary
items.overview: A story of finding community and connection through the unlikely medium of high school badminton.

items.title: Growing Up... Sucks!
items.overview: He's sick of growing up and tries to rekindle his childness, but it just doesn't feel the same.

items.title: The Spark
items.overview: Born in Africa, a region often associated with darkness and pessimism, Celal seeks ways to bring electricity to his village to improve the children's educational conditions.

items.title: Family Memories
items.overview: Through a video call with their mother, family archival footage, and an on-camera makeup ritual, filmmaker ZIWEI 子维 explores kinship, inherited memories, and the construction of gender and identity.

items.title: 090326, newportAquarium
items.overview: Scenes from Newport Aquarium in Newport, KY.

items.title: O Homem Para o Tempo
items.overview: In Ouro Preto, longing stirs the scene anew. It weaves memory across the fissures of time. Desire is reborn, vibrant and alive - a city set amidst resonant, enigmatic machines. Fragments of affection, time, desire, and place.

items.title: traipsing blues
items.overview: A photo montage, an internal monologue, a poem of a girl.

items.title: Trop Humaine
items.overview: For year she held on to what she believed was the right way to care for her patients, despite the hospital’s dehumanization, until the night that was one too many.

items.title: Beneath the  Skin
items.overview: In the present day, when racism and stereotypes still circulate around the Roma population in Bulgaria, Roma-Bulgarian actress Nataliya Tsekova reveals emotional and compelling stories about her journey to become an actress, and her battles with mis-representation in the film industry.

items.title: As You Were
items.overview: In this loose homage to Steve Martin's "L.A. Story", Harris is a young man figuring his life out in New York City. Muddled relationships and struggles with commitment and change leave Harris confused and stuck in an unhappy status quo, struggling to figure out which direction to take his life. Through the help of new connections and New York City itself speaking to him, Harris is able to start to change his life for the better.

items.title: Finding Bernie
items.overview: When their mother criticizes their painted fingernails, a non-binary film professor confronts a lifelong struggle with gender identity. They set out on a journey—searching for a gender non-conforming childhood role model, traveling with a multigenerational trans community, and befriending a trans historian. Past and present intertwine, revealing how personal identity is shaped by collective memory—and how, for many trans people, the personal is inherently political.

items.title: Fish, Chips & Faith
items.overview: The uplifting story of a Leeds restaurant bringing communities together by serving Kosher and Halal food under one roof.

items.title: Smile of a single Flower
items.overview: Ottrai Poovin Punnagai (Smile of a Single Flower)' captures the life of Rajalakshmi Senthilkumar, a Bharatanatyam teacher in Chennai, through the eyes of her son. While it celebrates her role as a mentor, it also reveals the simple, beautiful moments of a small girl whose life blossomed through dance, passion, and devotion. A gentle, intimate portrait of a life lived with grace and love.

items.title: Mark Hama: In Service
items.overview: At 16, Mark Hama entered the Yashica camera factory to support his father and siblings; years later, he gambled on an independent film camera repair business in the U.S. to provide for his wife and sons. Now in his 80s, Mark reflects on a lifetime of choices driven by duty to others while remaining one of the few original craftsmen practicing this disappearing art of camera restoration.

items.title: Hypnopompia
items.overview: A young woman emerges from the depths to find herself caught up in an epic battle of subterfuge and transformation. With no one to turn to, she reveals herself to be the hero she was looking for.

items.title: Due to delay
items.overview: Animated short film.

items.title: Baby Blue
items.overview: Jackie, who reluctantly joins her friends for a birthday celebration, accidentally wishes upon a fate in which she does not exist. She turns into an invisible observer in a world where she discovers a painful truth: her friends seem happier without her?

items.title: Ember
items.overview: Young Dalai, aspiring to follow in his injured brother’s footsteps, trains relentlessly for the Naadam Fair to save their horse from being sold. Despite his father’s doubts and the weight of family struggles, Dalai faces emotional challenges, balancing family expectations with his own dreams and ultimately forging his own path through the deep bond between man and horse.

items.title: Traços de Fuga
items.overview: Diana retreats into drawing and music to escape the chaos of her home. Each page of her notebook becomes an extension of the emotions she cannot bring herself to say out loud. But when even the smallest moments of peace are interrupted, Diana realizes that mentally escaping may no longer be enough to cope with the reality she lives in.

items.title: Hello! Pikmin: Dream
items.overview: Hey, you never know until you try!

items.title: Lonely Freddy
items.overview: Front and present is the titular Lonely Freddy; a body-snatching mini Freddy Fazbear animatronic issued by Fazbear Ent. in an attempt to "keep lonely kids company." After some tension with his sister, Alec finds himself right in the cross hairs of one! Alec experiences firsthand what these Lonely Freddy's are all about...

items.title: Earthbeat
items.overview: A nature recordist’s microphone becomes a lifeline to the wild, capturing echoes of a world that is struggling to be heard.

items.title: Some of Us Really Can't
items.overview: In an “LGBT-free zone” in the countryside, LGBTQIA+ people do not make themselves visible. This is how an intimate film came into being — one that does not seek to find them, but to understand the reasons for their apparent absence. These reasons emerge through conversations with local residents and in public spaces. Is it possible to live while remaining partially invisible?

items.title: Summer's End
items.overview: Grace has spent the summer looking after her dad, who is still mourning over the loss of his wife who died when Grace was a child. When her unpredictable older brother Oscar brings his friends to stay with them, Grace is forced to confront her relationship with the past and her expectations of the future.

items.title: One-Off
items.overview: When a death row convicted taxi driver picks his final meal, a twisted cook is determined to make it his most memorable.

items.title: Películas
items.overview: Lisandro, a young filmmaker, lies in bed with Nahuel, his lover. Lisandro is unable to get his films screened due to their subject matter, and a conversation with Nahuel leads him to make a decision.

items.title: IRL (In Real Life)
items.overview: Two friends, a domestic worker and a beautician, log into the BGMI combat game daily where they slip briefly out of their real lives. Through their avatars, they explore different selves, anonymity and intimacy inside the virtual world of the game, as the battlefield becomes as much about companionship and transgression, as it is about thrill. The docu-fiction explores how players reimagine their bodies and construct personas, revealing a landscape of desire and performance.

items.title: Life Sure Is Sweet
items.overview: Two years in the making, "Life Sure Is Sweet" is a independent coming-of-age snowboard documentary produced by the creative collective TDI (Technically Doing It). Featuring an all-Black and Brown crew of riders travelling and filming across the globe, the film moves beyond high-level action sports progression to explore deep themes of cultural identity, community, lifelong friendship, and charting your own path in the mountains.

items.title: Voyage
items.overview: nature only

items.title: East in the West
items.overview: The Story of the Cowboy in Bahrain follows a Bahraini man whose fascination with American cowboy culture has become part of his everyday life. Through his experience, the documentary looks at how a passion born far from its original setting can cross borders and take on a new meaning. The film captures an unusual meeting of cultures and the personal identity that grows from it.

items.title: Redamar
items.overview: Ulisses spends his days in a monotonous routine, longing for something that will never come: love. At night, in Fortaleza, he seeks to fulfill his repressed desires and frustrations, but his life begins to change when he receives news of his mother’s death in the distant neighborhood of Baleia.

items.title: Crunch
items.overview: A woman who suffers with misophonia has to endure a loud crisp eater on the train.

items.title: Cellulose
items.overview: Dean is a babysitter taking care of a creepy kid who keeps blaming things on his imaginary friend. Dean tries to console him before quickly realizing there is something else living in the house with them.

items.title: Lisa, Lusya - What's Your Name?
items.overview: A woman washes up on shore with no memory of who she is or how she got there.

items.title: Between Creases
items.overview: Through his late brother’s love of origami, a teenager discovers how a simple fold can connect memory, science, medicine, and hope.

items.title: Welcome to My Garden
items.overview: Things might happen in a garden, somewhere, sometime.

items.title: when clouds return home
items.overview: As twilight deepens, memory, scent, and silence drift through the air— where clouds, birds, and feelings quietly return home.

items.title: Practical Anarchy
items.overview: A defiant history of Bradford's 1in12 Club, the member-owned venue that became a beacon for protest and punk subcultures throughout the '80s and '90s. Long-standing club members reflect on the victories, struggles and the evolving destiny of the collective.

items.title: The Wronged of Juiced
items.overview: Gus sees a boy drinking juice. It is not the same as he remembers.

items.title: Paseo al Parque
items.overview: A walk through the Parc des Buttes-Chaumont. As sunlight bathes the trees and the bodies of those strolling through the park, a low-resolution cellphone camera struggles to process the light.

items.title: Kinder
items.overview: Tofino surfers Mathea and Sanoa Olin grew up chasing some of Canada’s finest cold water waves together. This short celebrates the different paths each has followed in their first cinematic reunion for the hard charging sisters since childhood.

items.title: Three Steps Forward
items.overview: A married couple's life is shattered by a premature loss. From that grief a conflict is born, and the two lovers no longer seem able to communicate. The loss hangs suspended between them: on one side, a woman who needs love to start living again; on the other, an astronaut frightened by the immensity of this pain, who sees the cosmos as a refuge.

items.title: Fault Lines
items.overview: For Noah Lane, the ocean has always been a place of freedom. But when a near-fatal accident at infamous Irish big wave spot Mullaghmore brings him face to face with his own mortality, the life he has built around the water begins to take on a different meaning.

items.title: ASTRONAUTALIEN
items.overview: A stranded astronaut orbiting Earth meets an alien who suddenly shows up in his space station.

items.title: Odeberecy
items.overview: In "ODEBERECY," we follow a day in the life of a babalorixá during a Candomblé festival, seen through the eyes of his spiritual children. Amidst rituals, displays of affection, responsibilities, and moments of celebration, the film reveals the human dimension behind the figure of the Pai de Santo, exploring the relationships forged within the terreiro and the bonds of ancestry, faith, and belonging that sustain this community.

items.title: Hitchhiker
items.overview: A woman traveling alone on a highway at night crosses paths with two men that change her life, one a lonely gas station attendant, and the other, a man on the run.

items.title: Încă o treaptă
items.overview: The 2025/26 season of Politehnica Timișoara, with coach Dan Alexa on the bench, and the Romanian club's return to Liga 2.

items.title: Dislocated Thumbs Part 1
items.overview: An experimental short film that follows the creator's headspace as he grapples with the loss of his memory, identity, and mind, which are twisted by overlapping influences.

items.title: Night Call
items.overview: A freelancer has a phone call with his mother.

items.title: Just A Mirage
items.overview: A woman shaped by devotion and sacrifice begins to see fractured versions of her younger self emerging from cracks in reality, revealing a hidden dreamlike realm beneath the ordinary world. As boundaries dissolve, she must choose between the life built for others or entering that fractured space to reclaim herself.

items.title: MCO: Marriage Crisis Ongoing
items.overview: Despite the MCO, arranged marriages and matches are still on-going.

items.title: מה אתה רואה?
items.overview: Daniel, an introverted and lonely young man, compulsively records conversations in secret and is the main subject of Mai’s documentary, in which she tries to understand why he does it. After she suddenly disappears, Daniel sets out to find her. As he searches through the archive and his memories, Daniel discovers their similarities and their shared fear of intimacy.

items.title: La lave ne brûle pas
items.overview: Filmed in 16mm, this poetic journey reconnects gender transitions with the Earth's movements and the lava flowing around its core.

items.title: Malvina
items.overview: Malvina is an angel sent to earth for being ignorant of it's problems. she falls to earth and after an incounter with a grieving mother seeks adamentley the love she talks about. when receiving this love finally she becomes addicted. she is filled with so much love for everyone she eventually loses herself completely in the desires and wants of everyone around her.

items.title: Plants Get Lonely
items.overview: A young scientist finds the answer to a botanical experiment in an unexpected place...

items.title: My Wife Doesn’t Move Anymore
items.overview: In a world where love is currency and women are commodities, a man constructs an elaborate justification for abandoning his immobile wife and caged daughter for another woman living next door.

items.title: Ruckus
items.overview: A study session is interrupted by an irritating racket.

items.title: He Loves Me
items.overview: Hungover Iris, locked out of her apartment by her boyfriend, is desperate to find a place to pee.

items.title: Knar
items.overview: In a quiet village, the body of an elderly man, Bhimsen Chhetri, is prepared for his final rites. His legs are carefully tied, his body bound with ritual precision, and the mourners stand in silence as tradition is followed without question. As the funeral procession begins, the film shifts decades into the past. A younger Bhimsen helps carry the body of his friend named Balmiki along with one old man and another young man through mustard fields toward the riverside for cremation. During a brief rest, a young man and an old man went to collect the wood into the jungle leaving Bhimsen alone with the corpse. What follows is an unexplainable event.

items.title: Kronoshock
items.overview: Nestled in the middle of a secluded valley and surrounded by green meadows and rivers, an imposing mass of snow and rock rises abruptly. The adventurous Lord Cliffrider hopes to be the first to achieve the summit of his longed-for mountain, but as time passes, this dream vanishes like the smoke from his pipe. This is a silent stop-motion film about the ambitions of a climber to reach the top.

items.title: Curb Appeal
items.overview: From conception to construction, a dream home is built.

items.title: King of War
items.overview: A merchant takes a dog to the front lines and encounters a deserter along the way.

items.title: The Seventh Circle
items.overview: Olívia seeks a way to cope with her toxic family life

items.title: I'm Still Flying
items.overview: It’s not easy to turn your back on your family and just say ‘Okay, I can do it,' but one grandma's love for a fairy gave her the strength she needed to go through an immigration journey from Iran to the United States.

items.title: La fille du rocher
items.overview: Livia, a 16-year-old teenager, spends the day with friends by the river where she witnesses a scene that plunges her into a strange dizzy state.

items.title: The Stars Are Comforting
items.overview: New Zealand astronomer Beatrice Tinsley sets off to Austin, Texas to get her theory of the universe heard.

items.title: Sonora
items.overview: In silence, three people share the same house: Ayla, a young Indigenous trans woman, is pregnant; Ferreirinha, a down-and-out accountant, harbors pro-Bolsonaro delusions; Sebastião, a lonely elderly man, is at war with the gardens. Sound trucks, campaign jingles, and evangelical hymns pierce through the walls: the public space outside devours their private lives. Deafening.

items.title: A House in One Night
items.overview: It is said that Penrhos cottage was built in one night. According to Welsh folklore, if you could build a house overnight on common land, with smoke rising from the chimney by dawn, the place would be yours to keep. 200 years later in rural Pembrokeshire, the house stands still in time. Beneath its thatched roof lived Rachel and Maria, two sisters who spent their days crafting a life that defied societal rules written for women. Quietly radical, the pair were celebrated by the whole community. Tŷ Unnos is a fairytale documentary told through the eyes of the children who once visited. Recounting memories of Penrhos and the legacy of its last owners, the past flickers back to life.

items.title: A Sliver of Truth
items.overview: One day, a man happens to witness a woman eating insects alone. A few weeks later, she approaches him for advice on a screenplay she is writing. The story is about a pervert who becomes sexually aroused by eating insects and is eventually caught by someone.

items.title: Stuck!
items.overview: Dr. Atkins, the hospital’s expert in removing “foreign objects”, finds himself in a bind when he forgets to get a present for his big wedding anniversary. When the perfect gift presents itself inside a patient, will he be willing to risk it all for love?

items.title: Duo
items.overview: Exploring connection, place, and the magic of cold-water surfing on both sides of the lens, this is a glimpse into the partnership of surf photographer and surfer, husband and wife, Rory and Elle Sutherland.

items.title: Jamlitz: A Documentary Fairy-Tale
items.overview: The Lower Lusatian village of Jamlitz/Jemjelnica was once a thriving artists’ colony. Later, the Nazis built a concentration camp there, and from 1945 the site served as a Soviet special camp. Now Friederike, the great-granddaughter of an artist, returns, hoping to use her family’s creative legacy to revive the village and heal the wounds of collective memory.

items.title: Štom stejo mrěje – At the End of the Bread Tree
items.overview: As a forestry worker, Jürgen Spottke (b. 1941) once helped plant the spruce forests of Upper Lusatia. As a wood artist, he drew on the coexistence of Sorbs and Germans. Today he is watching the forests die from drought and bark beetles. What would remain of Lusatia in a world of monocultures – without the Sorbian/Wendish?

items.title: Beneath the Surface
items.overview: From sharks beneath the waves to the people we pass by every day, this film reveals the worlds we miss when we let fear and assumptions keep us from looking deeper.

items.title: We Laugh Alone
items.overview: A filmmaker finds both connection and embarrassment while trying to learn how comedy can be both a part and product of one's culture.

items.title: Alone At Night
items.overview: An empathy-provoking journey through a seemingly safe city, told through the wary eyes of a young woman, Emma, who sees everything on her nighttime walk as heightened.

items.title: HYPOTHETICALLY
items.overview: On the morning of their last A-level exam before leaving for university, Dan decides to tell his best friend Joe something he's been keeping to himself. Nervous and unable to say what he really means, Dan hides behind a series of hypotheticals, trying to discover how Joe might react if someone liked their best friend.

items.title: Grub Explains Portsmouth
items.overview: Portsmouth legend "Grub" lets you know what's going on round here.

items.title: Full Pitch
items.overview: Returning to the first training session after an absence, Meadbh is ready to resume as team captain of her football team. She’s excited to meet her friends again, but when she’s introduced to Úna, she’s not quite sure what to make of her. Their coach swings in with a pep talk. Meadbh sits alone. Maybe things are different?  On the field, Meadbh’s game is off. The coach tries to keep things moving, offering advice as best he can. The session continues but the captain is thrown and it comes to a head. The girls get into a scuffle which forces them to take some time off the pitch. Úna isn't happy, Meadbh's frustration is clear.  The two girls find a moment to talk and discover a mutual respect. They return to their team with a newfound sense of purpose. As she drives home with her mother, Meadbh ruminates on the session, newly affirmed.

items.title: Iron-Cock
items.overview: As Leonardo Leonardo wants to dominate the cannabis market, he has his old foes Jay and Bob to face off with in a way he has never seen.

items.title: Manama Cairo
items.overview: A young man plans to get married in Cairo, but a short trip turns into an unexpected adventure after he forgets the address he needs to reach. Amid strange situations and surprising encounters, his journey becomes one of self-discovery and purpose, in a story filled with comedy and simplicity.

items.title: All Sacrifices Made for the Love Over Yonder
items.overview: A troubled Filipino teen looks to his friends and family for self-understanding and empathizes with their hardships, using this newfound knowledge of his Filipino identity to let his individuality and ethnicity co-exist while wishing his loved ones a pursuit for their own peace.

items.title: Loss Comes in Waves
items.overview: A filmmaker ponders the meaning of grief and loss - with help from a dog.

items.title: A Place in the Pack
items.overview: Documentary about the Caledonia Thebans, an LGBT rugby team from Scotland.

items.title: The Last Ally
items.overview: Poland, spring 1945. In a landscape suspended between the end of the war and the beginning of uncertainty, two survivors meet: a Polish prisoner on the run and a young German deserter.

items.title: Ellaathukum Oru Publicity
items.overview: After an act of kindness goes viral, an ordinary person finds their life suddenly overwhelmed by attention from media outlets and political parties.

items.title: Tutto Rimane
items.overview: In the shadow of Monte Vettore, a winding mountain road leads to a settlement of yellow container houses, where a community is still recovering from an earthquake. Shortly before Easter, the villagers prepare for their annual procession through the ruins of their former homes. At nightfall, torches are lit and songs echo through the empty streets. What begins as a solemn ritual of remembrance quietly reveals the fragile balance between faith, loss and the will to rebuild.

items.title: The Melancholy Cure
items.overview: A young man is pushed to his limits  by a persuasive entity.

items.title: It's Just Business
items.overview: When a desperate young woman finds herself in a late-night diner, she's offered a fortune by a mysterious stranger. But in order to earn it, she must commit her first murder.

items.title: forming en route
items.overview: At various paces and rhythms, a portrait of a French estuary town unfolds - a study of how light falls on a locale and its various aspects. As we wander from place to place through reflections and shadows, intermittently entering into different worlds, we notice how the activities of the inhabitants shape our experience of the environment. The people, architecture, weather, the everyday details, given equal significance in forming the landscape of the film with a dreamlike inner logic.

items.title: Chroma
items.overview: Three female artists share their stories to paint a perfect picture on how art can be a tool for self-expression and healing.

items.title: A Small Desire
items.overview: Through landscapes and nocturnal glimpses of men claiming public space, a Kashmiri woman narrates her lifelong negotiation with fear, curfews, and gendered restriction. The film is a quiet meditation on how the smallest desires expose the vast inequalities that shape women’s freedom.

items.title: Boys From The Slum
items.overview: A documentary following boys growing up in Rio de Janeiro's favelas, revealing the hardships of daily life, poverty, violence, and the lack of opportunities that limit their choices, dreams, and hopes for a better future.

items.title: The Surf Was Better Before
items.overview: Breton surfer Ian Fontaine time travels into the future to become the person he fears: an old-timer who claims everything was better before, in this beautifully observed and wry take on surfing folk lore.

items.title: Echo
items.overview: ‘Echo’ moves between routine and desire. Shoemaker by day, drummer by night. In search of recognition and meaning. When a young woman with a broken shoe walks into his shop, she awakens something in Echo. A chain reaction of encounters, unfortunate choices and lost sounds breaks loose.

items.title: Within
items.overview: An intimate portrait of resilience, identity and the search for a new sense of self, Stephen Downes opens a window into his oceanic world in this powerful story exploring what lies beyond survival, and the freedom that can be found when we refuse to be defined by our past.

items.title: Never End
items.overview: A story about a crack in a wall.

items.title: Kilometer 9 or Since When Do You Stop to Look at the City
items.overview: On a December night, the sound of motorcycles and fireworks fills the streets of Medellín, as the improbable connection between two young men from almost opposite worlds unfolds through a conversation that lays them bare, along with the labyrinthine streets they wander. Both face the constant threat of death and oblivion; at every stop, they pause to observe the city, holding on to that fleeting moment amidst the uncertainty.

items.title: The Sagittarian Journey
items.overview: On the eve of her 30th birthday, Raphaëlle sets out on an expedition to the Himalayas, together with her uncle and father. She attempts to understand what moved her to climb a 6,000-metre-high mountain.

items.title: Altitude
items.overview: During a trek in the Pyrenees, a teenage boy is pushed ever higher by his fearless mother. What begins as adventure turns into a struggle for autonomy.

items.title: The Dancing Plague
items.overview: 1518AD - when a pregnant woman is forced to flee her home, she forms an unlikely connection with a band of outcasts who draw her into a frenzied forest dance ritual.

items.title: Thread
items.overview: A thread. A yarn. A tale. A story to tell. A visual and sonic masterpiece journeying across the Celtic fringes, through thunderous barrels and peeling points breaks, pulling on threads that reveal that it’s as much about the journey as the folk that are with you along the way.

items.title: United We Run
items.overview: In the days after 9/11, New York City Marathon organizers and city, state, and federal officials faced an unprecedented question: Should one of the world's largest marathons move forward in a city still reeling from unimaginable loss?

items.title: Nairn Men's Shed
items.overview: In the north of Scotland, a group of men are finding new ways to support each other.

items.title: El vuelo de los cóndores
items.overview: Vania, a young and enigmatic police officer, arrives at Laura’s remote cabin under the pretext of completing her tactical diving training in freezing waters. However, she is concealing her true objective: to uncover the truth about her own past and her connection to Laura.

items.title: Asking 4 It
items.overview: A man views women only as objects of desire, until one morning he wakes to find he has changed into a woman. Confronted with life on the other side, he discovers the cost of being "desirable".

items.title: Executioners
items.overview: Through fragments of Andrzej Wajda’s films, a found-footage essay explores the conflict between the individual and power, the persistence of collective memory, and class struggle.

items.title: De Barriga Pra Cima
items.overview: Here in Monte Alegre, we dream of land, we dream of water, of the sky; we dream of things that exist and things that do not yet exist. A film created as part of a cinema workshop in the *quilombola* community of Monte Alegre, in Cachoeiro de Itapemirim, Espírito Santo.

items.title: Crime 0
items.overview: Trapped in isolation, a crime novelist becomes consumed by the world of his final manuscript as the boundaries between fiction and reality slowly dissolve. Haunted by guilt, loss, and the search for truth, he is forced into a confrontation that may become the final chapter of his life.

items.title: The Girl Beneath The Sun
items.overview: Teenage sugarcane harvester Shivkanya confronts the realities of early motherhood and marriage, unspoken duties, an eccentric  husband and an uncertain future that shapes and  constrains her dreams, identity and hopes for her child and herself.

items.title: Emplesbourg
items.overview: Emplesbourg is a horror movie released in 2026.

items.title: Pioneers
items.overview: Pioneers, Written and Directed by Cooper Shelton, follows four young boys who venture down into ancient underground city, with one goal. Find an ancient giant that supposedly terrorized the civilization that dominated the depths a millennium ago.

items.title: The Final Order
items.overview: The commander has one final order

items.title: Plankgas
items.overview: After taking a detour on a deserted road, a professional entertainer is pursued by a menacing pick-up truck and must outsmart its relentless driver to survive.

items.title: Pro Casual
