items.overview: An ode to surfing joy. Featuring Steph Gilmore, Caity Simmers, Bryce Young, Ryan Burch, Derrick Disney, Leah Dawson Lopez, Tosh Tudor and Jaleesa Vincent, charging waves from California to South Africa to Indonesia.

items.title: Grace Petrie: This Is No Time To Panic
items.overview: Saving the world is pretty heroic. Grace Petrie has been singing protest songs for 15 years, and she’s fed up! If folk songs can’t save the world, how about folk songs and standup combined?! No Time To Panic sees her weave together her critically acclaimed words and songs for the first time: a depressed audience is no good, so she’s going to change our personal climates if she has to do it one person at a time. Grace isn’t going to fight shy of hefty topics so age guidance is 16+ and you should go prepared to get motivated!

items.title: BONDE
items.overview: On a remote Swedish island, a sheltered farmer is forced beyond the boundaries of his isolated life, confronting autonomy, fear, and the fragile possibility of connection.

items.title: As Seen on TV
items.overview: A depressed, lonely woman orders a free trial of happiness off an infomercial.

items.title: The History of (Dog) Judo
items.overview: Roy and Rexley, legendary stars of the original Dog Judo cartoon series, argue over the modernization of judo, contrasting traditional techniques with futuristic ideas involving gaming consoles and other unusual equipment. Neil Adams, the UK's most successful ever judoist, appears as himself to give wise counsel.

items.title: Left Handed
items.overview: An unearthly creature falls into a playground, and falls some more.

items.title: Pilih Saya!
items.overview: In a world where food can talk, every side dish brags about itself and argue to prove why it deserves to be the one and only side dish for rice.

items.title: History Perched On A Needle
items.overview: In January 2026, merchants and shopkeepers protesting the economic situation take to the streets in Tehran. A very personal memoir of everyday life lived under the shadow of these dark and ominous days.

items.title: Yendo Contra el Viento
items.overview: With 16mm images and black-and-white photographs, a personal essay film guides us through Santo Domingo. Shaped as it is by unrest, habits and reflections, it becomes clear that the cityscape also mirrors an inner state.

items.title: Sometimes I dream about _____ too
items.overview: An energy company's emissions manager suspects that foul play, or even a conspiracy, may be behind his amnesia. Caught up in routine tasks, hollow slogans and surreal visions, he becomes immersed in an eerie eco-nightmare.

items.title: Gloam
items.overview: New artificial lighting is supposed to make Berlin's Görlitzer Park safer – but not for everyone. What would the night pond have to say about this state of affairs if it could speak? A mixture of mythology, scientific findings and archival materials may provide the answer.

items.title: The Bird Lives On
items.overview: Bora, a girl who loves playing duck-hunting games, stumbles upon an injured parrot and nurses it back to health. With her parrot Ppoppo, Bora experiences the happiest days of her life. Then one night, Ppoppo dies.

items.title: Impromptu
items.overview: Lora and her dog follow the same routine every morning. It includes an elevator ride with their neighbour Lyakov and his own pooch. Lyakov, a retired piano teacher and "the world's grumpiest man", never greets the two of them – until, one morning, he suddenly decides to kiss Lora.

items.title: Love Interest
items.overview: Hazel auditions for the part of Love Interest in a big budget film. The director is so enamoured with her performance that he continues the romance in real life -- all she has to do is stay in character.

items.title: Hey Sexy
items.overview: Paul is a builder who makes a habit of catcalling women. But before long, Paul's routine is disturbed when his hammer starts talking dirty to him.

items.title: Dynamite Dealer
items.overview: Alex Ludd is a rugby lad navigating the macho, meathead world of the Idley Trojans. His bravado spirals as he attempts to prove himself in a rough-and-tumble world where strength, loyalty, and pride collide.

items.title: Is This Good?
items.overview: We all face expectations about who we should be, how we should look, and what we should achieve. This film explores where those expectations come from, how they shape us, and what it means to break free from the pressure to be perfect.

items.title: The Observer
items.overview: We all have different personality when we start seeing it that call observer

items.title: Kalocsa
items.overview: A lovesick film director visits his ex-girlfriend in her small Hungarian hometown, hopeful of winning her back.

items.title: The Last Seen
items.overview: Inside a silent home, presence slowly turns into absence. As time distorts and emotions fade, what once felt alive begins to disappear.

items.title: For Lack of a Better World
items.overview: An experimental documentary short exploring how our sense of self is reshaped through conversations with machines. Through the lived experience of people in India speaking to AI, the film captures a fragile moment in which intimacy, care, and vulnerability are quietly shifting away from human bonds and toward artificial companionship. What happens when we train a machine to understand us better than we understand ourselves? Though these exchanges take place in private, the voices reveal something collective.

items.title: Late Check-In
items.overview: He's alone, he is all tied up, and he doesn't know who did it to him.

items.title: American Trilogy
items.overview: American Trilogy narrates the deep life of Elvis Presley, the King of Rock, through real filming. This is a cinematic, exciting and dynamic experience.

items.title: A Flowing Symphony
items.overview: Amid the cyclical rhythms of rice cultivation, the soil of Lung Nga Pai in Tai Po whispers its secrets of time, and reveals the subtle tensions and resonances between nature and human presence.

items.title: Alone
items.overview: A lonely young man is spending a night by himself in his apartment and begins to suspect he might not actually be alone.

items.title: A Sunflower in Delhi
items.overview: In a tiny women’s only beauty parlour, generations of devoted customers, including the filmmaker’s family, reflect on letting their hair go grey. The film meanders between the intimate oasis of the Sunflower Chinese Beauty Parlour and the bustling city landscape outside.

items.title: The Six Seconds
items.overview: A son contemplates what his final words will be to his dying father...

items.title: Most Likely
items.overview: As the night progresses, his crush Gregory seems to be getting closer to him...

items.title: The Search for Dinner
items.overview: After a chaotic neighbour eats everything in the house, a starving Matthew sets off in a hunger-fuelled trance that leads him into one bizarre food disaster after another. His brother Benji, their gang-affiliated cousin Peter and the very neighbour who caused it all must find him before it’s too late.

items.title: Shattering the Dawn
items.overview: Dawn breaks and the exhausted Mar tries to carry on partying and enjoy the moment, but she feels a pain she cannot explain. As she slowly begins to realise what has happened, the after-party turns into a nightmare.

items.title: WHOLE BODY LIKE GONE
items.overview: An empty swimming pool becomes the staging grounds for a puppet-protagonist as she confronts her disappointment, longing, and pleasure.

items.title: There Is Something I Want to Tell You
items.overview: Following a recent act of terrorism, growing homophobia among those around Jaro leaves him feeling increasingly cornered. The situation threatens the identity he has kept hidden.

items.title: The Age of L'EUROPEO
items.overview: Filmed in Milan and Sofia, the film traces the fate of one of the most influential print media outlets in European history, whose traditions are preserved today solely by its Bulgarian editorial team.

items.title: El último rescate en la Patagonia
items.overview: In the heart of the arid Patagonian desert, a mission as improbable as it is urgent comes to life: to rescue two fossilized dinosaur nests that could contain intact embryos. Boris, director of the paleontological museum in Lamarque—a small town in the remote Middle Valley of Río Negro—leads this unique expedition.
stream: Amazon Prime Video Free with Ads

items.title: The Dead Of Three Villages
items.overview: At the beginning of the 20th century, a man falls from his horse and dies at a three-village crossroads in Diyarbakır. A Muslim Kurdish mullah, an Armenian Christian priest, and a Yezidi Kurdish Sheikh come together to determine the man's religion. While the villagers wait to see how he will be buried, each religious leader interprets the marks on the man's body according to his own faith.

items.title: Some Pages, Some People
items.overview: brings together three individuals who reflect on the significance of reading, the cultural richness of Hindi literature, and the need to reconnect with the written word. Through their conversations, the documentary explores the relationship between literature, language, memory, and our understanding of the world.

items.title: Ember Notes
items.overview: A saxophonist struggling with burnout loses his passion for music, until unexpected connections offer a new way to rediscover his spark.

items.title: Moonless Night in a Coal Mine
items.overview: Among brief on-screen texts and hilarious sound design, total darkness becomes the protagonist of a short film that is as minimalist as it is ironic.

items.title: I Can Lasso the Stars and Dildo for You!
Impersonation
items.overview: Pratiroopa is a portrait of look-alike artist named Jaishri Raju who has been impersonating  Dr.Vishnuvardhan for more than two decades for a living. The film follows his journey as an impersonator and how he manages to fill the massive void left behind by the star, performing and recreating his iconic moments and songs, and in-turn entertaining fans.  The film also reflects upon the larger subcultures of rural orchestra and company theatre in Karnataka.

items.title: The Strongest Team in Vilnius
items.overview: From playing on neighborhood courts to winning numerous titles in basketball tournaments. The “Ferimstos” basketball players, who call themselves the strongest team in Vilnius, invite you to join their eighteen-year-long story of friendship—a journey through basketball courts, arguments, wild parties, and eternal love.

items.title: while I was away
items.overview: ‘while I was away' follows a group of four friends spending an ordinary day together, but beneath the laughter and nostalgia, one of them feels increasingly disconnected. As the day unfolds, memories and dreamlike moments blur the line between being surrounded by people and truly feeling present. A short film about friendship, isolation and the quiet distance we can feel, even when we're never physically alone.

items.title: San Giuliano di Puglia, ore 11.32 - Il crollo
Leave It Where You Found It
items.overview: An unearthed Polaroid comes with a visitor.

items.title: Dug. Or, The Moral Of The Story Is
items.overview: Mikey got drunk. But it’s no aw bad, know wit ah mean? A film about getting lost up a back alley in a British town with too many cul-de-sacs. Proof that the Scottish gift isn’t bagpipes – but rather the ability to spin any old nonsense into an epic.

items.title: Retrato de una memoria
items.overview: An elderly widower lives alone until a child’s presence intrudes upon his home. This small visitor completely disrupts his isolation, stripping away the last tangible links he has to his late wife. In his attempt to recover them, the old man is forced to revisit forgotten corners of his own house. Despite his initial resistance, the child insists on leading him to an abandoned greenhouse—a space that once belonged to his wife. Amidst plants beginning to sprout anew and the heavy burden of grief, the two forge an unexpected bond that helps them process their loss. Only then does the old man feel ready to fulfill his final wish: a long-awaited reunion with her.

items.title: Magi: A Story of Wonder
items.overview: What if the Star of Bethlehem wasn't a myth? Join Andy Reese on a fascinating journey through history, astronomy, geography, and Scripture to uncover the remarkable evidence behind the story of the Magi and discover the wonder of a God who is always at work.

items.title: Non-Degradable
items.overview: Plastic waste. The sea washes ashore what remains. Plastic does not break down; it only changes, becoming smaller, less visible, more dangerous. On the Croatian Adriatic coast, people are watching the growing pollution of the sea with great concern and considering what they can do about it. Even if only on a small scale.

items.title: Mono No Aware
items.overview: The spiritual journey of a human being -an idealized model, a prophet of purity- on the path toward the Nietzschean Übermensch, reinterpreted through a contemporary lens. From the social darkness of the Camel, taking its steps through a desert of melancholy and solitude, to the verbal force of the Lion, reflected in its absolute moral freedom and freedom of thought, up to the birth of the Child, the very manifesto of innocence, ruled by instinct, physical ecstasy, a continuous search for the Self, and constant linguistic experimentation.

items.title: Running Late
items.overview: One man’s surreal morning routine.

items.title: ROYA
items.overview: A taxi driver discovers a pair of AI-powered glasses that reveal glimpses of the life he might have lived. Drawn into visions of abandoned dreams and choices never made, he enters a surreal landscape built from his unrealised possibilities. The journey forces him to confront the distance between the life he imagined and the one he chose.

items.title: Gestalt
items.overview: Facing the inhabited space again through an unfamiliar gaze, attempting to discover a hidden body through ambiguous observation. Either a return or another rupture.

items.title: Love in Three Acts
items.overview: An intimate autobiographical film weaving together years of analogue photographs, self-portraits, and moving image. What began as a private act of preservation unfolds into a quiet meditation on bipolar disorder, love, family, and everyday memory.  Love in Three Acts is an intimate autobiographical film weaving together years of analogue photographs, self-portraits, and moving image.  What began as a private act of preservation — documenting early motherhood in isolation during the pandemic — unfolds into a quiet meditation on bipolar disorder, love, family, and everyday memory. Moving between humour and heartbreak, the film gathers fragments of self as woman, artist, and mother, while tracing a fraught relationship with photography after leaving photojournalism.  At its core, Love in Three Acts is an offering of a private world, now shared.

items.title: Inspecting the ponds
items.overview: Inspecting the Ponds documents the daily labor and living conditions of clam farmers in Qigu, Tainan, under Taiwan's fishery-solar symbiosis policy. Through pond patrols, seeding, harvesting, and post-typhoon recovery, the film follows Mr. Tsai and Ms. Lin's aquaculture lives, portraying how the arrival of solar development has gradually transformed the relationship between people and the land, and how farmers continue to make choices amid uncertainty and survival.

items.title: I Walk in Shoes of Dreams
items.overview: A young female protagonist moves idly through her flat and routine, pondering questions about growing up, or curiosity about her own body and love. Her daydreams morph into words and fragmented images, creating a new reality.

items.title: 5th Spring
items.overview: An intimate portrait of growing up, told in reverse chronology, gradually revealing how hidden past experiences shape a person's emotions, relationships, and life choices.

items.title: F**k Me in Saint-Gilles
items.overview: During a jam session in Saint-Gilles, the story of Harry and Tina’s explosive, erratic, lustful affair emerges through music. Every tune reveals a crescendo of sensuality, a heartbreak pause - their jazzy romance is the ultimate 'matching each other's freak'.

items.title: Amargô
items.overview: Amargô is a dark fable about a seamstress who returns to her hometown, seeking to reconnect with her daughter, only to find a place consumed by poisonous memories.

items.title: Half-Life
items.overview: Cumbrian poet Emma McGordon wrestles with mental health and class-based barriers as she tries to turn her poem into a film. Poetic yet gritty, this experimental performance piece weaves together McGordon’s experiences of heartbreak and OCD.

items.title: Cabeceira
items.overview: After being kicked out of the house by her mother, Rita returns to find her younger sister, Chica, all alone. Together, they set out for a walk through a landscape marked by loneliness and a lack of prospects.

items.title: I Can Lasso the Stars and Dildo for You!
Saweel
items.overview: On the edge of an industrial landscape, a body seeks solitude by performing a ritual involving the washing of wheat grains ("Saweel"). Memories awaken and fuse with the rhythms of movement and sound, opening a space for transformation and continuity.

items.title: Do Not Be Afraid
items.overview: A transgender woman miraculously becomes pregnant with the second coming of Christ.

items.title: Fairy Godmothers Inc.
items.overview: At 'Ursitoare SRL', magical godmothers are hired out on a commercial basis. But when newcomer Dana is sent to work her first christening, the plan backfires and a family's world is turned upside down.

items.title: Capsulated
items.overview: Desperate to find friends, a university freshman takes a mysterious drug and discovers a paranormal side effect.

items.title: Unhealed Wounds
items.overview: A sentimental journey of a desi family navigating the loss of a husband and father as they regain control over their lives.

items.title: Separation
items.overview: 2022. The war has begun, and so has mobilisation. Lyosha searches frantically for his passport, terrified of being called up. His father stays behind in Russia and says nothing. Three minutes of film, simple yet powerful, about the mortal fear of being sent to fight in a war you don't want.

items.title: The Entropy of Sin
items.overview: A young man is drawn into a secret order his father once served; whose doctrine of intellectual sins tests his conscience.

items.title: Do or Die
items.overview: Two "criminals" are forced to play against each other on a sadistic game show.

items.title: Messages
items.overview: A compilation of voice notes from a group of online friends, these messages show the simultaneous limits and possibilities of fandom culture united through the internet.

items.title: Façade
items.overview: In an apartment building, a variety of residents live side by side. Behind each door lies a personal secret. Some darker, some stranger than they first appear. Outwardly cheerful Joosep, dreamy Pille-Riin, withdrawn Ott, and nosy Magda – each harbors an inner world that slowly begins to seep through the wallpaper and walls. As the residents struggle to keep their secrets hidden, cracks begin to spread through the building’s facade. Soon, all their secrets threaten to come to light.

items.title: Gazawyat: Noor
items.overview: The film follows Nour, a Palestinian journalist living through genocide between frontline reporting and displacement, as life inside a tent exposes the fragility of privacy, the body, and marriage, turning her daily existence into a silent struggle for dignity, voice, and humanity under constant threat.

items.title: 1H
items.overview: Tenderness by the hour. Two teenagers check into a cheap hourly hotel for their first time and stumble, red-faced, into their first real moment of closeness. Mara Cohn tells an unvarnished, laconic and moving coming-of-age story somewhere between fumbling and feeling.

items.title: Gazawyat: Hadeel
items.overview: Far from the news, a silent genocide seeks to crush the humanity and femininity of women in displacement camps. The film dives into spontaneous moments of shared storytelling, where displaced women gather to reclaim their selves through ancient rituals. It is their attempt to rebuild the fortress of femininity dismantled by displacement, a bold declaration that the dignity of the body is the enduring reflection of the soul amidst the ruins.

items.title: Aydinlar - Where the World Ends
items.overview: The children of Moynaq know the sea only from their grandparents' songs. They play among abandoned shipwrecks that have long since become rusting witnesses to a lost world. The Aral Sea has almost completely vanished, but the hope that it will return, as bitter as it is futile, persists.

items.title: Claw & Order
items.overview: When a sudden and unexplained extinction wipes out Whitby’s lobster stocks, the local community is thrown into crisis. Fishermen and scientists must join forces to restore an ecosystem on the brink, with a little help from their hard-shelled heroes.

items.title: CAN I COME HOME NOW?
items.overview: A quiet stroll through the heart of Paris, where solitude and memories are imbued with a unique melancholy.

items.title: No Love 0/2
items.overview: An original animated crime story, of people and their fate, of their unsustainable debt of existence, of their corruption and violence.

items.title: On Earth
items.overview: It's the last day on earth. A boy and a girl promise each other that they're going to spend it together. They say goodbye to what's left of their families and leave together Milan, venturing further and further into a wounded Po Valley. They hide out in a country house waiting for the end. But will it come?

items.title: Watching
items.overview: A biology student's life is in danger when they discover their classmate is a spy camera designed to study humans.

items.title: Büyük Yalan Kulübü
items.overview: Carrying her heart in her hands, Mrs. Ivory joins the Grand Lie Club, where lying is mandatory.

items.title: I am my Mothers Daughter
items.overview: A young girl takes her chance to escape her mother's drug induced abuse as she runs away with her boyfriend. Just as she begins adjusting to her new life, she realizes she hasn't fully escaped her mother's grasp.

items.title: Franke de Jong: De Heerenveense Hitchcock
items.overview: Franke de Jong: De Heerenveense Hitchcock presents a selection of crime films by filmmaker Franke de Jong. For this compilation film, his film footage was digitized in 4K quality by the Frisian Film & Audio Archive and was screened at the 46th Noordelijk Film Festival.

items.title: Dodger
items.overview: In near-future wartime Australia, Vic approaches her friend Sam with a drastic plan to dodge the draft.

items.title: Production Exercise 1
items.overview: A man teleports while looking for something.

items.title: Tukki, From the Roots to the Bayou
items.overview: Senegalese jazz musician Alune Wade travels through West Africa and on to New Orleans to delve into jazz music's connection to African music and culture.

items.title: Rad Hair Robbie
items.overview: Robbie is a wig shop owner whose life takes a turn after a series of bizarre events.

items.title: Heritage Minutes: Captain Jonathan Snyder
items.overview: The quick thinking of Captain Jonathan Snyder during an ambush in Afghanistan saves the lives of dozens, and leads him and four other Canadian soldiers to receive medals for their bravery.

items.title: Pizza Boys IV: Revengeance, the Final Stroke
items.overview: War has changed.  It's been 30 years since Officer Chief died. The Pizza Boys Program has long-since been decommissioned, cast aside for the new age of technological warfare. Tony Pizza and Cody Peplin find themselves forlorn and forgotten, adrift amidst regrets and inadequacy. They try to forget, but the world has not forgotten them. A new threat emerges from the ashes of their past.  The return of Officer Chief... and a plot to destroy all pasta as we know it. America needs the Pizza Boys, but will they be willing to put everything on the line to ensure the safety of humanity?

items.title: LA Metro
items.overview: A personal letter to a father and a love letter to Los Angeles, LA Metro explores immigration, memory, and belonging through the lives that share the city's buses.

items.title: Witch Hunt
items.overview: In a near future dystopian world, modern witches are hunted by men of the old world in the name of power. Told through the eyes of two witches in love, this sapphic fantasy short is a modern retelling of the witch hunts of the 1600's.

items.title: Twister Alley
items.overview: A 1,000-mile chain of tornadoes tears through the USA striking unprepared cities with unprecedented chaos. Now as the storm intensifies, a team of scientists must race against time to stop the deadliest tornado outbreak in history.

items.title: Les lunettes de...
items.overview: A young man fails to understand why his relationship attempts keep failing one after the other. His friend decides to help him out...

items.title: Henry V
items.overview: Artistic take on Henry V. Recommended to watch (as NO lan intended) on a 30 year old school projector.

items.title: Un traidor fiel
items.overview: During the day of the 2022 World Cup final, Lorenzo, a secret agent, receives alongside his mentor Hugo a mission to intervene a conversation. As the investigation develops, tensions will arise amid mistrust within the duo, putting their relationship at stake and unveiling double-crossing shenanigans.

items.title: Ecstasy Of Tragedy
items.overview: A physics professor sets up a car accident for herself. On a quiet forest road she carefully calculates every part of the plan. Finally tucked into a hospital bed, she enjoys the success of her scheme, but for how long?

items.title: A Spinner
items.overview: Set in the wake of the Woman, Life, Freedom uprising and the global outcry following the death of Mahsa Amini. The plot follows a woman who seeks justice after surviving a violent alleyway attack, only to find herself trapped in a seemingly endless cycle of institutional oppression.

items.title: TIME OUT
items.overview: A story of friendship, risk, fear and loss. TIME OUT is an action comedy about Leevi and Viljami, two teens rejected by society who struggle to find their place in the world. Desperate to resolve their financial and personal problems, they turn to places where they have no business sticking their noses. The film explores just how far desperation and necessity can drive people in their darkest moments.

items.title: Sad Doll Since '14
items.overview: Maria, or Sylvia, spends over a decade caught in thoughts of companionship, reproduction, safety, pop culture, and death. She has been missing since 2022. The film pieces together what may have been her final thoughts.

items.title: The Fight
items.overview: A visually striking animated short film exploring themes of self-destructive ambition and ambiguous loss.

items.title: saturated reflections
items.overview: two people meet at a alleyway.

items.title: Vasera
items.overview: Story of Sikhs coming together to build a shared home

items.title: Between Breaths
items.overview: For many years, Florian Ledoux has lived and filmed on the drifting sea ice of Svalbard. Over time, a young polar bear crosses his path. He names her Grinch. Orphaned too soon, she grows up alone in a fragile and changing world. From a distance, Florian follows her journey, witnessing her resilience, her vulnerability, her life on the edge of survival. Between them, there is no contact. Only silence, distance… and presence. Yet, a bond quietly forms. Until the day she disappears.

items.title: Milk Inc. Forever: Live in Concert
Turtleneck
items.overview: It’s an ordinary autumnal Saturday. Somewhere between date four and five, Laura and Gus trade jokes and half-insults with a familiar rhythm. But they're circling the topic that matters most.

items.title: Mama
items.overview: Captured through the lens of a car's backup camera, a grieving immigrant mother is forced into a night of crime. After receiving a frantic call from her son in prison, motherly love is put to the test.

items.title: Helping Hand
items.overview: Anna hears concerning sounds in the flat above her, which ignites an unexpected coming together with an inconceivable outcome. A film about what it means to share a building with other people.

items.title: Multiple Choice
items.overview: During her very last school maths exam, high-achieving Grace is swept up into the hypnotic rhythm of the room and forced to confront her future as a variety of multiple-choice questions.

items.title: A Dirge
items.overview: Beth and Nel seek redemption in the wake of a traumatic event. This short film is an eerie exploration of who we become when anger turns into delusion and when love becomes desperation.

items.title: Fathers & Daughters
items.overview: After learning that her parents intend to sell their family home, lifeguard Orla Murphy finds her relationship with her father becoming increasingly strained but one fateful incident is about to put both of their lives into perspective.

items.title: Bredouille
items.overview: a lonely man, running through the forest, seems to escape something, however nobody  follows him. Then, who, or what is he running away from?

items.title: Diana in the Leaves
items.overview: Roger and Diana, a pair of writers soon to be wed, have just moved into the granny flat that stands beside Diana’s childhood home. They’ve escaped the hustle of their previous city life for a quieter, rural one. Yet, the ideas brewing in Roger’s mind are loud, cutting through the peace of the bush and turning it into something that, in Diana’s eyes, it is not. Attempting to understand the bush and its secrets, Roger becomes inspired by the concept of hunting. What does it feel like to hunt? What does it feel like to be hunted? Armed with only his imagination and a pen, he goes as ‘method’ with it as he can. But undictated by reality, his ‘hunting’ quickly spirals into a delusional power trip, bringing new revelations not only about the state of his writing, but the state of his relationship with Diana.

items.title: Mums v Big Pharma
items.overview: Mums v Big Pharma is a powerful BBC Two documentary that chronicles the long, dogged campaign by mothers—led by Janet Williams and Emma Murphy—to expose the devastating health scandal surrounding the anti-seizure medication sodium valproate (commonly known as Epilim).

items.title: Spiral
items.overview: An artist called Fabian struggles finding worth in her work.  This film was made as part of a Bad Camera Challenge, the cameras used being a camcorder and a Nintendo 3DS

items.title: Les Contes De Jean Phil
items.overview: Jean Phil is a notorious french villain... But why?

items.title: Watching Stephanie
items.overview: We watch Stephanie, talking to herself while a mysterious viewer watches...  This film was made as part of a Bad Camera Challenge, the cameras used being a camcorder and GoPro.

items.title: INTERTIDAL
items.overview: After encountering something otherworldly during a midnight swim, a woman is confined to a forensic tent on a remote Cornish beach where a government agent offers her coffee, reassurance - and a version of events that doesn’t match her own.

items.title: Mission Alaska: To the Ends of the Earth
items.overview: Through the unforgiving elements of Alaska, courageous priests, religious, and lay faithful bring the Eucharist to some of the most remote Catholic communities on earth.  This documentary chronicles the incredible efforts of priests, religious, and laity as they brave the elements, a lack of roads, and a serious shortage of priests to keep the light of faith alive. This is the Catholic Church in the 49th State, where some communities wait a year or more for a priest to celebrate the sacraments.

items.title: Loba Tahu, Loba Elmu
items.overview: Powered by Sumedang Tofu, 12-year-old super-genius Ilham enters a culinary-power competition to lift his family out of poverty. But to win, he must overcome a fierce rival and the weight of his father’s doubt.

items.title: Unfiltered
items.overview: Four teens hiding behind perfect online lives confront anxiety, grief, identity, and pressure. Through friendship and courage, they discover that being authentic and asking for help can save themselves and one another.

items.title: Adaikalam
items.overview: An elderly man longing for love, attention and purpose in a technology-driven world; the telemovie explores how social media can both connect people and deepen loneliness within families.

items.title: Story of an Artist
items.overview: Shot over the course of three years, this is a portrait of the artist as a young man.

items.title: The Place Between Life and Death
items.overview: Two mysterious beings have a conversation in a plane where time, space and logic don't exist.

items.title: Paranormal Support
items.overview: A man calls into a not-so-helpful paranormal helpline while his house tries to kill him.

items.title: WILDFLOWER
items.overview: Just because you're lost, doesn't mean it's over.

items.title: Dispose
items.overview: When a man is intimidated into taking out the trash by his mysterious roommate, he uncovers the horrifying reason behind his unusual behavior.

items.title: DNK
items.overview: A young man with a compulsive stealing habit brings trouble upon his family, who must deal with the consequences of his actions.

items.title: Identitti
items.overview: A student named Nivedita finds an old photo of her professor and discovers the latter had been living a lie. Saraswati, of all people — a woman of color who lectures on cultural identity — is in fact white. While the media and online community whip up a frenzy, Nivedita faces a political and personal dilemma as she tries to find out Saraswati's motive.

items.title: Never Surrender
items.overview: An ex-soldier and his grandchildren battle against ruthless criminals in a remote village. To survive, they must also confront their fears and regrets.

items.title: Allen
items.overview: 20 years after his encounter with an alien, Petey never moved on. Now his old friend has returned, and the reason why is complicated — and unexpected.

items.title: Itllu Arjuna
items.overview: A mute man with exceptional skills falls in love, proving that true feelings do not always need words.

items.title: Snoopy Presents: 12 Days of Snoopy
items.overview: Eager to get off Santa's naughty list, Snoopy goes all out to be the nicest beagle in town.

items.title: The Age Of Goodbyes
items.overview: Set in Malaysia, the film follows a young woman named Du Li An who falls in love with a man named Lin Sang in 1969 before he mysteriously disappears. Years later, after marrying a gangster and becoming stepmother to a teenage girl, Du Li An encounters a man who looks exactly like her vanished lover. The decade-spanning narrative blends elements of romance, mystery and coming-of-age storytelling.

items.title: Bouma
items.overview: A struggling singer returns to an isolated, secret-shrouded estate tied to her own forgotten past. Simultaneously, a police investigation into a series of missing women intersects with the estate, blurring past memories and active crime.

items.title: Eternal Return
items.overview: Cass has come to a personal point of emotional invulnerability, until she meets Virgil, a cartographer. Along with his partner Malcolm, they attempt to travel back in time to awaken Cass to love again.

items.title: The Christmas Switch
items.overview: Craving a change of pace, work-hard-play-hard city girl Freddie swaps lives with her homebody sister Mattie at Christmas time, only to unwrap a whole new kind of mess.

items.title: A Royal Stables Christmas
items.overview: At a prestigious equestrian training center, Ella forms a connection with a charming horseman who understands her desire to escape family expectations and forge her own path. But when his surprising royal secret is revealed, Ella must decide whether their Christmas romance can overcome the obstacles standing between them.

items.title: The Best Summer of My Life
items.overview: Brother and sister, teenagers Savva and Aglaya, live in the city and do what they like most. Savva is a fan of computer games and an eternal fidget. Aglaya is a young genius of science who dreams of making an important discovery. Each has plans for the summer holidays: Savva is going to a games festival, and Aglaya is working on a project at a science camp. But one day, their plans fall apart. Since the guys are always teasing each other, arguing about everything and can't agree on anything, one day a disaster occurs, as a result of which their apartment is simultaneously flooded with water and engulfed in fire. As punishment, the parents send the children to the village to their grandparents. For Savva and Aglaya, this is a nightmare: they are used to food delivery, entertainment, games and the Internet, and in the village they have to get up early, work in the garden, feed for slaughter, go to the bathhouse and a bunch of other village "delights".

items.title: La Gran Sangre: ojo x ojo
items.overview: Two decades later, Tony Blades, Mandril, and El Dragón are released from prison to confront a mafia controlling the Rímac district. In a Lima plagued by extortion and contract killings, the iconic vigilante group returns without a shred of mercy, ready to fight crime by their own rules.

items.title: Il rumore delle cose nuove
items.overview: A vividly interwoven tale of secrets and connections, Il rumore delle cose nuove centers on three families whose lives have quietly overlapped in the streets of Milan—unaware of each other—for years. Andrea, a photographer, and Andreina, a nurse, share a haunting truth: Andreina has given a part of herself to keep Andrea alive. Umberto finds solace in alleviating others’ pain at work, yet at home he inflicts suffering upon Alba, once hopeful, now dreamless. In another household, Ralph, who crafts sounds, and Viola, an actress who yearns to live as freely as she performs, are quietly struggling—alongside Mirko, a ten‑year‑old whose presence echoes loudly. As the story unfolds, their ordinary routines unravel under the weight of these “noisy” secrets—some seemingly trivial, others utterly unbearable. Chaos tumbles over the fragile bonds holding them together, forcing confrontations with truths they can no longer ignore.

items.title: How Could I Live Without You? 2
items.overview: The members of Kuplung are getting ready for a wedding.

items.title: Forest
items.overview: Two Muscovites go on a trip to Karelia and disappear without a trace in an endless, dense forest. Each attempt to get out turns into a new threat. The forest seems to breathe, watch and does not want to let go... It becomes clear: the Forest lives by its own rules, which there is no time to understand - without food and water, the girls will not last long. In the meantime, one strange family moves into an abandoned village house. Strangers are not welcome here. After all, they used to live in the Forest.

items.title: Afterpiece
items.overview: Owen, a once prestigious and acclaimed stage director, has fallen into depression after more than a decade of creative drought. His ex-lover Su Manling comes back into his life leveraging their old romance, whereas his wife Tracy hovers on the verge of crossing the marital line. Eager to reclaim his dignity, he resolves to write, direct and perform in a brand-new play. However, while holding open auditions for the leading actress, he is powerfully drawn to amateur newcomer Hannah, slowly slipping into a dangerous grey area where stage drama intertwines with real life.

items.title: A Bowl of Chicken Noodles Before I Die
items.overview: If today were your last day, what one small thing would you really want to do?  For Ale, the answer is simple: enjoy a bowl of his favorite chicken noodles before he truly gives up on life. But when his regular food cart is closed, that situation leads him into a series of unexpected encounters.

items.title: Lagi Probation: Kerja Ngejar Apa Sih?
items.overview: Driven by family duty, a desperate young woman lands a competitive probation spot at a corporate seasoning giant, only to find her newly formed workplace friendships shattered when it is revealed that six ambitious interns must battle it out for a single permanent position.

items.title: Pasukan 1000 Janda
items.overview: Following the tragic loss of her husband in combat, a fierce Acehnese noblewoman rises to become the world’s first female naval admiral, mobilizing an army of grieving widows into a formidable armada to avenge their families and defend their sovereign homeland against Portuguese colonization.

items.title: Só Não Posso Dizer o Nome
Batulo Jun
items.overview: Abhiman, freshly graduated and recruited for a government job, returns to his village. Seeing his villagers struggling with basic literacy, he chooses to stay and contribute, eventually falling in love with Jun— unaware that fate will test their relationship.

items.title: Blood Money
items.overview: In the Albanian port city of Durrës, Arion, a former inmate, is released from prison to fight in illegal bare-knuckle bouts at the notorious venue «The Circle» on behalf of Ilir, who is heavily in debt. Club owner Hans is initially skeptical of Arion. However, as Arion attracts more and more attention, Hans recognizes his commercial potential as well. What begins as a way out of poverty turns into a risky game when Ilir becomes involved in an illegal betting ring.

items.title: Lilya
items.overview: The year is 1915; World War I is underway. In Petrograd, the young Futurist poet Vladimir Mayakovsky meets a married couple, Lilya and Osip Brik. He reads them his poem *A Cloud in Trousers*; Lilya and Osip fall instantly and forever in love with Mayakovsky’s poetry, recognizing an extraordinary talent—a poetic genius—before them. Vladimir, in turn, falls in love with Lilya—also instantly and forever.

items.title: Kacau
items.overview: After a game of Spirit of the Coin goes horribly wrong, a group of friends begin dying in gruesome ways, forcing the survivors to fight for their lives while uncovering a dark secret among them.

items.title: Новый дом
items.overview: After seven years in prison, Anna is released. She has no home, no family, no purpose in life, and the guilt over her past haunts her. A charity helps her find a job, provides a place in a dormitory, and refers her to a psychological support group. There, Anna meets Roman, who helps her realize that to move on with her life fully, she needs to address what's weighing her down. She decides to take a step that could change everything.

items.title: Under Fire
items.overview: As a fire captain in Idaho, Rob has spent his life saving others. Now, with the help of an experimental therapy, he may just learn how to save himself.

items.title: Mahout
items.overview: A story of family, faith, and a bond that time cannot erase. Erin’s return to claim an inherited house brings the family back for more than a matter of property; it leads them to a spiritual inheritance that will transform all of their lives forever.

items.title: Helene Weigel - Revolutionärin im Rampenlicht
items.overview: Who was Helene Weigel? Using impressive archive material, the film follows the convinced communist, acting icon, and free spirit from her early days in theater to her escape from the Nazi regime to the founding and management of the Berliner Ensemble. The result is a powerful portrait that finally puts the “woman at Brecht's side” in the spotlight.

items.title: Stand Up
items.overview: Vera is a fun-loving 23-year-old until her entire life is upended after an accident leaves her in a wheelchair. Struggling to cope with her new reality, she meets Xander, who helps to show her that being in a wheelchair doesn’t mean she’s stuck.

items.title: Sonic the Hedgehog: Memories And Beyond
items.overview: Dr. Eggman's evil scheme is to upgrade Metal Sonic to the ultimate fighting machine. By stealing Sonic's life data and harnessing the power of the Chaos Emeralds, Sonic and his friends realize that in order to defeat Metal Sonic, they must rely on the friendship they built through their adventures!

items.title: Приключения пингвиненка
items.overview: Kwi the penguin is transferred from the Moscow Zoo to another city. However, an accident occurs during the transfer, and the little one finds himself alone in the big city. Thus begins his incredible journey home.

items.title: Heals
items.overview: Heals traces the rise of Pangina Heals, from a childhood shaped by intergenerational trauma and a conflicted relationship with his alcoholic mother to becoming Asia's first drag queen with a Vegas residency.

items.title: White Tiger Column
items.overview: A training camp for Myanmar's resistance movement lasts 45 days. Up close, we follow a group of young people who have decided to fight for their freedom. A moving and visually striking portrait of a courageous generation.

items.title: Atrápelo quien pueda
items.overview: A widowed father, encouraged by his nine-year-old daughter, returns to dating after years away from romance. Following multiple failed attempts with various suitors, he discovers that true love was closer than he imagined.

items.title: The Incident
items.overview: In 2024, two filmmakers set out to create the next hit reality show, but beneath all the over-the-top drama lurks something far more sinister.

items.title: Spirit Tasting
items.overview: On New Year's Eve, three former punks toast their late bandmate at a distillery. When a strange sommelier invites them to a top-shelf tasting, the trio discover there's only one catch: every bottle requires a 'wish'. But as each of their desires twist into doom, these old friends discover that every pour at the Red Bat Distillery comes at a deadly price.

items.title: Black Sheeps
items.overview: A young scientist who is convinced that a dangerous new pathogen threatens the population and tracks it back to her hometown – which is located in the shadow of the remote sheep station where the macabre events of the original Black Sheep unfolded.

items.title: The Serpent Spirit Goddess
items.overview: Dedi, a man who is bankrupt and deep in debt, performs a ritual to marry a beautiful jinn named Dewi in order to get the money to pay off his debts—with one condition: he must never marry anyone else.  As Dedi grows richer and more prosperous, he suddenly falls in love with a woman and intends to marry her. Dewi becomes furious because Dedi has forgotten the condition of the ritual, and eventually, a series of terrifying events threatens the lives of those closest to Dedi.

items.title: Leica – A Century of Vision
items.overview: LEICA - A CENTURY OF VISION shows how the invention of the 35mm format revolutionized documentary photography. Featuring legendary and contemporary photographers the film reveals the camera's enduring power to capture history as it unfolds.

items.title: Abyssal Fish
items.overview: ABYSSAL FISH is a creative film in the border between fiction, real and performance through the artistic work of Luís Capucho. A singular artist who survived the time when the HIV represented the death stigma. Building an amazing work of poetic power post­disease, Capucho surpasses the physical sequels that have left him mute and without part of his body movements for a while, until the current partial recovery.

items.title: Mall Country
items.overview: For generations, shopping malls weren't just a place to buy clothes but a means to share space as a society. Shiny escalators snaking through floors became a symbol of American community and economic prosperity. What does it mean when these spaces deteriorate, and the number of malls dwindles from thousands to mere hundreds? And when an Albanian immigrant semi-accidentally purchases a mall in Johnstown, Pennsylvania, what can he do to prevent it from going extinct?

items.title: UNBROKEN: The Untold Story of Shen Yun
items.overview: “UNBROKEN: The Untold Story of Shen Yun” follows the world-renowned classical Chinese dance company Shen Yun Performing Arts as it rises to global acclaim while facing intimidation and threats of violence. Through the eyes of two brothers and their fellow performers, the film traces an unlikely journey—from ordinary American childhoods to the world’s most prestigious stages—where rigorous artistic training and spiritual conviction shape both their craft and their character.  As Shen Yun tours internationally, the company becomes the target of escalating smear campaigns, threats, and alleged interference linked to the Chinese Communist Party. Blending personal storytelling with investigative reporting, “UNBROKEN” reveals what happens when art, faith, and freedom collide with totalitarianism power—and how resilience, community, and cultural revival endure in the face of intimidation.

items.title: Superbuhei
items.overview: Jesse Bronske runs the melancholy bar Klaus Meine, navigating love, work, and paranoia while haunted by his twin, as daily life and risky plans spiral amid alcohol and obsession.

items.title: The Brownsburg Conversations
items.overview: A portrait of a Virginia community observed through its residents, who reflect on histories of race and slavery, the role of faith in shaping connection, and the possibility of regeneration, as tradition and modern life collide in an increasingly polarized America.

items.title: ¿Dónde está la casa de mi padre?
Return to a Strange Land
items.overview: In this nostalgic and yet dramatic documentary, choreographer Jiří Kylián creates a final work for his lifelong partner Sabine, a deeply personal performance that celebrates love, creation, and the ephemeral nature of life.

items.title: Death Bitch 2
items.overview: Alexis Walker tries to escape her violent past, but when her best friend is killed, she returns to the streets. Unknown to her, Sabrina hunts the vigilante who destroyed her family. Two women move toward a collision neither can avoid.

items.title: Recrucified
items.overview: In a dystopian future, a young graffiti-artist living on a Greek island under foreign occupation is forced to portray Jesus in the Easter Passion Play.

items.title: Mom's Alive Today
items.overview: Jakov returns to hometown in order to take care of his mother whose suffering from a schizoaffective disorder, however, this intense new element in his life will slowly start to make his own psyche crack.

items.title: The War We Carry
items.overview: Hninn is a diligent student who wants to become a nun. In February 2021, the military seizes power in Myanmar and everything she has strived for vanishes overnight. Civil war breaks out in the country and Hnin's family must learn to live with constant fear: moving house, going into hiding, deciding who to trust and where to go at all. For six years, the camera follows them as they search for a safe place in a country torn apart. And yet, amidst all this horror, there is still room for faith, courage and even joy.

items.title: Full Metal Sasquatch
items.overview: An unstoppable, cybernetic super-Sasquatch fights off a deadly alien army that is preparing to invade Earth!

items.title: Forever, For Now
items.overview: As a young man eager for adventure, Jason Eftink broke his neck in a devastating skiing accident. With support from his mother and community, he built a new life despite profound challenges.

items.title: Let me Live
items.overview: Upon learning that she has terminal cancer that will leave her bedridden for the rest of her life, young teenager Julia begs her mother, Andrea, to flee the hospital and discontinue treatment.

items.title: The Flesh and the Soul
items.overview: As if opening the pages of a personal and exclusive diary, David Cronenberg generously opens up, retracing his life and the works that have made him one of the greats of cinema. Through an honest and disarming narrative, the filmmaker reveals the deep roots of an imagination that has influenced and transformed entire generations of viewers and directors.

items.title: The Drug of Being Loved
items.overview: Carlos and Roi spend blissful summery weeks, wildly, passionately in love. So much so, that they decide to break up. The question is how?

items.title: Lucid Dreams
items.overview: A young man nearly hits a stranger who runs into the road and claims that this is all just a dream.

items.title: Womb of the Dead
items.overview: Phop, a young nurse, has never given up hope of finding his older sister, who vanished without a trace years ago. He takes a job at a hospital in his hometown—the last place she lived before her disappearance.

items.title: Sounds of Cicadas
items.overview: A migrant father's relentless pursuit of a better future forces his son to endure the emotional cost of survival.

items.title: Andrômeda
items.overview: During the pandemic, Alice is hospitalized with COVID-19, and when she is intubated, she finds herself in a state between life and death. Guided by Virgílio, she embarks on a journey of hallucinations, memories, and the rediscovery of cinema as her purpose in life.

items.title: Buffalo 10
items.overview: A trans woman returns to her hometown, reconnects with pre-transition friends, and falls into the arms of a local chaser in this dreamlike dramedy.

items.title: Chekhov in Rosario
items.overview: Two actresses and a director meet in an old theater in Rosario to rehearse scenes from The Seagull and The Cherry Orchard by Anton Chekhov. As rehearsals unfold, the line between fiction and life begins to blur. Chekhov?s words merge with memories, frustrations, desires, and questions about time, loss, and the need to keep making art.

items.title: You’re Not Ready
items.overview: Over-enthusiastic and incapable personal assistant Wynn Santos must sell an apartment to a couple from hell.

items.title: De Roberto à Léon XIV - Un Pape péruvien
Adjustments
items.overview: A perfect man decides to get even better using Better™, a surreal technology-assisted therapy. When it compels him to destroy his ego, his doomer girlfriend tries her hardest to ignore his self-destructive Instagram Reels, her terminally ill patients, and her other boyfriend.

items.title: Pregnant
items.overview: At nine months pregnant, Hannah is getting ready for a date with her partner. But her body rebels against every attempt to live up to the beauty standards she’s imposing on herself. The harder she fights, the more chaos takes over… Until her partner looks at her.

items.title: Bright Eye
items.overview: Callie Jones is not your average IT tech. They’re a bio-hacker, living in the cracks of their dystopian society and illegally hacking bionic implants. Careful. Methodical. Invisible... until one wrong phone call exposes them.

items.title: Four Girls
items.overview: Finding shelter in an abandoned mansion, a group faces the challenges of coexistence. Free from traditional power structures, the black women experience power, love, and the possibility of dreaming about the future, while the white women resist learning to help with household chores, take care of themselves, and face their mistakes. When an old threat resurfaces, however, they all must band together to survive.

items.title: Scars of Revenge
items.overview: One has no memory, the other cannot forget.

items.title: Two Peas in a pod
items.overview: Victoria is caught between three wars. One is in Israel, where she lives. Another is in Ukraine, where she was born. The third is personal: a battle with her father whose devotion to his new wife, Lena, left no room for his daughter. When Victoria learns he is gravely ill, she has no choice but to return to her Ukrainian hometown ? once peaceful, now shattered by war.

items.title: Once, Here
items.overview: After an unexpected encounter, a young woman spends an afternoon wandering through the changing landscape of her hometown.

items.title: Camp Omega
items.overview: Ruth McKnight is acting strange. It’s clear to her family that she’s hiding something, but the camp pastor is worried it’s more sinister than anyone imagined.

items.title: Blue Man in Orange
items.overview: A middle-aged immigrant takes a swimming lesson on the last day of the year, aiming to join the crowd at the Dutch New Year's Plunge the following day.

items.title: Skindiei: The Thirteenth Floor
items.overview: A person records their experiences on a cruise ship.

items.title: Tránsito
items.overview: A family gathers at their restaurant near Christmas to celebrate matriarch Susana's birthday, only to find themselves caught in a sinister game that forces them to confront dark secrets from their past.

items.title: Enquanto o Céu Não Me Espera
items.overview: A simple farmer, attached to the memories of his father, struggles to stay with his family on their small farm, despite the difficulties imposed by the flooding of the Amazon rivers.

items.title: Home Stories
items.overview: When a housemaid with psychic abilities is left in charge of an abandoned mansion, the ghosts of its former masters and servants appear to tell stories of love, pain and tragedy.

items.title: VisionQuest Official Podcast
items.overview: Iman Vellani and Frank Alvarez sit down with the cast and showrunner of VisionQuest. Together, they break down the biggest scenes throughout the series, unpack what these events mean for Vision, Ultron, and Tommy, and share behind-the-scenes stories from the set and the writers' room.

items.title: Monstro
items.overview: A man arrives at an isolated house in the wild nature and decides to settle in. In the shadows of the night, a mysterious monster begins to visit him. The creature unleashes a whirlwind of emotions and fears that Bonio believed he had buried deep inside. The monster forces him to confront himself.

items.title: Auditions
items.overview: A film school is holding an aptitude exam for its directing program. Güney, the last candidate of the day, is called into the room. What begins as an ordinary student interview gradually spirals out of control when his ex-girlfriend arrives. As the jury’s familiar questions give way to personal reckonings, the examination room becomes a courtroom where it is no longer clear who is judging whom.

items.title: Under the Judas Tree
items.overview: In a remote village near the Greek-Albanian borders, an exiled father becomes obsessed with a young woman's murder.

items.title: THE EJACULATED
items.overview: Stockbroker Alessio Santos, who was recently diagnosed as infertile, leads a life dominated by bad habits. These bad habits manifest in mysterious ways and return to exact their revenge...

items.title: Viscera
items.overview: In the wake of her mother's death, Lyra, a fishmonger, is drawn towards a beached whale. Entering its decaying body, she confronts the memories and grief she's kept buried.

items.title: Sentenced at Birth
items.overview: A young mother leaves prison with her daughter, only to discover that freedom may be the hardest sentence of all.

items.title: Always, Summer
items.overview: A chance encounter brings Mer and Earth into each other’s lives, and before long, they find themselves becoming someone special to one another. Yet, what lies between them remains difficult to define.  But when Venus, a figure from Earth’s past, reappears, old feelings begin to resurface. Caught between the one standing by his side and the one he has never truly let go of, Earth finds himself shaken by his own uncertain heart.

items.title: The Tiger Wears Black
items.overview: A giallo sequel to the 40-minute long web release of the same name from 2022.

items.title: Crazy Love
items.overview: Khmer movie

items.title: Heart of the Hill
items.overview: In the heart of Southern Brazil's Morro Santana, the indigenous spiritual leader Iracema Gãh Té Kaingang braves constant threats in order to protect the water and land of her people.

items.title: GUR: Code "Sikora"
items.overview: Maksym is a pilot of an Mi-8 military helicopter, call sign "Sikora". Raised by his military grandfather, Maksym has been used to acting on moral grounds rather than under stress since childhood. When a full-scale war breaks out, he does not immediately rush into battle. But after the atrocities committed by the Russian military in Bucha, Irpin, and Donetsk region, he can no longer remain silent. The viewer is presented with a story not only of war, but also of the inner transformation of a man who is faced with the choice every day to stay on the sidelines or to become one of those who resist.

items.title: She Always Comes Back
items.overview: When a troubled young woman returns to her childhood home in rural East Tennessee, an aging  farmer must confront a familiar cycle of violence and the terrible lengths he'll go to protect the person he loves most.

items.title: The Road Never Ends
items.overview: A story of the legendary Latvian climber Teodors Kirsis, who chased the world's highest peaks through an era of profound change.

items.title: A Spectacular Fiasco
items.overview: Mümtaz, a former filmmaker living in isolation, spends his days recording video diaries. The sudden arrival of his estranged nephew, Cahit, disrupts this quiet routine. During the strange and tense day they share, the turmoil Cahit is facing forces him to confront his greatest dream and his true identity, while they leave an indelible, irreversible mark on each other’s lives.

items.title: Brutal Znad Wisły
items.overview: These places no longer exist, but you can still get to know the legendary Hotel Forum from the inside, thanks to the recollections of its former staff.

items.title: Eroded
items.overview: As rising waters wash away Toronto's historic queer beach, its community turns to archives, art, and memory to keep its legacy alive.

items.title: Parasite Frenzy
items.overview: Wanqu Island is overrun by deep-sea parasites that turn the infected into bloodthirsty demons. Hoping to make his name, naval officer Nie Yunqiao leads a squad of condemned convicts ashore to rescue the Marquis of Nan'an — and there encounters Han Chong, the father who long ago vanished under an assumed name. The island is a death trap and every man in the party has his own agenda. As betrayals and sacrifices mount, the truth emerges: the plague of demons is a cruel experiment devised by a court eunuch and the Marquis himself. Father and son set aside old grievances and join Aru, a healer's daughter, against the conspiracy. After a brutal battle the culprits are brought to justice, and Aru turns to her father's notebooks in search of a cure.

items.title: I Want to Be Human
items.overview: An observational exploration of life inside prison, seen through the daily experiences, personal transformations, and social reintegration of inmates.

items.title: A Red Button
items.overview: Garry works at an organisation that he doesn't know much about. There, he has to press a button whenever a light in front of him flashes red. Haunted by the obscurity of his new job, Garry attempts to find answers, all while dealing with the ghosts of his past as the mystery pushes him beyond his breaking point.

items.title: Homeless
items.overview: The story of Pairoj Pichetmetakul, an artist who decided to leave his hometown of Bangkok and pursue his dreams in New York for nearly a decade.

items.title: Monyeka!
items.overview: A stylish teen decides on an outfit with the help of a paper doll and a few unwelcome opinions.

items.title: Gareth Reynolds: Why Aren't You Bigger?
items.overview: Filmed at The Den Theater in Chicago, Gareth Reynolds (We’re Here to Help, The Dollop) delivers a fast, funny hour about life in an increasingly automated America. From the robo-takeover of everyday life and the strange demands of an algorithm-driven culture to the healing power of animals and the uphill battle of making a living in modern entertainment, Reynolds finds the absurdity in a world that feels less human by the day. He also turns his attention to America’s billionaires, arguing that they are not only wildly powerful and deeply troubling, but embarrassingly lame. Building from sharp observations into a lively musical finale, the special brings its biggest ideas together in a closing number that is equal parts ridiculous, pointed, and unexpectedly catchy, suggesting that the antidote to all of this is the healing power of animals.

items.title: Gislaine
items.overview: Gislaine, 18, claims to have received a divine revelation. On the night of her graduation party, she is confronted by family and friends, who question her about the future she believes has been revealed to her.

items.title: Fume
items.overview: After accidentally burning down their own business, three friends scramble through a hazy night to recover the money, while the truth about their relationships finally catches up to them.

items.title: Afternoon within Afternoon
items.overview: For this family from Manaus, in the heart of the Brazilian Amazon, coming of age is anything but ordinary, it's a celebration!

items.title: Be Still, My Soul.
items.overview: Kelly lives with heroin addiction in the South Bronx, where she also works at a harm reduction clinic - handing out clean needles, administering Narcan, cleaning blood spots from the floors. Shot over five years by a single filmmaker embedded within her world, Be Still, My Soul observes her daily life through a restrained, immersive form: no narration, no explanation, a score that moves alongside her inner world.

items.title: The Wiels Marsh
items.overview: The Wiels Marsh, located in Brussels, hosts a body of water that is crucial for numerous species of birds, amphibians, and insects, as well as adapted vegetation that has allowed local biodiversity to thrive. In this animated documentary, several speakers voice their support for this unique place. The directors trace the history of this natural sanctuary, constantly threatened by real estate projects, and highlight the work of the volunteers who ensure its daily upkeep.

items.title: Free Tonight
items.overview: An introverted, anxious teenager travels through the unpredictable but freeing chaos of a house party, overcoming his self-doubt and allowing himself to accept his queer identity.

items.title: Dinosaur Drive-In
items.overview: A nostalgic cinematic journey through the golden age of dinosaur movies and drive-in entertainment, Featuring vintage trailers and classic advertising, this special presentation recreates a night at the drive-in with a prehistoric twist

items.title: Chameleon
items.overview: Father and son go to the forest - away from the city to remember what it means to be a family. A bonfire, heart-to-heart talks. But in the morning they wake up in an abandoned village, which shouldn't be here.

items.title: Wizard and Knight
items.overview: Animated short film by Calgarian animator Mo Ramsay.

items.title: Plum Road Tea Dream
items.overview: On a deliberately paced walk through fragmented virtual spaces, a semi-autobiographical story unfolds about belonging and grief.

items.title: A Tradutora
items.overview: Whilst working on the Portuguese version of a medieval Japanese tale about a female hermit at a forest, a young translator begins to pay frequent visits to the local florist's.

items.title: Roots
items.overview: Our film Roots is a four minute short story about three close friends learning to grapple with the fleeting connection to their culture. Using morphs and experimenting with tactile media, this film will illuminate the dark psychological space of finding who one really is.

items.title: Dune in IMAX
items.overview: A young couple's relationship nearly falls apart over a seemingly minor dispute: she wants to stream Dune, but he refuses to let her, convinced it will return to theaters in IMAX.

items.title: Abby Howells: Welcome to My Dream
items.overview: Abby Howells takes you on a journey into her own mind. In many ways, she has everything she ever wanted. She’s a comedian full time! She lives in the big city (well, Auckland is big for New Zealand)! And in a ‘game changing’ move, she just bought some new outdoor furniture… But alas, there is still much that plagues her. Life is agony, as they say, hahaha! Abby has many enemies and they will be vanquished. How? By talking about them in a comedy show? Probably not, but that’s what is going to happen.

items.title: The Curse of Ghost Island
items.overview: Influencers are invited to a mysterious island to explore for treasure and content; their antics may surprise you once people start dying.

items.title: Von Tauben und Hunden
items.overview: A young man drifts further into an existential despair. Surrendering to loneliness and overwhelmed by financial hardship, he drifts through life in a daze until he is driven to commit a senseless crime.

items.title: The case for quiet
items.overview: In the context of John Mark Comer’s new book, Into the quiet: Following Jesus in a world of noise, this documentary explores two key things following the book’s structure. The world of noise. Is it even a problem, objectively? And if so, what defines it and what is it holding back from experiencing it in the spiritual life? What is the answer to noise, and how do we find it when noise is already all around us?

items.title: Fanfare
items.overview: The forest  is a mysterious place.

items.title: 4 Lucas
items.overview: Gastón neither studies nor works, and he gets kicked out of his house. Apathetic and addicted to his cell phone, he gets swept up by friends and eccentric characters who end up in absurd situations, when all he wants is to get 4,000 pesos to try the hamburger that a flyer distributor is trying to sell him.

items.title: Slingshot
items.overview: Short animated film from Canada.

items.title: Rare
items.overview: Documentary stories of children in a stage production, told not with pity or melodrama but through beauty and the superpower of children with rare diseases. Illness is spoken of through the lens of rarity itself: in life, in nature, and in a person. The film is conceived as a backstage record of the making of a play called Rare. The main characters are on stage; in the auditorium and at rehearsals are those who watch and guide them in real life — leading Russian geneticists, doctors specialising in rare diseases, and parents.

items.title: Mandy's Story
items.overview: For Mandy, horses have always been more than a passion. From her childhood in England to finding her way back to riding in Australia, they have shaped her life, her friendships and her sense of home.  Nestled in the Ku-ring-gai landscape of Sydney's Northern Beaches, Georgetown Stables brings together a lifelong love of horses and an appreciation for natural materials, warmth and character-filled architecture.  Inviting us in, Mandy shares the personal story behind Georgetown Stables, her special connection with her horse Gracie, and how this remarkable place has changed the way she lives.

items.title: Isoliert
items.overview: Along with the severe and brutal security measures that it entailed, the existence of the inner-German border between East and West Germany also gave rise to unique flora and fauna: today's "Green Belt".

items.title: The Surprisingly Lengthy Account of Everything That Went Into Making The Sunshine Boy, Despite Most of It Happening Before This Documentary Was Filmed, or 35 Minutes of Me Talking About Pre-Production
items.overview: With production on The Sunshine Boy only days away, filmmaker Aiden Diorio takes a final look back at the months of preparation that brought his ambitious $300,000 short film to life. From the earliest ideas to the last-minute challenges, this documentary captures the story behind the film before filming even begins.

items.title: Die Freiheit, die Stasi und der Tod
Absence
items.overview: Absence follows Marcus, a hardworking young graduate who has become increasingly consumed by his career. After turning down a day out with his friend James because of work, Marcus promises that he will make it to James' farewell drinks that evening before James leaves for Spain.  When Marcus is pressured into staying late at the office, the night begins slipping away from him. By the time he finally leaves, he is forced to rush across the city in an attempt to reach James before the night is over. His journey forces him to confront the balance between the future he is working towards and the relationships and experiences he may be leaving behind.

items.title: Just A Thought
items.overview: Klara is troubled by intrusive mental images during a date with her girlfriend. While the two women grow increasingly close, Klara fears she might secretly be a terrible person. Can their relationship survive?  A romantic drama inspired by a commonly misunderstood form of Obsessive Compulsive Disorder.

items.title: Ms.Rose & Mr.Cane
items.overview: Raghu is a blind author who feels secure about his surroundings by hearing and touching things around him. He gets acquainted with Shreya, an interior designer having one of those days when things are not going her way at all. The two meet accidentally for a coffee break, and their conversation gradually evolves into something much deeper.

items.title: Derii's Boneka
items.overview: A kingdom in peril, a collapsing tower and dormant memories: Deriba flees Amazonia and tries to find a way to a new self through childhood, transition, witchcraft and ballroom culture.

items.title: Deetz
items.overview: Berlin ends in Deetz, a landfill in Brandenburg, home to an ever-rising mountain of construction rubble that underscores the downsides of urban growth and capitalist greed. The film analyses the social and ecological consequences of demolition decisions in the German capital.

items.title: The Shell
items.overview: Zeynep, an idealist painter in her forties who has never married, cares for her ailing mother in a stifling apartment. Trapped between duty and repression, her carefully constructed shell begins to crack, exposing desires and fears she can no longer contain.

items.title: Can You Watch This for Me?
items.overview: A distracted woman agrees to watch a man's notebook in the café, but quickly realizes someone else is keeping a much closer eye on it.

items.title: If We Were a Tale
items.overview: On the day of his daughter Umay’s release from an eight-year prison sentence, Mümtaz starts a journey with his eight-year-old granddaughter, Efsun. Knowing her mother’s identity only through the warrior Vasilisa’s tale invented by her grandfather, Efsun wants to learn the rest of the story along the way. Trapped  between his conscience and his granddaughter’s questions, Mümtaz is forced to confront the reality he has been avoiding, while Efsun stands on the verge of confronting the harsh reality of her past instead of an imaginary hero.

items.title: Presto and the Fly
items.overview: An aspiring magician struggles to impress his would-be employer.

items.title: TOMBSTONE
items.overview: TOMBSTONE by Browser Magazine

items.title: The Hack
items.overview: A hacker forces her way into a corrupt MP's computer to expose his dirty secrets to the public.

items.title: Mr. Monochrome
items.overview: A fragile young man collapses under pressure when an unwavering woman drops their past connection.

items.title: Road To Roswell - A Welcome To Roswell Short
items.overview: A trans documentarian heads to Roswell, New Mexico with a small film crew to come out to his family and get it all on camera. On the road to Roswell where an infamous UFO crash allegedly happened in 1947, the crew listens to a sci-fi podcast which piques the camera operator’s curiosity about the town's history and ignites her obsession with UFOs and Aliens.  While the director tries to keep the crew focused his coming out story, the stars may have something else in store for this production.  ROAD TO ROSWELL is a short concept film based on StormMiguel Florez’s feature mockumentary, "Welcome To Roswell," which is currently in development.

items.title: Palindromic
items.overview: After Leonie stands her up, Alex drafts a letter about the strange occurrences on the island.

items.title: From Nowhere
items.overview: As more and more members of his Hakka-Chinese community leave Kolkata, Henry starts to ponder where belonging begins – and when a place becomes a home.

items.title: Gofrodita
items.overview: Artificial intelligence, robots and digital illusions drag a filmmaker further and further down a self-destructive path of delusion and addiction. This expressionistic essay traces the ways that technological innovation can alter our perception of reality.

items.title: Gises
items.overview: Gises is what the Potawatomi of the Great Lakes called the sun.

items.title: Matinee Soiree
items.overview: A woman whose life is merely an endless cycle between matinees and soirees, finds the courage to overcome her invisibility through her own inner validation, due to the connection she establishes between her own vicious circle and the myth of Sisyphus she watched on stage.

items.title: The Sleep of Elephants
items.overview: Stuck in the rubble of his home destroyed in a bombardment, nine year old Ahmet begins to spin a globe he finds among his toys. As the globe spins, the joyful and carefree lives of children from different parts of the world appear. As each spin shows the contrast with his own despair, the final scene brings him face to face with the painful reality of Gaza under fire. Reaching out to the globe as if to extinguish the flames, Ahmet draws his last breath among the ruins of his family’s wreckage.

items.title: A Very Merry Sure Shot Dombrowski Christmas
items.overview: The story follows Billy and Summer as they prepare for a major pre‑Christmas hockey tournament. Things get chaotic when new characters — including arena manager Noel, Grandfather John, hockey friend Caleb, and the usual mischievous crew of Bill Sr, Kate, Rene, Ray, Coach Johnston, and Coach Johansson — join the mix  . Expect a blend of sports humor, holiday cheer, and over‑the‑top “Christmas hijinx” in the arena.

items.title: This Side
items.overview: Having been estranged from his father, Recep, and sister, Ayşegül, for years, Samet returns to his hometown after his father’s death. Recep’s dying wish was to be buried beside his late wife; however, the local cemetery has no available plots. Over the course of a day-long burial effort, Samet and Ayşegül must confront both their shared grief and the emotional distance that has grown between them.

items.title: Yesterday, Today
items.overview: When Camille’s giant cat suddenly grows small, she must adapt to their new way of life.

items.title: Sinner's Head: Elevated
items.overview: When Sinners Head members Jack and Thomas step into an elevator, an ordinary journey quickly turns into an unexpected crisis. Convinced that they've become trapped, one bandmate begins spiralling into panic, while the other just doesn't care. Accompanied by their photographer, Adam, who left the elevator to get his lens. This comedic story had to be told.

items.title: Framed
