items.overview: Jackson, an ambitious photographer desperate to make his first showcase unforgettable, recreates the haunting works of a famous Canadian painter rumoured to have possessed her paintings after her death. Legend claims that anyone who comes into contact with the artwork becomes claimed by it — body and soul.  Skeptical but hungry for recognition, Jackson dismisses the warnings and immerses himself in the recreations. But as his work intensifies, so do the disturbances around him. What begins as artistic ambition spirals into psychological unravelling, as Jackson realizes the paintings may not simply be inspired by death — they may be inhabited by it.  Framed is a dark supernatural thriller exploring obsession, artistic sacrifice, and the terrifying cost of being seen.

items.title: The Hollowing
items.overview: Brothers Noah and Silas return to their late father's remote hunting property — only to awaken a sinister presence tied to the darkness they inherited, threatening what remains of their fragile bond.

items.title: Aqua Vita
items.overview: Yusuf and Leyla are an elderly couple whose daily life is full of constant arguments. While Leyla’s world revolves entirely around plants and animals, particular man Yusuf cannot stand the mess they create. Leyla drinks only spring water, which Yusuf brings her by bicycle every other day. On a night of heavy arguing, Yusuf forgets to bring the water and Leyla dies. Her final wish weighs so heavily on his conscience that he loses all sleep. Yusuf will find no peace until he slakes his wife’s thirst and has one last quarrel with her.

items.title: The Cube
items.overview: A detective follows a mysterious trail, drawn toward an encounter with something far beyond his understanding.  Conceptually, The Cube serves as a cold open for a series in the vein of Fringe or The X-Files.

items.title: A Restless Home
items.overview: An indigenous mother begins to sense something malicious in her household.

items.title: Drip
items.overview: Drip is an experimental stop-motion animation exploring the role of water in the cycle of life and humanity’s bond with nature. While crafting her family tree in a sunroom, an elderly woman realizes that with every falling drop, her past slowly washes away. Beyond life itself, water represents the stream of memory. Her quest to reclaim what was lost draws her into an abstract world, until the final drop reaches a tree, and life sprouts anew.

items.title: The Berg
items.overview: The Berg follows one extraordinary iceberg from Greenland to Canada’s east coast, revealing the marine life it draws in, the forces shaping its path, and the quiet risks it carries as it drifts toward Iceberg Alley.

items.title: Eastern Ghouta: The Poisonous Silence
items.overview: Eastern Ghouta: Toxic Silence focuses on the chemical attack targeting the Syrian city of Eastern Ghouta on the night of August 21, 2013. Through the testimony of seven residents from various professions, the documentary reveals how the attack impacted different lives. It also presents a firsthand account of starving children who were killed by inhaling the scent of apples, and shows how the global media turned a blind eye to this reality.

items.title: Come Back
items.overview: On a barista's last day before he moves to the big city, he meets a customer he connects with. Suddenly, moving on doesn't feel so easy.

items.title: The Job Interview
items.overview: A struggling filmmaker encounters a mysterious vagrant with a magical presence who guides him towards a new understanding of art, money, and success through an unexpected revelation.

items.title: For Sharon
items.overview: Within a space suspended between church and home, a mother and son navigate faith, endurance, and spiritual responsibility.

items.title: Mended Women, Tailored Bodies
items.overview: Mended Women, Tailored Bodes follows women finding unexpected ways to reclaim and reinvent their bodies and their lives in the face of breast cancer. Blending intimate stories, poetry and floral installations, this uplifting documentary celebrates friendship, creativity and the connections we weave — a gentle reminder that we all need a little help finding our way back to ourselves sometimes.

items.title: Danielle Hogan: Slow Reflections
items.overview: Artist Danielle Hogan discusses her most recent body of work. What started as a small assignment to get back into painting has turned into a series of almost over 1800 small paintings. Over three years, Danielle has been painting these small 2"x2" compositions nearly every day.

items.title: The Honour Song
items.overview: Through music, history, and personal reflection, The Honour Song reveals how a powerful Mi'kmaq tradition has survived, evolved, and continues to inspire pride and connection across the world.

items.title: Hello! Pikmin: Bowling
items.overview: Living in the fast lane!

items.title: Storm
items.overview: In a dark Berlin winter, Alexey drifts through two days of quiet routines and chance encounters. But beneath the ordinary lies a secret: he is a deserter from the Russian army.

items.title: Into The Distance
items.overview: When a birdwatcher becomes to enclosed in his room, he has to face consequences...

items.title: Cobra Mist: CIA, Seals & Orford
items.overview: At the height of the Cold War, a secret CIA base was built on the Suffolk Coast at Orford Ness. Over $1 Billion was spent trying to spy on the Soviets. Today Cobra Mist is off limits and not open to the public. In this special film Ralph Cochrane goes behind the scenes to find out what really happened and how a small dedicated team are helping to keep this fascinating piece of history alive for future generations. Featuring rare footage of Orford Ness lighthouse which was pulled down in 2020 due to coastal erosion and the new seal colony that's formed on Orford Ness this film is beautifully shot by the event.video team.

items.title: Stitching Undone, Threads Broken
items.overview: Nemat, a Rohingya refugee who sells pickled fruits on the street, races against time to rescue his sister from grave danger while being pursued by a police officer.

items.title: Lament Heat
items.overview: In its hypnotic rhythm, LAMENT H.E.A.T explores narratives around rubber plantations in Malaya, drawing connections to the themes of resistance and memory.

items.title: PSP: Person Searching Person
items.overview: "The newly bought second-hand PSP brings back memories of certain people and events. Through the penetration of the game console hardware, I have rediscovered those fragmented memories."

items.title: Tomorrow Has Already Passed
items.overview: A travelogue detailing a journey across Europe.

items.title: Sibling's Bond
items.overview: “Sibling’s Bond” is a haunting coming-of-age psychological drama about guilt, grief, and the line between justice and revenge.  When Eric Woods runs away from home after the death of his twin sister, he takes refuge in the woods, living off scraps and memories. But every night, he’s tormented by the same dream: reliving his sister’s death… and his moment of regret.  Trapped between trauma and madness, Eric struggles to survive both the wilderness and the chaos in his own mind.

items.title: Echo of the sun
items.overview: Japan, culture and the nuclear age.

items.title: The War Crimes Unit
items.overview: Ukraine police and prosecutors chase justice in the chaos of war in a battle to hold Russia’s leadership accountable and defend international law.

items.title: Statement regarding the PR Razzia Stunt
items.overview: Maximilian Knabe, aka HandOfBlood, addresses a controversial PR campaign involving a staged police raid. He explains the idea behind the stunt, its connection to social media manipulation and the public controversy that followed.

items.title: Mannequin
items.overview: Mannequin is, in short, a social outcast: no friends and no one to lend an ear. Their only solace comes from feeding birds at their favourite park and doodling, dreaming of being friends with The Girl. She's everything Mannequin wants to be, which means she would never like somebody like them...

items.title: Quásares
items.overview: A constellation-like film, composed of the people, objects, and places that accompany cancer patients in their fight against the disease. A hopeful journey across the Earth that reveals, within the intimate and the everyday, the most luminous entities in the universe.

items.title: Kikay
items.overview: A short documentary which pays tribute to the life and fighting spirit of Alyssa Alano, a 22-year-old University of the Philippines Diliman political science student who was among the 19 people killed during a military operation by the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) in Toboso, Negros Occidental.

items.title: 3 Hearts of Iron
items.overview: Schuyler Bailar, Chella Man, and Cal Calamia come together through friendship and solidarity to take on an Ironman, claiming, (and fully enjoying) their place in a world of sport where trans bodies are increasingly questioned, politicized, and pushed out.  At a time when public visibility can make trans people both targets and symbols, simply showing up becomes a statement. But 3 Hearts of Iron is not a story about proving their humanity through suffering. Surrounded by a fierce and loving community, Schuyler, Chella, and Cal move through the race with joy, interdependence, determination, and extraordinary athleticism.  Together, they offer a different image of trans life in sport: not one defined by debate or exclusion, but by friendship, excellence, and belonging. In doing so, they show that trans people do more than belong in sports: they have the power to transform and expand what sports can be.

items.title: TORNADO
items.overview: Deep in the channels of the Paraná Delta, where land ends and water takes over, floats "Tornado" a floating parrilla like no other. Built on a sturdy barge anchored in the middle of the river, this improvised restaurant serves as a meeting point for boaters, timber workers, local islanders (isleños), and travelers passing through.  Through quiet observations, rich visuals, and intimate interviews, the documentary shows the balance between loneliness and community. Tornado is more than just a place to eat; it is a story about human strength, warmth, and the life of people who live on the river.

items.title: Shankarabharanna: Karnataka Tour
items.overview: It is a music Video/ Documentary of the Karnataka Tour taken place by SHankarabhaarana team

items.title: Moon and Back
items.overview: Harper, a recent high school graduate, who is beginning her new life at university, facing the pressures of a new start. This big change in her life causes her to distance herself from her mother, Janet. Ignoring Janet during a movie night, Janet is confused and upset by her daughter's behaviour and is unable to understand why Harper is pushing her away. The coddling from her mother and the looming anxiety of her future blurs Harper's emotions, causing her to run off to her room. Janet attempts to keep the peace, but with Harper ignoring her, the tension builds, leading to an explosive altercation. During this moment, Janet realises Harper's behaviour isn’t usual teenage rudeness, but something much deeper. They both realise that their anger is rooted in sadness and anxiety. As they talk, Harper learns that she should embrace this change, and even if it doesn't work out, her mother will always be there for her.

items.title: The Body
items.overview: After a dance-team initiation goes wrong, a group of badly behaved Catholic school girls begin having prophetic visions that set off mass hysteria in their town.

items.title: Synchronicity
items.overview: Ato, the village shaman, and his childhood friend Yan. One day, Ato decides to hold a ritual in Yan's honor. But as the ritual progresses, an eerie atmosphere settles over the village — and Yan begins to sense that something is terribly wrong...

items.title: Bloom
items.overview: A lone exploration robot lands on a distant planet, only to discover that the alien ecosystem it was sent to study is far more hostile than expected.

items.title: Gaza’s Lost Horizon
items.overview: The film portrays Nadia, an 8-year-old girl in Gaza left paralyzed by the ongoing Israeli genocide, offering a raw and intimate reflection on childhood shaped by loss, trauma, and survival. Inspired by the real experiences of thousands of children in Gaza who lost their ability to move, the story reveals a world defined by stillness, silence, and unseen suffering.

items.title: In a Blue Painting
items.overview: Secluded in a cottage on a lake in the woods, Marian struggles to finish one last painting for an upcoming show.

items.title: The Resident
items.overview: An elderly nursing home resident finds herself abandoned and alone. Driven by instinct, she finds her way to freedom. As an inexplicable catastrophe unfolds around her, the boundary between past and present begins to blur, offering her an unexpected final moment of clarity.

items.title: You Can Feel Like Shit and Still Be Happy
items.overview: A rising heavy metal performer, SFX artist, and motion capture actor, Chris Waddell received an unexpected diagnosis at the age of 26. Now in his 50's, Chris reflects on his relationship with pain, leading up to his final performance.

items.title: Second Wind
items.overview: After a failed first attempt at the prestigious LEADVILLE 100, mountain biker Mike Black returned home only to then be diagnosed with thyroid cancer. Driven by determination through an intense treatment process that tested his spirit, he fully recovered. Now he aims to return to Leadville in 2025 stronger than before. Join Mike as he pushes through pain, fear, and challenges to embrace life again.

items.title: Agent Zeta
items.overview: Four Spanish ex-intelligence officers are assassinated simultaneously worldwide. The CNI discovers all participated in the covert "Operation Ciénaga" decades ago in Colombia. Zeta, the CNI's best operative, must hunt and protect the sole survivor, facing his deadliest global mission yet. Top Colombian agent Alfa will join Zeta, seemingly knowing more about "Ciénaga"'s secrets than him.

items.title: Heartland
items.overview: A former country star, Misty Jones, comes out of seclusion to investigate the disappearance of her missing niece, a rising country musician and must grapple with her own past and Nashville’s seedy underbelly. Her search uncovers a murky side of Nashville where no one, including Misty, is who they seem.

items.title: Parivarik ManuRanjan
items.overview: Ranjan Dubey, Lucknow's most eligible bachelor, finds his search for a bride taking an unexpected turn when Helen, his charming new househelp, walks into his life. With everyone having an opinion on this unlikely duo, will their companionship blossom into love?

items.title: God with Us
items.overview: In an urban Maryland neighborhood, virginal Mary Anne Thomas and her boyfriend Joseph 'Junie' Love find their lives turned upside down when Mary discovers she’s miraculously pregnant without ever being with a man. As disbelief, danger, and divine destiny converge, their love is tested in a community desperate for hope.

items.title: Quarter
items.overview: Kelly, a young woman living with Type 1 diabetes, is about to turn 25, as she deals with the ups and downs of her blood sugar levels and the ups and downs of her personal life.

items.title: Dead of Night
items.overview: A small town is terrorized by a series of brutal murders, as a determined sheriff, his daughter, and a desperate mayor race to uncover the truth behind the killings before the town descends into chaos.

items.title: Liberated from Paradise: Resonance of the Heart
items.overview: In 2400, most of humanity still lives without physical bodies inside the digital paradise DEVA, but Angela Balzac's rebellion left consequences its security forces could not erase. During the chaos, numerous agents escaped to Earth after stealing material bodies and hardware containing their personal data, then vanished from DEVA's surveillance.  These fugitives, now called the Fallen, have become a threat whose true purpose is unknown. Agents Gabriel, Arma, and Daniel are sent to track them across the surface, where the lingering Nano Hazard makes the environment itself dangerous. The closer they come to the Fallen, the harder it becomes to trust everything they were told about Angela's revolt and the 'paradise' they have been ordered to protect.

items.title: Drink Coffee, Talk Fast
items.overview: Cast, crew, and fans trace the making of Gilmore Girls and the enduring pull of Stars Hollow, revealing how its stories shaped lives and connected generations.

items.title: Cursed Meme
items.overview: Yura, a young girl who struggles to fit in with her classmates, discovers an old smartphone while helping clean out a disused school building. Out of curiosity, she and her friends power it on. Soon afterward, strange videos featuring the children themselves begin appearing on their phones. At first, the clips seem like harmless jokes and are consumed much like viral internet memes. What the children do not realize, however, is that these videos are foretelling a horrifying future that awaits them.

items.title: The Child
items.overview: The story of Mariaje and Nicasio, the mother and grandfather of one of the children who died in a gas explosion in a town in the Basque Country in October 1980. On a journey marked by unexpected emotions, Mariaje and Nicasio search for - and find - their own unique way to overcome their loss.

items.title: Mrigaya 1.5: The Hunt Continues
items.overview: Officer-in-Charge Debanjan Dutta of the Kolkata Police and his team face mounting danger while investigating a gruesome crime that shakes their neighborhood. As twists derail the probe, a ruthless gang spreads chaos across the city. With tensions rising and violence erupting, the hunt intensifies.

items.title: A Fox Under a Pink Moon
items.overview: At just 16, Soraya is already creating stunning drawings and sculptures that are as beautiful as they are dark. This strong-willed Afghan sculptor and illustrator has been trying for five years to escape Iran and join her mother in Austria.

items.title: Plucked
items.overview: In Gilded Age New York, a rebellious woman seeking to divorce her emotionally unstable husband turns a seemingly civilised evening into a night of chaos and violence.

items.title: Black Gold
items.overview: The value of human hair is skyrocketing day by day.  dark color, length, and strength of Indian women's hair are highly prized in the global market. Millions of dollars circulate in this industry, which is controlled by commercial mafias. It is a well-known fact that wherever there is money, bloodshed, rivalry, and envy inevitably follow

items.title: My Christmas Cowboy
items.overview: Meg set aside her newscaster aspirations after a disastrous audition experience in college and has been happy as a news producer in her small town of Fern, Texas. Billy Kane, her former college crush and audition partner, is a well-known celebrity host in Hollywood on the brink of losing his career after an on-camera gaffe. At the advice of his publicist, Billy begrudgingly returns to Texas to lay low and spend the holidays with his sister and her family. When Meg and Billy cross paths he’s happy to see her but her feelings are on the frostier side: she’s still upset he took advantage of her failed audition to get the gig himself. Meg finds herself seeing Billy more than she’d like since his nephew Graham is in the horse therapy program her dad runs at their ranch. With the annual Reindeer Roundup holiday event coming up, Meg’s dad gets sidelined after an injury and enlists Billy to serve has its host, much to Meg’s chagrin.

items.title: Lex Julia
items.overview: Julia travels to her new friend Anna's private island and meets Anna's husband JP, whom she recognises from a past traumatic encounter.

items.title: Axis of Life
items.overview: A pilgrimage in which a spiritual master must choose one of his disciples as his successor turns into an inner journey for each of the participants. Who am I? Where do I come from? What is left, when I am no longer here? A mystic tale about the path of the human soul through eternity.

items.title: To Be Ordinary
items.overview: A car accident leaves a 22-year-old young man bound to a wheelchair for the rest of his life. The elderly driver who hit him gives the family a house and pays monthly compensation, yet he still cannot forgive himself. The boy’s mother believes that as long as one is alive, there is hope. His unemployed father devotes himself entirely to caring for him. The physical therapist who guides his rehabilitation quietly falls in love with him. Because of the accident, the family begins gathering for dinner every night, finding a fragile sense of togetherness. But his perceptive younger sister knows the truth behind their beautiful new home: it was bought with her brother’s broken body.

items.title: 1 in 2
items.overview: Nearly one in two of us will be diagnosed with cancer at some point in our lives. David Nicholas Wilkinson is one of them, twice over. 1 in 2 follows Wilkinson through his own treatment, where he discovers a steep rise in bowel cancer among people far too young to be screened for it, and far too young, it seems, to be believed.

items.title: Ben Sana İnanıyorum
items.overview: Eager to land prestigious clients, Mahsun, an ambitious lawyer puts up an online ad, only to end up saddled with a ruthless crime boss confined to house arrest. Dragged headfirst into dangerous underworld chaos, he must scramble to rid himself of his unwanted client before his career and life completely unravel.

items.title: Search Party: Where's PawPaw?
items.overview: Noble Kristian Silk Williams rushes home after Aunt Meek Meek warns that PawPaw's health has taken a turn for the worse. After visiting him in a rundown nursing home, Noble and her quirky best friends return to find him missing. Joined by their chaotic, self-reformed hood-Aunty, they follow bizarre clues and encounter eccentric characters in a race to find PawPaw before time runs out.

items.title: Small Talk
items.overview: Elisabeth spends Christmas with her boyfriend Espen and meets his family for the first time. An unfortunate incident involving his grandmother turns an already uncomfortable family gathering into a nightmare, forcing Elisabeth and Espen to confront unfamiliar sides of each other.

items.title: UK Holiday
items.overview: A UK Holiday is not just a journey; it’s an adventure filled with love, laughter, and unforgettable memories. The story revolves around Aakash, a kind-hearted and adventurous young man, who invites his sister Rekha from the USA to visit the UK for a long-awaited family reunion. Rekha, excited to escape her routine, is thrilled to meet their mother, Subhadra, and sisters Priyanka and Deepika, who already reside in the UK. Aakash ensures this holiday becomes a truly special experience. Together, they explore London’s iconic landmarks like the London Eye and Tower Bridge. The journey takes them to the natural wonder of Durdle Door in Dorset and the charming town of Aldershot. Along the way, they share stories, laughter, and moments of deep connection. This feature film captures the essence of holidays—taking a break, reconnecting with loved ones, and creating memories that last a lifetime. UK Holiday is a celebration of family, adventure, and the joy of togetherness.

items.title: All the Music in the World
items.overview: A revealing look at one of the world’s greatest pianists – Emanuel Ax, a celebrated virtuoso still contending with stage fright – as he embarks on his 50th year of performing and wrestles with the question of when, or whether, to step away from the spotlight.

items.title: Running Wild
items.overview: Three people, a lesbian couple and a man they meet at a club, embark on a wild adventure to deliver drugs, only to find a series of uncontrollable events from this dangerous menage a trois relationship . As their world blurs and they lose their innocence, what’s left is the sobering impact of reality and survival.

items.title: Never Guilty
items.overview: At the height of his success as a real estate developer, Todo is suddenly arrested on charges of embezzling funds from a school land deal—an accusation he adamantly denies. His pleas are ignored by prosecutors, and the situation spirals out of control when his most trusted partner and his loyal employee give an account that casts him as the mastermind. Stripped of his position and reputation, can he seize a final chance to prove his innocence?

items.title: Do You Understand Or Do I Have To Spell It Out For You?
items.overview: Madrid, Spring 1992. Pepe, owner of a Catalan tavern in Chueca, faces the worst streak of his life: his bar is in ruin, his wife leaves him and the debts drown him. When he thinks all is lost, his friends propose a twist as unexpected as brilliant: turn the tavern into a gay pub! What happens from there is an unstoppable succession of entanglements, crazy situations and endearing characters, in a politically incorrect comedy, current, and absolutely smarty.

items.title: We're All Haunted Here
items.overview: Julia, a desultory ghost, is faced with moving on when a mother and son move into the home she haunts. Tensions rise between the family, and everything changes when the son reveals something else is in the house with them. Something not even their ghostly voyeur can see.

items.title: Stanley's Shadow
items.overview: A found footage archive of interviews exploring Stanley Kubrick's legacy through the voices of filmmakers inspired by his work.

items.title: Craig Simons Is James Acaster
items.overview: Meet your new favourite comedian Craig Simons, a James Acaster tribute act that definitely ISN'T Acaster himself. Filmed at Edinburgh’s legendary Monkey Barrel after a sellout UK, Ireland and US tour, Simons shows why he’s the best in the game.

items.title: The Flaw
items.overview: In a bleak future where the Regime decides who belongs and who doesn't, the Line divides everyone. Now, a ruthless Interrogator is ordered to follow a perfect Plan and prove a Suspect's guilt. A game of psychological manipulation unfolds as the Plan advances with cold precision. Every word or action is cast in a new light. Reality itself becomes twisted. But just as the puzzle seems complete, a single flaw changes everything. When a gun is drawn, the question is no longer who will pull the trigger – but whether either man can cross the Line that has always divided them.

items.title: BerleeN_
items.overview: Over the course of a single day in Berlin, three Arab strangers are drawn into a series of surreal encounters that force them to confront the ghosts of their past.

items.title: And Damn He Could Play
items.overview: After making his name alongside Ray Charles, Motown’s Funk Brothers, and Charles Mingus, trumpeter Marcus Belgrave chose Detroit over the promise of greater fame, devoting his life to nurturing a community and shaping the next generation of jazz musicians.

items.title: Dead Tide
items.overview: Zhong, a recently released murderer, returns to his fishing village because of his father's death. Ten years ago, Zhong was convicted of manslaughter and imprisoned for accidentally killing a young man from a neighbouring village. Haunted by guilt, Zhong seeks out the victim's family, who have since moved away, hoping for their forgiveness. Along the way, he encounters Xue, a mentally ill woman confined to a stilt house. The two, both longing for redemption, help heal each other's past wounds.

items.title: The Water Will Carry Us
items.overview: Years ago, a dragon boat club boatman lost his son in a maritime disaster, a tragedy he has never been able to overcome. The son's girlfriend, who survived the accident, has since started a new family and is now preparing to relocate back to Australia with her husband. How will they all finally find closure and untangle the knots in their hearts?

items.title: Five Figurines
items.overview: Five Figurines is a Nigerian feature film directed by Akay Mason that will be released in cinemas nationwide on November 13, 2026.

items.title: The End of all Days
items.overview: After discovering that her dreams are real, Lucy is torn between the life she knows and the supernatural mystery behind a house in the mountains, a box named Blind Man's Bluff, and the plot bringing everything together that might bring the end of the world. Joined by new and returning cast alike, "The End of All Days" is the culmination of fifteen short films and the finale to "TETHER PAW."

items.title: Nothing more and nothing different
items.overview: When a devoted elderly couple faces the devastating reality of terminal illness, they are left to deal with a radical decision that will reshape their bond.

items.title: InterroGRAPEtion
items.overview: Leigh Jordín, an aspiring film school graduate, struggles with unruly cast members as she tries to document her directorial debut. "Detectives," Deuce Amoa and Saint Jemone lose their grip on reality as they interrogate their main suspect, Wesley Holdcraft, regarding a crime surrounding a defiled bag of grapes. Insanity ensues as the line between acting and solving the case blurs.

items.title: Swamp
items.overview: Years after her mother's disappearance, Jamie and her friends return to the lake where the woman claimed to see a terrifying creature. Soon after arriving, the keys to their car go missing, leaving the group trapped.

items.title: Dark Chocolate
items.overview: After a string of failures, "Fire Star" Yagna faces downfall. Banned by the Film Industry for his attitude, can the "one-hit wonder" make a comeback?

items.title: Just Like Me and You
items.overview: A college student faces hardship of hearing loss, while befriending a fellow classmate who challenges him.

items.title: DIRT
items.overview: Following the outbreak of war, an elderly Ukrainian refugee gets stopped by Customs while trying to bring a jar of Ukrainian soil into the UK.

items.title: Little Flower
items.overview: An ominous dream pushes Layla, a directionless twenty-something to reconnect with an old friend.

items.title: Muguruza FM 40 Tour
items.overview: Four decades after taking to the stage for the first time, Fermín Muguruza launches into his last major tour: a collective journey to celebrate 40 years of music, engagement and cultural resistance. This music documentary captures the pulse of that voyage: concerts packed to the hilt, endless kilometres on the road, all sorts of encounters on the way and a shared energy that stretches beyond generations, from the bands Kortatu and Negu Gorriak to his current solo career.​

items.title: American Amazon
items.overview: A spectacular journey through natural wonders of a part of the country Grammy-winning musician and actor Jon Batiste knows very well: the vast network of wetlands spanning Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, and the Carolinas.

items.title: A Christmas Party
items.overview: Home for the holidays, Adam longs for the magic of his childhood. Amid the chaos of the annual Foxhall Village Christmas party, he dodges relatives, evades the political turmoil, and-surprise!-falls for his childhood friend.

items.title: Sludge
items.overview: A rambunctious young man embarks on a nightmarish journey after a prank on his best friend goes horribly wrong.

items.title: Apart
items.overview: In 1974, a young woman flees war-torn Cyprus for apartheid South Africa to start a new life through an arranged marriage  but must hide a secret that could cost her everything.

items.title: Inherited
items.overview: Mina has been sentenced to death for murder. With little time left before her execution, she attempts to harm herself to delay it, but fellow inmates and prison guards intervene. A prison trustee tells her that the only way to postpone her execution is to become pregnant.

items.title: Understory
items.overview: It tells the story of 3 scientific renegades: a botanist (Robin Wall Kimmerer), a forester (Suzanne Simard), and a philosopher (Paco Calvo) who listen and learn from plants. Today the world is finally waking up to their message.

items.title: Negative
items.overview: A young police officer infiltrates a cult to find his missing mother, only to face a decision that could irreversibly reshape the past.

items.title: Lambodhara 2.0
items.overview: A young man is drawn into a revolutionary AI-powered game that promises true happiness, only to discover it is a hidden system designed to study and control human emotion.

items.title: Sour Grapes
items.overview: When her husband skips couples' therapy, Justine is left face-to-face with his over prepared personal assistant instead.

items.title: Holy Light
items.overview: A child and his father journey from their Romanian mountain village to an airport to collect a light for their village church.

items.title: Heisters
items.overview: It's just another dull night in Buenos Aires. Juan and Luciana, a couple at their breaking point, head to their friend Gastón's party. Amid drinks, jealousy and mysterious masks, their relationship is about to blow up.

items.title: Whiddy
items.overview: A small rural community in Ireland welcomes in a major, global oil company with open arms but just 10 years and numerous oil spills later, that dream turns into an unimaginable nightmare. 50 lives lost in a tragedy that silenced and divided the community and still haunts it to this day.

items.title: IOU
items.overview: WU, a desperate man struggling between survival and kindness. Trying to repay his own debts by all means necessary, he blockaded the Shaanxi rural lodging of siblings LI, hoping to force their father home to repay his loan to WU. Despite causing him endless headaches, the siblings’ simple-mindedness as well as naturally-born compassion is transformative on WU. Ran away from other creditors who successfully tracked him down, WU re-appeared at the LI’s shabby lodging on Chinese New Year’s Eve and made an unexpected choice.

items.title: Ella Arcangel: Ballad of Tooth and Claw
items.overview: A young witch named Ella fights both humans and mythical monsters in the city to protect her community.

items.title: *DONUT *DONUT *DONUT
items.overview: Alex and Maddie are ready to have a baby; they just need a little help from their friend. However, an innocent autocorrect typo begins to unravel their family before it even starts.

items.title: Sana'y Nandito Ka
items.overview: A young man reunites with his estranged mother six years later.

items.title: The Death of Marion Wayne
items.overview: Marion Wayne is a chaotic gunslinger traveling the country with his small gang. When he gets captured by the law he learns of an indifference of power within the law, and upon breaking out of prison he pursues a revenge arc to balance the system.

items.title: For Better or Worse
items.overview: When they first met at Yuan Bo's secularization party, Li Xinran was still an actress suffering from depression. The two, both at the lowest point in their lives, fell in love at first sight and quickly came together, welcoming their first child. With several million yuan in savings, they envisioned an ideal life, but due to extravagance and a lack of financial management experience, they fell into an economic crisis. To turn their situation around, Yuan Bo planned to establish a handpan instrument factory in the mountains of Anji. The lush greenery seemed like their utopian dream. However, with the birth of their second child, their business failed, their business partner left, and they were burdened with debt. The daily grind and financial pressure gradually eroded their once passionate relationship. Deep in the mountains, they loved each other until they had nothing left but each other.

items.title: All This Time
items.overview: Trapped inside a gothic mansion in an endless time loop, Grace must unlock the secrets of the house, the enigmatic owner, and the previous night's party, to find any hope of escaping and returning to her normal life and young child.

items.title: Body Works
items.overview: A laid-off dishwasher finds survival in a paid romance until the relationship begins to demand more than a transaction.

items.title: Bedcrumbs
items.overview: As his boyfriend invites a carousel of lovers into their bed, Michael is forced to confront his relationship and himself.

items.title: The Mayor: Halsema & Amsterdam
items.overview: Amsterdam mayor Femke Halsema was followed for a year by filmmaker Mijke de Jong, from crisis meetings to television interviews and from public appearances to closed-door sessions, as the right to protest clashed with public safety.

items.title: Badgeless
items.overview: Sergeant Jalil is a recently retired police officer. In his new civilian life, he starts working as a security guard for a company, but he misses his former life. One night during a night shift, two thieves try to break in. Jalil shoots them with his non regulation firearm, wounding one of the young men. The police, his former colleagues, search for the culprit. Jalil tries to kill the wounded thief, but the police set a trap for him.

items.title: An Incomplete Day in the History of Georgia 10.06.93
items.overview: Derived solely from video recordings of Georgian parliamentary proceedings on June 10, 1993, when Eduard Shevardnadze was the head of state, An Incomplete Day in the History of Georgia presents the debate surrounding the introduction of Georgia’s national currency coupon to replace the Russian ruble. Members of parliament voice their concerns from the floor, questioning the resolutions presented by the vice prime minister and president of the National Bank. How should the country’s leaders proceed in light of domestic challenges such as starvation, fuel shortages, budget shortfalls, and rapid inflation? Viewed with hindsight, this document from the early days of Georgian independence reminds us how fragile the democratic process can be.

items.title: The Virus of Pathological Kindness
items.overview: On a cold winter's night in 1983, a young teacher of Serbo-Croatian recieves a surprise visit. A nude man, claiming to be from Belgrade in the far future tells her that the world as they know it will crumble and that he believes he knows how to stop it.

items.title: Tonight is Forever
items.overview: How long can love remain an illusion? In Tokyo's red-light district, host Hikaru makes a fortune selling women romantic fantasies in this film that—like the host—blurs fiction and reality.

items.title: Lesbian Dogwood and The Bottomless Well Within
items.overview: In the second installment of the THIS IS MY DISASTER saga, Fishbaby#359478100 sinks deeper into domestic human life. Meanwhile, the titular Lesbian Dogwood has other stuff to do.

items.title: One or Two Ways To Die
items.overview: Two American friends travel down Mexico's Pacific coast in search of land to buy. As they move through a country increasingly shaped by foreign ownership, Joe falls victim to the myth of "Moctezuma's Revenge" and their search for paradise begins to turn against them.

items.title: Drumskin
items.overview: Milena is stuck in a life she did not choose, taking care of a husband who was left in a vegetative state after being run over by a drunk driver. Everyone tries to encourage her to move on with her life. The man responsible for the accident, Tom, leaves prison and starts attending Alcoholics Anonymous meetings, seeking redemption. Milena joins too, to stalk him. What seems like some sort of revenge becomes less clear as they get to know each other. She starts to learn about his (wealthy) family, and keeps going to AA meetings, which take place directly below a malambo rehearsal room. Drawn to the dance, Milena experiences emotions which she thought were long dormant. The energy of the dance kickstarts something within her, reawakening certain desires.

items.title: Under the Bridge
items.overview: At first glance, Cedar Valley — a picturesque rural community just an hour from Toronto — appears to be the idyllic setting for childhood. Michelle Caravantes returns to confront for the first time the trauma and horror she faced here 45 years ago.

items.title: Lyrical Vengeance
items.overview: On crowded dance floors at queer club nights in Tokyo, Yogyakarta and Rotterdam, ravers celebrate the lives and works of Japanese author Fumiko Hayashi, Indonesian author Suwarsih Djojopuspito and Dutch-Indonesian author Beb Vuyk. These women challenged patriarchal and nationalist politics from the 1930s to the 1950s, a turbulent period marked by violence, war and decolonization. They wrote openly about sensitive subjects such as women’s labour, sex work and resistance to colonial and patriarchal oppression.  Contemporary activists, artists and researchers engage with the authors’ literary legacies through collective reading, and performance. These local actors quote from the writers’ work and, through improvisation, enact how these women might have responded to complex situations. The writers’ artistic practice, activism and feminism resonate with the creative practices of today’s transnational queer community, connecting different ways of creating and claiming space.

items.title: Russell Brand: Open Secret
items.overview: Featuring inside voices and archive footage, providing insight into British comedian Russell Brand’s life and the investigation that started it all at The Times and The Sunday Times, through chief news correspondent Rosamund Urwin and investigations correspondent Charlotte Wace.

items.title: Barricade
items.overview: A couple's intense argument traps two housemates outside their own kitchen, forcing them into increasingly desperate attempts to rescue a cake before it's too late.

items.title: UNDER THE MIDNIGHT SUN
items.overview: A withdrawn boy spends the summer in the countryside, coping with the loss of his grandmother and his parents’ separation, while communicating with her through an old tape recorder as a mysterious unseen world slowly begins to emerge.

items.title: Secret Dinner Guest
items.overview: When an invisible dinner guest joins the table, a light-hearted evening quickly descends into unsettling chaos.

items.title: Faces
items.overview: Elvia is a housewife who returns home early to spend the day with her teenage son, Yustin. However, he prefers listening to reggaeton, chatting online, and scrolling through social media. That night, Elvia will fight to be heard.

items.title: The Man of Destiny
items.overview: An aspiring writer in Paris investigates the dark past of a legendary filmmaker, leading him to a lost film that threatens to shatter the myth surrounding its creator.

items.title: To feel something at least
items.overview: A middle-aged woman finds emotional relief when pretending to be a sculpture.

items.title: Lacrimosa
items.overview: Luke returns from travelling, realising escape hasn’t freed him from lingering heartache. Determined to confront his past, he gathers tears in lacrimatory vials, descending into an orgiastic dance of memories to purge his pain and find the courage to move on.

items.title: Small Hours
items.overview: Locked out of her flat in the early hours of the morning, a young woman pleads with strangers to let her in.

items.title: The Blind Ferryman
items.overview: The blind ferryman Ayoub lives in the swamps of southern Iraq. One day he meets a mysterious woman and falls for her. Nobody believes that she exists. When even his neighbors turn away from him, he carries out a fatal act in desperation.

items.title: The Ballad of Lieutenant Dan
items.overview: Inspired by the character he played and told by those who know him best, Gary Sinise’s story follows his mission to serve injured veterans and Gold Star families while enduring the devastating loss of his son, Mac.

items.title: Eight Walls Two Doors
items.overview: As lockdown protests erupt in China in 2022, past and present blend for a Chinese woman living in New York; all the while, a leaky radiator sparks a romance between her husband and an older neighbor…

items.title: Different Shores
items.overview: An abrasive caregiver and a stubborn elderly woman must reconcile their contrasting personalities to find inner healing.

items.title: Saara
items.overview: Saara has packed her bags yet again, searching for a place where she can finally belong. But, just as she’s about to leave, she is enticed by mysterious visions and an unexpected yearning for intimacy.

items.title: Saturn
items.overview: The Norwegian department of a Swedish mob is struggling with operations going south. A man has to confront his son, leading to a terrible event

items.title: Lovers' Quarrel
items.overview: A cosy night in turns into complete chaos when a desperate friend crashes a couple's evening, hiding from his furious girlfriend after an unfortunate case of mistaken identity.

items.title: Cocaine Cowboys
items.overview: Twenty years after Cocaine Cowboys premiered, the cult classic returns with a complete visual reconstruction. Smugglers, traffickers, assassins and cops. The people who lived Miami’s cocaine wars reveal how billions in drug money and an unprecedented wave of violence transformed a sleepy vacation town into an international capital.

items.title: Falling Out
items.overview: A night of drinks with friends takes an extraordinary turn when an impossible encounter forces one young man to question the future of the people he loves.

items.title: Maanaa Kanimo
items.overview: Set in a tight-knit community disrupted by the disappearance of a Mama Mary statue, the story follows two sisters as they confront questions of identity, faith, and morality.

items.title: Scatterbrain
items.overview: An imaginative college senior enlists the help of his childhood best friends to uncover the mystery behind a cartoonish cloud in the sky only he can see.

items.title: The Last Vision
items.overview: After visiting an isolated coastal fort, a group of friends begin experiencing fatal visions of each other's deaths.

items.title: August 31st, 1997
items.overview: Based on personal recollections of the events of August 31st, 1997, a filmmaker revisits his childhood through the perspective of the television set that raised him.

items.title: It's not so cold in the spring anymore
items.overview: Grieving the end of a violent relationship, I return to my parents' home in Yumbel to celebrate my birthday. Weaving together present-day footage and family archive material, I search for a new way to confront the intergenerational depression my mother and I share.

items.title: Black Slaughter
items.overview: In 1996 Israel, an atmospheric thriller set within the Ethiopian Jewish community probes the fault lines between race, religion, and national identity.

items.title: Deadbolt
items.overview: Anne Harrington is weighing a run for Congress when she comes home to find a door cracked open, one she is certain she locked. Within minutes, silence turns to dread, and dread turns to terror, as she realizes she is not alone in her own house. Trapped and hunted through the dark, she must outwit two violent predators who will stop at nothing.

items.title: 2126, Looking for the Sea's Star
items.overview: Reunited in their hometown of Kushiro by a bid to revive a once-beloved RPG sequel, a group of childhood friends fight for the future of their town.

items.title: Shopping Cart
items.overview: Ana works at a supermarket where autonomous AI-controlled shopping carts have replaced the staff. Mistreated daily by customers, she forms a bond with the machines. But when a serious accident occurs, Ana realizes the carts are not what they seem.

items.title: La Violinista
items.overview: A young violinist must discover whether her music belongs to the world, her family, or herself.

items.title: Talking Stage
items.overview: As two strangers prepare for their first date, well-meaning friends take over the conversation, turning a promising romance into a comedy of mixed messages, modern dating and missed connections.

items.title: Eye Contact
items.overview: A criminology student requests to interview a man convicted of seven mysterious murders, but upon arrival, is given one strict rule. Whatever you do... don't look him in the eye.

items.title: Make Me Laugh
items.overview: *Faça-Me Rir* follows the story of an aging, washed-up clown who decides to hold a bizarre contest to find a replacement to take his place. However, the situation spirals completely out of control and takes a dark turn when one of the contestants loses all restraint in his actions.

items.title: The Scar Lake 7
items.overview: Seven friends vanished during a weekend getaway at a secluded lakeside cabin, leaving behind a mystery that would haunt the town for a decade. When advances in DNA technology finally reopen the case, two detectives interrogate the property's reclusive owner and the group's sole survivor. As their stories expose a tangled web of jealousy, betrayal, and violence, the search for answers reveals that something far more sinister may be lurking beneath the surface of Scar Lake.

items.title: Rainy
items.overview: After the accidental death of his daughter, Rainy, who fell from a bridge, Aek, a single father, finds himself consumed by grief and guilt. He decides to undergo a memory-erasing procedure to wipe Rainy from his mind entirely.

items.title: Where Is My Son?
items.overview: The house is alive with wedding preparations. On a hot summer day, food is being laid out, music fills the air, and Gulnaz, a strong-willed mother of three, is determined to give her daughter Ainara a beautiful Kazakh wedding. Then someone notices that Meirim, her youngest son, is missing. At first, there is hope for a simple explanation. But hours pass, calls lead nowhere, and the celebration slowly gives way to fear. As relatives and friends are drawn into the search, old tensions rise and secrets begin slipping through the cracks.

items.title: Gobbl
items.overview: A struggling musician gets a shot at the break he’s always wanted, but with his relationship under strain and his day job delivering blowjobs, Tom must decide how far he’ll go to chase the dream.

items.title: FOREVER CHEMICALS
items.overview: A sensory journey into the silent contamination of our everyday lives by PFAS, the so-called “forever chemicals.”

items.title: Music The Film
items.overview: "Music The Film" is a 24-minute-feature-length visual album thats brings the "Music" universe to life. The movie features recurrent references to the star-status hunger, teenager feelings and surreal dreams.

items.title: Run Shirley Run!
items.overview: A suicidal manananggal splits in two. Her top half wants to die, but her bottom half wants to live. Who will get their way?

items.title: Depersonalisation Station
items.overview: An actress performs a poem born from depersonalisation, exploring the unsettling distance between body and self, and the quiet ways we drift from ourselves while life carries on.

items.title: Vincent Niclo et le Choeur symphonique : Bel Canto Tour
Balaton
items.overview: Lake Balaton is one of Hungary's main tourist attractions during the summer. But when winter arrives, all the towns in the area are empty. In this context, and in the shadow of the war in Ukraine, Olena and Boldizsár meet by chance. Both are alone and try to deal with their respective problems, while trying to connect in a language that is not fluent.

items.title: Township
items.overview: Join Ronald, Joe, and Aadit on the town in Chicago.

items.title: Norma
items.overview: This Brazilian animated short tells the story of Norma, an elderly trans woman, is sent to a nursing home by her daughter. Norma plunges into a routine of rigid rules and loneliness, missing her daughter and her grandson. Everything changes when a clandestine web of friendships emerges, forging a pact of resilience against the system.

items.title: Let Sleeping Cats Lie
items.overview: Unlike a cat you only get one life so sometimes it's better to let sleeping cats lie.

items.title: Unearthly Disposition
items.overview: Two regular joes hide in a bunker as an alien invasion consumes the Earth around them. A fragile peace fills the room, until they hear a knock at the door...

items.title: Spontaneous Human Combustion
items.overview: There's a disease going around, a disorder of inner liquids. Five separate instances are tied together through what is blue, rather than what is not - from which, a woman in distress that lurks around a subway station, and two girls sharing an intimate moment, whilst being watched.  Far from proving anything spiritual, it proves that the body is, alas, and all too much, just a body.

items.title: Orgasmagoria
items.overview: An ongoing film about sexual pleasure in the digital age, created in collaboration with a group of international (cyber)sex workers, porn actors and their friends. In front of the camera, they close their eyes and imagine a future in which desire is inextricably linked to technology, money and power. Orgasmagoria unfolds as an endless series of personal stories, fables and dystopias. In a realm saturated with explicit imagery, imagination is brought back into play.

items.title: The Dome Sessions
items.overview: Richly textured music film in which 11 artists enter into a dialogue with the architecture, raw acoustics, and history of a huge concrete Dome on Oscar Niemeyer's unfinished exhibition site in Tripoli.

items.title: Inherit the Winds: Hajimari
items.overview: Set in June 1863 (Bunkyu 3), a young man with amnesia is brought to the Mibu Roshi-gumi headquarters in Kyoto. Rescued by Okita Soji, he begins his new life as a member of the unit under the name Jinnosuke Tachikawa. As the group's presence grows amidst the turbulent Bakumatsu era, Jinnosuke finds himself caught in the waves of historical change and the brewing tensions within the ranks.

items.title: Crooners
items.overview: World-renowned singers Frank and Sam argue on who’s the better singer between them. While those two bicker, their girlfriends Diana and Peggy share a conversation about their relationships and maybe themselves, using lyrics of iconic crooner songs as dialogue.

items.title: Jimmy Sentoro in: FOOL ME TWICE!
items.overview: When old friends are killed by a masked menace, private eye Jimmy Sentoro must team up with district attorney Charlie Kent to solve the case.

items.title: Lash Gaze
items.overview: Behind neighbouring windows, two lives quietly unfold.  Tom and Kate share an unusual feature: extraordinarily long eyelashes. He is a solitary artist, drawn to the intimacy of watching from afar; she moves through the world with unapologetic confidence, concealing a more private self behind closed doors.  As Tom's gaze lingers on Kate, an unspoken game begins to take shape. Yet, what appears to be a solitary act of observation gradually reveals a mutual exchange. In the quiet space between watching and being watched, two strangers find an unexpected way of reaching one another , revealing a universal longing to connect, to be understood, and to exist in the eyes of someone else.

items.title: And I Maintain
items.overview: Shards, desire and fear: the boundaries between everyday life and dreams become blurred. A film about the truthfulness of things.

items.title: Hyperborea
items.overview: From the empty space, a world is generated, contained within the space of an old scroll. A goddess rules it: she is both good and evil. Beauty and violence intertwine within this microcosm, in a way that makes them almost indistinguishable between one another, until everything ends, in an infinite loop, parading into a "Hellmouth" where we are not allowed to follow.  Made of more than 1000 drawings on paper, hand drawn and hand colored with a straight ahead technique, in order to enhance its surreal quality, the animation references both folk-medieval and contemporary art.  By playing with the space of the paper, intertwining empty and ultra-crowded sequences, the scenes overwhelm the viewer, who is challenged to pick a character as their guide inside this chaotic world, where there is no truth: only what one chooses to see and what chooses to ignore.

items.title: I DREAM OF THE END OF POST-COLONAILISM IN THE PARK 5 min.
items.overview: Relaxing in the park, haunted by the tower, city, and modern world, hallucinated by the internet.

items.title: Super Champions
items.overview: Seven people think about their place in the universe.

items.title: A Pagan Prayer
items.overview: A woman wanders through a landfill on the outskirts of a city. Among the debris, she finds an old box containing a tiny, miniature crown. From that moment, something shifts. An ancient, natural, and magical world opens up for us to behold. Both spaces, somehow, coexist. Somehow, they never quite separate.

items.title: POG1: The Making of a Legend
items.overview: More than a story of victories, POG1 – The Making of a Legend is a portrait of Tadej Pogačar beyond the finish line.  The documentary explores the people, relationships and defining moments that shaped one of the greatest cyclists of his generation, revealing the mindset, character and passion behind an athlete who is redefining the history of the sport.

items.title: 10 Days Later
items.overview: Told by the players, first responders, and fans who were there, 10 Days Later revisits the night Mike Piazza's eighth-inning home run turned the first ballgame after 9/11 into a moment of collective healing.

items.title: A Ghost Can Only Howl
items.overview: A young, feminine herbolario dons his mother’s clothes in hopes of joining the revolutionary forces, but he must first get past his father’s madness.

items.title: Cowboy
items.overview: "COWBOY" is a music video by Jack Boaz and Ryan Thompson, featuring Boaz's original song of the same name. Jack, a transmasc cowboy-curious protagonist, is introduced to Western cowboy culture through Susi, an elder butch cowboy. Susi take him to the Gay Rodeo. Line dancing ensues.  "COWBOY" was executive produced and creative directed by Jack Boaz, in collaboration with on-location filming at the New Mexico Gay Rodeo (Santa Fe, NM), and with The Outlaws, a group of queer line dancers from Albuquerque, NM, who created an original line dance choreography for the video by 7 of their trans/nonbinary choreographers. The video was a DIY and community effort, self-funded with 25 dance volunteers, and no indie or major label support.

items.title: Answering The Call
items.overview: On Ireland’s rugged west coast, a rare call cuts through the summer night: a corncrake has returned. For those who have grown up with its rasping cry, this is more than the return of a bird. It is the sound of home, of childhood summers and a living connection to a landscape shaped by generations. But that familiar voice is disappearing, and with it, a piece of who these communities are.  In Answering the Call, communities of farmers, locals and naturalists unite in a race to save what few corncrake remain. As the community rallies to answer the call, one question becomes impossible to ignore: if they fail to act now, will they be the last generation to hear this extraordinary sound?

items.title: Karst
items.overview: Wanting to rediscover himself after his commited relationship was terminated, Mislav decides to visit his father who lives in a small village in the Dalmatian Hinterland and runs a fighting bull breeding business. However, his newfound relationship with one of the bulls starts changing Mislav as a person.

items.title: Escape the Internet
items.overview: The AI apocalypse has begun, and humanity is suffering from a deadly form of brain rot in this hilarious, chaotic and unifying video game for the big screen. A unique collective experience.

items.title: Alive
items.overview: Baby, baby. Now wait and stay. I’m gonna make you scream and pay. Why you look so scared? I thought you wanted a ride? Is it not the right kind of ride? Not the right kind of vibe?

items.title: The Dance of the Angels
items.overview: A group of young people conquer the heavens and return to earth as angels. But they are invisible to mortals. Only an old camcorder, forgotten in a family drawer, is capable of capturing a faint trace of their presence.

items.title: So, my daughter says you’re a film critic?
items.overview: A young man visits his girlfriend’s father for the first time. When the father asks whether he’s a film critic, he confidently replies, “I write on Letterboxd.” The answer doesn’t go down quite as expected, and the father tells him to get the fuck out of his house.

items.title: Monsieur Mercedes - Im Schatten des Sterns
Cat Cabaret
items.overview: Three kick ass strippers suspect their no good manager is up to something sinister. Will their combined skills of brain, brawn and heart be enough to save their club and each other before it’s too late?

items.title: 無題のスーパー8フィルム
Little Things
items.overview: Through the changing reflection of her mother, Sara contemplates how reflections reveal our experiences, the passage of time, and the beliefs we carry about ourselves.

items.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000: The RiffTrax Experiments — The Mummy Theme Park
items.overview: Mike and the bots riff on this Italian film about an American photographer and his assistant/possible girlfriend being sent to Egypt to take pictures of the brand new Mummy Theme Park.

items.title: Flhorrida 2: Even Flhorrider
items.overview: In 2017, a horrid holiday happened... Now, in 2025, a holiday happened horridly... again! SmellBad Films present, a rubbish sequel no one in the universe asked for. But this time, it will be... EPIC!

items.title: The Wetland
items.overview: An environmentalist farmer and his biologist daughter lead efforts to save their 1,000 year old wetland community from being destroyed by Mexico City.

items.title: Raíces
items.overview: After being rescued by a remote community, two siblings discover that the place that saved them will stop at nothing to keep them from leaving.

items.title: Get Stuffed
items.overview: The year is 1986, and a group camping trip goes awry when five students find themselves hunted by a masked killer. The killer's aim? To start a human taxidermy collection.

items.title: Shisei
items.overview: New adaptation of Junichiro Tanizaki short story. Seiji, a tattoo artist who returned to Japan following his father’s death, encounters Chisato—a woman who wanders the city streets barefoot. Captivated by Chisato, who lives desperately for the sake of her younger brother and her lover, Seiji becomes consumed by a burning desire to tattoo her back—an act that feels like a defiance against his own failing, illness-ridden body. Meanwhile, Seiji reconnects with his childhood friend, Takashi, who has been living a dissolute life. Together, Seiji, Takashi, and Chisato—who longs to shed her timid self and be reborn—embark on a journey, leaving everything else behind.

items.title: You've Got Me
items.overview: When Henley, an insecure 10-year-old learns his best friend Rory is leaving for private school, he agrees to an outrageous plan to rob a bank, so he can join Rory at private school and keep their friendship alive.

items.title: I was in Cologne all summer
items.overview: A film made as a farewell brings memories back to life. As a camera stitches the edges of a city together, the summer stretches into forever. Remembering turns into forgetting; forgetting, into remembering. As time folds in on itself, the Rhine keeps flowing.

items.title: Ark Park
items.overview: An observational study of Kentucky's "Ark Encounter", a Christian fundamentalist theme park that approaches the biblical story of Noah's unique vessel as historical fact.

items.title: Jardín Escondido
items.overview: Hidden Garden

items.title: Persistence
items.overview: A bored young boy visits a science park and embarks on an adventure in science.

items.title: Nchuwejh
items.overview: A dance film set in the heart of the Chaco Impenetrable, where the Wichí movement intertwines with the four elements and ancestral memory to celebrate the sacred bond between culture and nature.

items.title: The Stag
items.overview: Following a heist that gifts them more money than expected, a dysfunctional group of thieves find their hopes and dreams shattered when they are forced to confront a serial killer, as well as the vengeful crime lord they’ve stolen from.

items.title: KIDKILLER
items.overview: FBI Special Agent Collins is dispatched to investigate a missing child at an abandoned residence. But when the case turns out to be nonexistent, a ransom note reveals that she was the intended target all along.

items.title: The Dead House
items.overview: At his grandfather’s wake, Patrick is forced into a long-avoided confrontation with his father, unearthing buried shame, family secrets and the Traveller heritage that continues to shape their lives.

items.title: See It Loud! The Globe Poster Story
items.overview: See It Loud documents the legacy and rebirth of Globe Poster, the legendary, Baltimore-based poster company.

items.title: The Other Mother's Child
items.overview: Andy's son is kidnapped by mistake. The target was her friend Katrina's child. The kidnappers give her one way to get him back: kill Katrina.

items.title: Alfetashim
items.overview: A Film by Redi Bereka

items.title: River's Dawn
items.overview: Struck down by grief and trapped in her own depression, a young woman is drawn outside by a mysterious sound beneath her window, embarking on a journey through nature and memories to find peace within her mind.

items.title: SALUS ANIMARUM
items.overview: On July 1, 2026, thirty-eight years after the episcopal consecrations performed by Archbishop Marcel Lefebvre, four new bishops are consecrated in Écône for the Society of Saint Pius X.  Through exclusive testimonies and previously unseen footage, the documentary SALUS ANIMARUM explores the circumstances and reasons behind this decision, the preparations for the consecrations, the ceremony itself, and the reactions it provoked within the Church.  Beyond this historic event, the film highlights what is at stake in the transmission of Catholic Tradition, fidelity to the priesthood, and the mission of the Church, whose supreme law remains the salvation of souls.

items.title: Between Sky and Sea
items.overview: A largely wordless portrait of life in displacement from Gaza City filmmaker Ismail Abu Hatab (1993-2025), Between Sky and Sea artfully documents scenes of resilience, survival, and ordinary life of Palestinians in Gaza’s largest displacement site during the summer of 2024, concluding in a mass march home to northern Gaza.

items.title: Moondog Equestria
items.overview: A ritual situated between (post)modern staging and the authentic representation of indigenous customs, featuring Mexican art, horseback riding and the music of Moondog.

items.title: Vamped
items.overview: After attending a vampire-themed party with her best friend, Joaquin, Mina is bitten by a mysterious stranger (Keiran). She begins undergoing unsettling changes. As her senses sharpen and her confidence grows, she starts to realize that the life she feared losing may have been holding her back all along.

items.title: Lapidaria
items.overview: Rosa danced to exhaustion. Now, in her sixties, with an impressive career as a dancer and contemporary dance teacher, she has lost her job and, with it, the will to live... At least not as a human being. Deep and dark thoughts arise as an invocation to a supernatural being that frees her from her carnal wrapping, seeking to sublimate her existence towards immortality. But first, he will have to say goodbye to all the primal pleasure and sensation. And then, he will come.

items.title: Kinomania: The Beginning
items.overview: The beginning of the World Film Panorama in Sofia was in November 1987, and since 1993 the event has taken the name "Kinomania". For four decades now, the capital's oldest film festival has been bringing audiences together with the best of world cinema from the past year. Through the stories of the real participants in the events and intriguing archival footage, the short documentary film by Boris Missirkov and Georgi Bogdanov tells the story of the festival's creation – from the World Film Panorama and the birth of "Kinomania" to the present day.

items.title: Der Fall Fabian - Hinter der Akte
Animal
items.overview: One night. Two boys. A truth they can't escape.

items.title: After Dive
items.overview: After Dive tells a story of passion, perseverance, discipline, and companionship. The athletic preparation required in springboard diving demands constant training, a ritual that perfects technique, coordination, and concentration. The film unfolds at the Karl Dibiasi pool in Bolzano, where Tania Cagnotto and Francesca Dallapè, Europe’s most successful synchronized diving pair, have trained since 2008. Two years after initially saying farewell to the boards, they return to train together for the next Olympic Games. In the meantime, both have become mothers: Tania to Maya and Francesca to Ludovica.

items.title: Peter
items.overview: Peter, an intoxicated trans man, leaves the bar late at night. On his way to meet a love interest, he gets followed by a mysterious man. Peter questions whether this man is just a pedestrian or if he has sinister intentions, specifically a hate crime.

items.title: the door is open
items.overview: In this political moment, when creating feels futile, I choose instead to craft a spell. Four tracks make up my film: two you can see and hear, and two that remain invisible and inaudible, yet are fully present. The Door Is Open is a spell by and for trans and non-binary people. It is an offering—crafted with intention, grief, joy, and magic. This short film is not meant for consumption or voyeuristic curiosity. The Door Is Open is an act of care: a portal, a whisper, a protection spell woven in light and shadow. If you are trans and or non-binary, this film is for you. You are invited. You are necessary. You are seen. The spell waits patiently for you.﻿﻿

items.title: attempting to escape death by dancing
items.overview: di come i vivi tentarono, danzando, di sottrarsi alla morte is an experimental documentary exploring traditional dances of Southern Italy as collective acts of resistance against death. Through the manipulation and progressive digital degradation of archival footage, accompanied by a grotesque and unsettling soundscape, the film brings Elias Canetti's reflections on the refusal to accept death into dialogue with Ernesto de Martino's studies on magic and the crisis of presence. The movement of bodies becomes a ritual attempt to suspend the irreversibility of time, an obstinate and ultimately futile revolt against the dissolution of existence.

items.title: COOKED FLESH
items.overview: When an arrogant young sous chef named Danny receives a final warning at the restaurant “Bruce and CO”. He makes a reckless decision to get back at his over-bearing manager, turning him into an uncontrollable zombie. What begins as a petty revenge prank quickly spirals into complete chaos. Forcing Danny and the staff to survive an increasingly bizarre shift, while trying to save both their jobs and their lives.

items.title: A Life with Peregrines
items.overview: For forty years, George has been protecting the peregrine falcons of the Scottish Borders. Now that his retirement is approaching, he is passing on his knowledge to his protégé Rebecca. An intimate portrait about nature conservation, dedication, and passing on a lifelong mission.

items.title: The Moon Comes Again
items.overview: As an elderly couple reflects on their shared life, their memories challenge the promise of "happily ever after".

items.title: Selamat Hari Jadi
items.overview: Tuck feels the growing cracks in his family as his parents drift apart. At his birthday party, he meets Oak, a spirited Malay girl. Through their friendship, he learns to face fear, loneliness, and the imperfect reality of growing up.

items.title: Holy Moly!
items.overview: Prasin, Voplatek, and Filip. three friends from Polevsko in the Šluknov salient, want to mark their final evening together with something special: stealing a crucifix and adding it to the collection of "trophies" in their hangout spot. But while two of them are preparing to head off to Prague, the third refuses to come to terms with the changes on the horizon. A satirical coming-of-age comedy about friendship, growing up, and the difficulty of letting others go.

items.title: Full Moon
items.overview: Raimunda is an elderly woman from rural Minas Gerais whose routine as a market vendor is disturbed by marital woes. When her husband vanishes, she sets out on his trail fueled by a thirst for revenge.

items.title: The Dream As Resistance
items.overview: A look into the mind of Belgian surfboard shaper Angelo De Meulenaere.

items.title: Cold Streak
items.overview: After a career-ending injury takes away the one thing this former D1 basketball player has ever known, he returns to the court for one final shot, hoping to recapture the feeling of who he once was.

items.title: GANTARI
items.overview: A highschool girl learn that her life have more to offer when she discover the art of dancing.

items.title: Your Worst Nightmare
items.overview: A group of unassuming Halloween partygoers fall victim to the plot of two murderers among them. Chaos ensues as the group hunt for clues that will lead them to the killers.

items.title: Sidestep
items.overview: After obtaining a valuable briefcase, a spy must make a quick and stealthy exit as counterintelligence searches for him. When things go awry, he must rely on his handler and his wits to outsmart counterintelligence agents.

items.title: Familial
items.overview: After discovering his parents are serial killers, a teenage boy must choose whether to turn them in - or join them.

items.title: Entropy
items.overview: Are things getting better? I’m not sure.

items.title: 13-Novembre : La France face au terrorisme islamiste
Jarlath Regan - Make America Laugh Again
items.overview: A brand new stand-up comedy special from Irish comedian Jarlath Regan. Breaking America is one thing. Getting into America, is quite another.
